arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
english: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
hindi: अल्लाह के नाम से जो रहमान व रहीम है।
hinglish: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
english: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds -
hindi: तारीफ़ अल्लाह ही के लिये है जो तमाम क़ायनात का रब है।
hinglish: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds -

arabic: ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
english: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
hindi: रहमान और रहीम है।
hinglish: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,

arabic: مَـٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
english: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.
hindi: रोज़े जज़ा का मालिक है।
hinglish: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.

arabic: إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ
english: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
hindi: हम तेरी ही इबादत करते हैं, और तुझ ही से मदद मांगते है।
hinglish: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.

arabic: ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
english: Guide us to the straight path -
hindi: हमें सीधा रास्ता दिखा।
hinglish: Guide us to the straight path -

arabic: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
english: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.
hindi: उन लोगों का रास्ता जिन पर तूने इनाम फ़रमाया, जो माअतूब नहीं हुए, जो भटके हुए नहीं है।
hinglish: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓمٓ
english: Alif, Lam, Meem.
hindi: अलीफ़ लाम मीम
hinglish: Alif, Lam, Meem.

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
english: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -
hindi: (ये) वह किताब है। जिस (के किताबे खुदा होने) में कुछ भी शक नहीं (ये) परहेज़गारों की रहनुमा है
hinglish: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
english: Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them,
hindi: जो ग़ैब पर ईमान लाते हैं और (पाबन्दी से) नमाज़ अदा करते हैं और जो कुछ हमने उनको दिया है उसमें से (राहे खुदा में) ख़र्च करते हैं
hinglish: Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them,

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ وَبِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
english: And who believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
hindi: और जो कुछ तुम पर (ऐ रसूल) और तुम से पहले नाज़िल किया गया है उस पर ईमान लाते हैं और वही आख़िरत का यक़ीन भी रखते हैं
hinglish: And who believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].

arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
english: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.
hindi: यही लोग अपने परवरदिगार की हिदायत पर (आमिल) हैं और यही लोग अपनी दिली मुरादें पाएँगे
hinglish: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
english: Indeed, those who disbelieve - it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
hindi: बेशक जिन लोगों ने कुफ़्र इख़तेयार किया उनके लिए बराबर है (ऐ रसूल) ख्वाह (चाहे) तुम उन्हें डराओ या न डराओ वह ईमान न लाएँगे
hinglish: Indeed, those who disbelieve - it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.

arabic: خَتَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَعَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِمْ ۖ وَعَلَىٰٓ أَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ غِشَـٰوَةٌ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
english: Allah has set a seal upon their hearts and upon their hearing, and over their vision is a veil. And for them is a great punishment.
hindi: उनके दिलों पर और उनके कानों पर (नज़र करके) खुदा ने तसदीक़ कर दी है (कि ये ईमान न लाएँगे) और उनकी ऑंखों पर परदा (पड़ा हुआ) है और उन्हीं के लिए (बहुत) बड़ा अज़ाब है
hinglish: Allah has set a seal upon their hearts and upon their hearing, and over their vision is a veil. And for them is a great punishment.

arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ وَمَا هُم بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
english: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah and the Last Day," but they are not believers.
hindi: और बाज़ लोग ऐसे भी हैं जो (ज़बान से तो) कहते हैं कि हम खुदा पर और क़यामत पर ईमान लाए हालाँकि वह दिल से ईमान नहीं लाए
hinglish: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah and the Last Day," but they are not believers.

arabic: يُخَـٰدِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَمَا يَخْدَعُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
english: They [think to] deceive Allah and those who believe, but they deceive not except themselves and perceive [it] not.
hindi: खुदा को और उन लोगों को जो ईमान लाए धोखा देते हैं हालाँकि वह अपने आपको धोखा देते हैं और कुछ शऊर नहीं रखते हैं
hinglish: They [think to] deceive Allah and those who believe, but they deceive not except themselves and perceive [it] not.

arabic: فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ فَزَادَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَرَضًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْذِبُونَ
english: In their hearts is disease, so Allah has increased their disease; and for them is a painful punishment because they [habitually] used to lie.
hindi: उनके दिलों में मर्ज़ था ही अब खुदा ने उनके मर्ज़ को और बढ़ा दिया और चूँकि वह लोग झूठ बोला करते थे इसलिए उन पर तकलीफ देह अज़ाब है
hinglish: In their hearts is disease, so Allah has increased their disease; and for them is a painful punishment because they [habitually] used to lie.

arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُصْلِحُونَ
english: And when it is said to them, "Do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "We are but reformers."
hindi: और जब उनसे कहा जाता है कि मुल्क में फसाद न करते फिरो (तो) कहते हैं कि हम तो सिर्फ इसलाह करते हैं
hinglish: And when it is said to them, "Do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "We are but reformers."

arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْسِدُونَ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
english: Unquestionably, it is they who are the corrupters, but they perceive [it] not.
hindi: ख़बरदार हो जाओ बेशक यही लोग फसादी हैं लेकिन समझते नहीं
hinglish: Unquestionably, it is they who are the corrupters, but they perceive [it] not.

arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ ءَامِنُوا۟ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلنَّاسُ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
english: And when it is said to them, "Believe as the people have believed," they say, "Should we believe as the foolish have believed?" Unquestionably, it is they who are the foolish, but they know [it] not.
hindi: और जब उनसे कहा जाता है कि जिस तरह और लोग ईमान लाए हैं तुम भी ईमान लाओ तो कहते हैं क्या हम भी उसी तरह ईमान लाएँ जिस तरह और बेवकूफ़ लोग ईमान लाएँ, ख़बरदार हो जाओ लोग बेवक़ूफ़ हैं लेकिन नहीं जानते
hinglish: And when it is said to them, "Believe as the people have believed," they say, "Should we believe as the foolish have believed?" Unquestionably, it is they who are the foolish, but they know [it] not.

arabic: وَإِذَا لَقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ شَيَـٰطِينِهِمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مَعَكُمْ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُسْتَهْزِءُونَ
english: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We believe"; but when they are alone with their evil ones, they say, "Indeed, we are with you; we were only mockers."
hindi: और जब उन लोगों से मिलते हैं जो ईमान ला चुके तो कहते हैं हम तो ईमान ला चुके और जब अपने शैतानों के साथ तनहा रह जाते हैं तो कहते हैं हम तुम्हारे साथ हैं हम तो (मुसलमानों को) बनाते हैं
hinglish: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We believe"; but when they are alone with their evil ones, they say, "Indeed, we are with you; we were only mockers."

arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَهْزِئُ بِهِمْ وَيَمُدُّهُمْ فِى طُغْيَـٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
english: [But] Allah mocks them and prolongs them in their transgression [while] they wander blindly.
hindi: (वह क्या बनाएँगे) खुदा उनको बनाता है और उनको ढील देता है कि वह अपनी सरकशी में ग़लत पेचाँ (उलझे) रहें
hinglish: [But] Allah mocks them and prolongs them in their transgression [while] they wander blindly.

arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلضَّلَـٰلَةَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَـٰرَتُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ
english: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.
hindi: यही वह लोग हैं जिन्होंने हिदायत के बदले गुमराही ख़रीद ली, फिर न उनकी तिजारत ही ने कुछ नफ़ा दिया और न उन लोगों ने हिदायत ही पाई
hinglish: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.

arabic: مَثَلُهُمْ كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِى ٱسْتَوْقَدَ نَارًا فَلَمَّآ أَضَآءَتْ مَا حَوْلَهُۥ ذَهَبَ ٱللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمْ وَتَرَكَهُمْ فِى ظُلُمَـٰتٍ لَّا يُبْصِرُونَ
english: Their example is that of one who kindled a fire, but when it illuminated what was around him, Allah took away their light and left them in darkness [so] they could not see.
hindi: उन लोगों की मिसाल (तो) उस शख्स की सी है जिसने (रात के वक्त मजमे में) भड़कती हुईआग रौशन की फिर जब आग (के शोले) ने उसके गिर्दों पेश (चारों ओर) खूब उजाला कर दिया तो खुदा ने उनकी रौशनी ले ली और उनको घटाटोप अंधेरे में छोड़ दिया
hinglish: Their example is that of one who kindled a fire, but when it illuminated what was around him, Allah took away their light and left them in darkness [so] they could not see.

arabic: صُمٌّۢ بُكْمٌ عُمْىٌ فَهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
english: Deaf, dumb and blind - so they will not return [to the right path].
hindi: कि अब उन्हें कुछ सुझाई नहीं देता ये लोग बहरे गूँगे अन्धे हैं कि फिर अपनी गुमराही से बाज़ नहीं आ सकते
hinglish: Deaf, dumb and blind - so they will not return [to the right path].

arabic: أَوْ كَصَيِّبٍ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فِيهِ ظُلُمَـٰتٌ وَرَعْدٌ وَبَرْقٌ يَجْعَلُونَ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِم مِّنَ ٱلصَّوَٰعِقِ حَذَرَ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ مُحِيطٌۢ بِٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
english: Or [it is] like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning. They put their fingers in their ears against the thunderclaps in dread of death. But Allah is encompassing of the disbelievers.
hindi: या उनकी मिसाल ऐसी है जैसे आसमानी बारिश जिसमें तारिकियाँ ग़र्ज़ बिजली हो मौत के खौफ से कड़क के मारे अपने कानों में ऊँगलियाँ दे लेते हैं हालाँकि खुदा काफ़िरों को (इस तरह) घेरे हुए है (कि उसक हिल नहीं सकते)
hinglish: Or [it is] like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning. They put their fingers in their ears against the thunderclaps in dread of death. But Allah is encompassing of the disbelievers.

arabic: يَكَادُ ٱلْبَرْقُ يَخْطَفُ أَبْصَـٰرَهُمْ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أَضَآءَ لَهُم مَّشَوْا۟ فِيهِ وَإِذَآ أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ قَامُوا۟ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَذَهَبَ بِسَمْعِهِمْ وَأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
english: The lightning almost snatches away their sight. Every time it lights [the way] for them, they walk therein; but when darkness comes over them, they stand [still]. And if Allah had willed, He could have taken away their hearing and their sight. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.
hindi: क़रीब है कि बिजली उनकी ऑंखों को चौन्धिया दे जब उनके आगे बिजली चमकी तो उस रौशनी में चल खड़े हुए और जब उन पर अंधेरा छा गया तो (ठिठके के) खड़े हो गए और खुदा चाहता तो यूँ भी उनके देखने और सुनने की कूवतें छीन लेता बेशक खुदा हर चीज़ पर क़ादिर है
hinglish: The lightning almost snatches away their sight. Every time it lights [the way] for them, they walk therein; but when darkness comes over them, they stand [still]. And if Allah had willed, He could have taken away their hearing and their sight. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
english: O mankind, worship your Lord, who created you and those before you, that you may become righteous -
hindi: ऐ लोगों अपने परवरदिगार की इबादत करो जिसने तुमको और उन लोगों को जो तुम से पहले थे पैदा किया है अजब नहीं तुम परहेज़गार बन जाओ
hinglish: O mankind, worship your Lord, who created you and those before you, that you may become righteous -

arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فِرَٰشًا وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزْقًا لَّكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
english: [He] who made for you the earth a bed [spread out] and the sky a ceiling and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you. So do not attribute to Allah equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him].
hindi: जिसने तुम्हारे लिए ज़मीन का बिछौना और आसमान को छत बनाया और आसमान से पानी बरसाया फिर उसी ने तुम्हारे खाने के लिए बाज़ फल पैदा किए पस किसी को खुदा का हमसर न बनाओ हालाँकि तुम खूब जानते हो
hinglish: [He] who made for you the earth a bed [spread out] and the sky a ceiling and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you. So do not attribute to Allah equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him].

arabic: وَإِن كُنتُمْ فِى رَيْبٍ مِّمَّا نَزَّلْنَا عَلَىٰ عَبْدِنَا فَأْتُوا۟ بِسُورَةٍ مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ وَٱدْعُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
english: And if you are in doubt about what We have sent down upon Our Servant [Muhammad], then produce a surah the like thereof and call upon your witnesses other than Allah, if you should be truthful.
hindi: और अगर तुम लोग इस कलाम से जो हमने अपने बन्दे (मोहम्मद) पर नाज़िल किया है शक में पड़े हो पस अगर तुम सच्चे हो तो तुम (भी) एक सूरा बना लाओ और खुदा के सिवा जो भी तुम्हारे मददगार हों उनको भी बुला लो
hinglish: And if you are in doubt about what We have sent down upon Our Servant [Muhammad], then produce a surah the like thereof and call upon your witnesses other than Allah, if you should be truthful.

arabic: فَإِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلُوا۟ وَلَن تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِى وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلْحِجَارَةُ ۖ أُعِدَّتْ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
english: But if you do not - and you will never be able to - then fear the Fire, whose fuel is men and stones, prepared for the disbelievers.
hindi: पस अगर तुम ये नहीं कर सकते हो और हरगिज़ नहीं कर सकोगे तो उस आग से डरो सिके ईधन आदमी और पत्थर होंगे और काफ़िरों के लिए तैयार की गई है
hinglish: But if you do not - and you will never be able to - then fear the Fire, whose fuel is men and stones, prepared for the disbelievers.

arabic: وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ كُلَّمَا رُزِقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مِن ثَمَرَةٍ رِّزْقًا ۙ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى رُزِقْنَا مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَأُتُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُتَشَـٰبِهًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِيهَآ أَزْوَٰجٌ مُّطَهَّرَةٌ ۖ وَهُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
english: And give good tidings to those who believe and do righteous deeds that they will have gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow. Whenever they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, "This is what we were provided with before." And it is given to them in likeness. And they will have therein purified spouses, and they will abide therein eternally.
hindi: और जो लोग ईमान लाए और उन्होंने नेक काम किए उनको (ऐ पैग़म्बर) खुशख़बरी दे दो कि उनके लिए (बेहिश्त के) वह बाग़ात हैं जिनके नीचे नहरे जारी हैं जब उन्हें इन बाग़ात का कोई मेवा खाने को मिलेगा तो कहेंगे ये तो वही (मेवा है जो पहले भी हमें खाने को मिल चुका है) (क्योंकि) उन्हें मिलती जुलती सूरत व रंग के (मेवे) मिला करेंगे और बेहिश्त में उनके लिए साफ सुथरी बीवियाँ होगी और ये लोग उस बाग़ में हमेशा रहेंगे
hinglish: And give good tidings to those who believe and do righteous deeds that they will have gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow. Whenever they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, "This is what we were provided with before." And it is given to them in likeness. And they will have therein purified spouses, and they will abide therein eternally.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَسْتَحْىِۦٓ أَن يَضْرِبَ مَثَلًا مَّا بَعُوضَةً فَمَا فَوْقَهَا ۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَيَقُولُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۘ يُضِلُّ بِهِۦ كَثِيرًا وَيَهْدِى بِهِۦ كَثِيرًا ۚ وَمَا يُضِلُّ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
english: Indeed, Allah is not timid to present an example - that of a mosquito or what is smaller than it. And those who have believed know that it is the truth from their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, they say, "What did Allah intend by this as an example?" He misleads many thereby and guides many thereby. And He misleads not except the defiantly disobedient,
hindi: बेशक खुदा मच्छर या उससे भी बढ़कर (हक़ीर चीज़) की कोई मिसाल बयान करने में नहीं झेंपता पस जो लोग ईमान ला चुके हैं वह तो ये यक़ीन जानते हैं कि ये (मिसाल) बिल्कुल ठीक है और ये परवरदिगार की तरफ़ से है (अब रहे) वह लोग जो काफ़िर है पस वह बोल उठते हैं कि खुदा का उस मिसाल से क्या मतलब है, ऐसी मिसाल से ख़ुदा बहुतेरों की हिदायत करता है मगर गुमराही में छोड़ता भी है तो ऐसे बदकारों को
hinglish: Indeed, Allah is not timid to present an example - that of a mosquito or what is smaller than it. And those who have believed know that it is the truth from their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, they say, "What did Allah intend by this as an example?" He misleads many thereby and guides many thereby. And He misleads not except the defiantly disobedient,

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مِيثَـٰقِهِۦ وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ
english: Who break the covenant of Allah after contracting it and sever that which Allah has ordered to be joined and cause corruption on earth. It is those who are the losers.
hindi: जो लोग खुदा के एहदो पैमान को मज़बूत हो जाने के बाद तोड़ डालते हैं और जिन (ताल्लुक़ात) का खुदा ने हुक्म दिया है उनको क़ताआ कर देते हैं और मुल्क में फसाद करते फिरते हैं, यही लोग घाटा उठाने वाले हैं
hinglish: Who break the covenant of Allah after contracting it and sever that which Allah has ordered to be joined and cause corruption on earth. It is those who are the losers.

arabic: كَيْفَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَكُنتُمْ أَمْوَٰتًا فَأَحْيَـٰكُمْ ۖ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
english: How can you disbelieve in Allah when you were lifeless and He brought you to life; then He will cause you to die, then He will bring you [back] to life, and then to Him you will be returned.
hindi: (हाँए) क्यों कर तुम खुदा का इन्कार कर सकते हो हालाँकि तुम (माओं के पेट में) बेजान थे तो उसी ने तुमको ज़िन्दा किया फिर वही तुमको मार डालेगा, फिर वही तुमको (दोबारा क़यामत में) ज़िन्दा करेगा फिर उसी की तरफ लौटाए जाओगे
hinglish: How can you disbelieve in Allah when you were lifeless and He brought you to life; then He will cause you to die, then He will bring you [back] to life, and then to Him you will be returned.

arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَسَوَّىٰهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ ۚ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
english: It is He who created for you all of that which is on the earth. Then He directed Himself to the heaven, [His being above all creation], and made them seven heavens, and He is Knowing of all things.
hindi: वही तो वह (खुदा) है जिसने तुम्हारे (नफ़े) के ज़मीन की कुल चीज़ों को पैदा किया फिर आसमान (के बनाने) की तरफ़ मुतावज्जेह हुआ तो सात आसमान हमवार (व मुसतहकम) बना दिए और वह (खुदा) हर चीज़ से (खूब) वाक़िफ है
hinglish: It is He who created for you all of that which is on the earth. Then He directed Himself to the heaven, [His being above all creation], and made them seven heavens, and He is Knowing of all things.

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى جَاعِلٌ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ خَلِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَجْعَلُ فِيهَا مَن يُفْسِدُ فِيهَا وَيَسْفِكُ ٱلدِّمَآءَ وَنَحْنُ نُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِكَ وَنُقَدِّسُ لَكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
english: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority." They said, "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we declare Your praise and sanctify You?" Allah said, "Indeed, I know that which you do not know."
hindi: और (ऐ रसूल) उस वक्त क़ो याद करो जब तुम्हारे परवरदिगार ने फ़रिश्तों से कहा कि मैं (अपना) एक नाएब ज़मीन में बनानेवाला हूँ (फरिश्ते ताज्जुब से) कहने लगे क्या तू ज़मीन ऐसे शख्स को पैदा करेगा जो ज़मीन में फ़साद और खूँरेज़ियाँ करता फिरे हालाँकि (अगर) ख़लीफा बनाना है (तो हमारा ज्यादा हक़ है) क्योंकि हम तेरी तारीफ व तसबीह करते हैं और तेरी पाकीज़गी साबित करते हैं तब खुदा ने फरमाया इसमें तो शक ही नहीं कि जो मैं जानता हूँ तुम नहीं जानते
hinglish: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority." They said, "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we declare Your praise and sanctify You?" Allah said, "Indeed, I know that which you do not know."

arabic: وَعَلَّمَ ءَادَمَ ٱلْأَسْمَآءَ كُلَّهَا ثُمَّ عَرَضَهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ فَقَالَ أَنۢبِـُٔونِى بِأَسْمَآءِ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
english: And He taught Adam the names - all of them. Then He showed them to the angels and said, "Inform Me of the names of these, if you are truthful."
hindi: और (आदम की हक़ीक़म ज़ाहिर करने की ग़रज़ से) आदम को सब चीज़ों के नाम सिखा दिए फिर उनको फरिश्तों के सामने पेश किया और फ़रमाया कि अगर तुम अपने दावे में कि हम मुस्तहके ख़िलाफ़त हैं। सच्चे हो तो मुझे इन चीज़ों के नाम बताओ
hinglish: And He taught Adam the names - all of them. Then He showed them to the angels and said, "Inform Me of the names of these, if you are truthful."

arabic: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَآ إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمْتَنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
english: They said, "Exalted are You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You who is the Knowing, the Wise."
hindi: तब फ़रिश्तों ने (आजिज़ी से) अर्ज़ की तू (हर ऐब से) पाक व पाकीज़ा है हम तो जो कुछ तूने बताया है उसके सिवा कुछ नहीं जानते तू बड़ा जानने वाला, मसलहतों का पहचानने वाला है
hinglish: They said, "Exalted are You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You who is the Knowing, the Wise."

arabic: قَالَ يَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ أَنۢبِئْهُم بِأَسْمَآئِهِمْ ۖ فَلَمَّآ أَنۢبَأَهُم بِأَسْمَآئِهِمْ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَأَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْتُمُونَ
english: He said, "O Adam, inform them of their names." And when he had informed them of their names, He said, "Did I not tell you that I know the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth? And I know what you reveal and what you have concealed."
hindi: (उस वक्त ख़ुदा ने आदम को) हुक्म दिया कि ऐ आदम तुम इन फ़रिश्तों को उन सब चीज़ों के नाम बता दो बस जब आदम ने फ़रिश्तों को उन चीज़ों के नाम बता दिए तो खुदा ने फरिश्तों की तरफ ख़िताब करके फरमाया क्यों, मैं तुमसे न कहता था कि मैं आसमानों और ज़मीनों के छिपे हुए राज़ को जानता हूँ, और जो कुछ तुम अब ज़ाहिर करते हो और जो कुछ तुम छिपाते थे (वह सब) जानता हूँ
hinglish: He said, "O Adam, inform them of their names." And when he had informed them of their names, He said, "Did I not tell you that I know the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth? And I know what you reveal and what you have concealed."

arabic: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِـَٔادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
english: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate before Adam"; so they prostrated, except for Iblees. He refused and was arrogant and became of the disbelievers.
hindi: और (उस वक्त क़ो याद करो) जब हमने फ़रिश्तों से कहा कि आदम को सजदा करो तो सब के सब झुक गए मगर शैतान ने इन्कार किया और ग़ुरूर में आ गया और काफ़िर हो गया
hinglish: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate before Adam"; so they prostrated, except for Iblees. He refused and was arrogant and became of the disbelievers.

arabic: وَقُلْنَا يَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ ٱسْكُنْ أَنتَ وَزَوْجُكَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَكُلَا مِنْهَا رَغَدًا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمَا وَلَا تَقْرَبَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
english: And We said, "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat therefrom in [ease and] abundance from wherever you will. But do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers."
hindi: और हमने आदम से कहा ऐ आदम तुम अपनी बीवी समैत बेहिश्त में रहा सहा करो और जहाँ से तुम्हारा जी चाहे उसमें से ब फराग़त खाओ (पियो) मगर उस दरख्त के पास भी न जाना (वरना) फिर तुम अपना आप नुक़सान करोगे
hinglish: And We said, "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat therefrom in [ease and] abundance from wherever you will. But do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers."

arabic: فَأَزَلَّهُمَا ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ عَنْهَا فَأَخْرَجَهُمَا مِمَّا كَانَا فِيهِ ۖ وَقُلْنَا ٱهْبِطُوا۟ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ ۖ وَلَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُسْتَقَرٌّ وَمَتَـٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
english: But Satan caused them to slip out of it and removed them from that [condition] in which they had been. And We said, "Go down, [all of you], as enemies to one another, and you will have upon the earth a place of settlement and provision for a time."
hindi: तब शैतान ने आदम व हौव्वा को (धोखा देकर) वहाँ से डगमगाया और आख़िर कार उनको जिस (ऐश व राहत) में थे उनसे निकाल फेंका और हमने कहा (ऐ आदम व हौव्वा) तुम (ज़मीन पर) उतर पड़ो तुममें से एक का एक दुशमन होगा और ज़मीन में तुम्हारे लिए एक ख़ास वक्त (क़यामत) तक ठहराव और ठिकाना है
hinglish: But Satan caused them to slip out of it and removed them from that [condition] in which they had been. And We said, "Go down, [all of you], as enemies to one another, and you will have upon the earth a place of settlement and provision for a time."

arabic: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَـٰتٍ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
english: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.
hindi: फिर आदम ने अपने परवरदिगार से (माज़रत के चन्द अल्फाज़) सीखे पस खुदा ने उन अल्फाज़ की बरकत से आदम की तौबा कुबूल कर ली बेशक वह बड़ा माफ़ करने वाला मेहरबान है
hinglish: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

arabic: قُلْنَا ٱهْبِطُوا۟ مِنْهَا جَمِيعًا ۖ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّى هُدًى فَمَن تَبِعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
english: We said, "Go down from it, all of you. And when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
hindi: (और जब आदम को) ये हुक्म दिया था कि यहाँ से उतर पड़ो (तो भी कह दिया था कि) अगर तुम्हारे पास मेरी तरफ़ से हिदायत आए तो (उसकी पैरवी करना क्योंकि) जो लोग मेरी हिदायत पर चलेंगे उन पर (क़यामत) में न कोई ख़ौफ होगा
hinglish: We said, "Go down from it, all of you. And when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
english: And those who disbelieve and deny Our signs - those will be companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally."
hindi: और न वह रंजीदा होगे और (ये भी याद रखो) जिन लोगों ने कुफ्र इख़तेयार किया और हमारी आयतों को झुठलाया तो वही जहन्नुमी हैं और हमेशा दोज़ख़ में पड़े रहेगे
hinglish: And those who disbelieve and deny Our signs - those will be companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally."

arabic: يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتِىَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَأَوْفُوا۟ بِعَهْدِىٓ أُوفِ بِعَهْدِكُمْ وَإِيَّـٰىَ فَٱرْهَبُونِ
english: O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I have bestowed upon you and fulfill My covenant [upon you] that I will fulfill your covenant [from Me], and be afraid of [only] Me.
hindi: ऐ बनी इसराईल (याक़ूब की औलाद) मेरे उन एहसानात को याद करो जो तुम पर पहले कर चुके हैं और तुम मेरे एहद व इक़रार (ईमान) को पूरा करो तो मैं तुम्हारे एहद (सवाब) को पूरा करूँगा, और मुझ ही से डरते रहो
hinglish: O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I have bestowed upon you and fulfill My covenant [upon you] that I will fulfill your covenant [from Me], and be afraid of [only] Me.

arabic: وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِمَآ أَنزَلْتُ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا مَعَكُمْ وَلَا تَكُونُوٓا۟ أَوَّلَ كَافِرٍۭ بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَا تَشْتَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِى ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا وَإِيَّـٰىَ فَٱتَّقُونِ
english: And believe in what I have sent down confirming that which is [already] with you, and be not the first to disbelieve in it. And do not exchange My signs for a small price, and fear [only] Me.
hindi: और जो (कुरान) मैंने नाज़िल किया वह उस किताब (तौरेत) की (भी) तसदीक़ करता हूँ जो तुम्हारे पास है और तुम सबसे चले उसके इन्कार पर मौजूद न हो जाओ और मेरी आयतों के बदले थोड़ी क़ीमत (दुनयावी फायदा) न लो और मुझ ही से डरते रहो
hinglish: And believe in what I have sent down confirming that which is [already] with you, and be not the first to disbelieve in it. And do not exchange My signs for a small price, and fear [only] Me.

arabic: وَلَا تَلْبِسُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
english: And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know [it].
hindi: और हक़ को बातिल के साथ न मिलाओ और हक़ बात को न छिपाओ हालाँकि तुम जानते हो और पाबन्दी से नमाज़ अदा करो
hinglish: And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know [it].

arabic: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱرْكَعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱلرَّٰكِعِينَ
english: And establish prayer and give zakah and bow with those who bow [in worship and obedience].
hindi: और ज़कात दिया करो और जो लोग (हमारे सामने) इबादत के लिए झुकते हैं उनके साथ तुम भी झुका करो
hinglish: And establish prayer and give zakah and bow with those who bow [in worship and obedience].

arabic: أَتَأْمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلْبِرِّ وَتَنسَوْنَ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ تَتْلُونَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
english: Do you order righteousness of the people and forget yourselves while you recite the Scripture? Then will you not reason?
hindi: और तुम लोगों से नेकी करने को कहते हो और अपनी ख़बर नहीं लेते हालाँकि तुम किताबे खुदा को (बराबर) रटा करते हो तो तुम क्या इतना भी नहीं समझते
hinglish: Do you order righteousness of the people and forget yourselves while you recite the Scripture? Then will you not reason?

arabic: وَٱسْتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ۚ وَإِنَّهَا لَكَبِيرَةٌ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلْخَـٰشِعِينَ
english: And seek help through patience and prayer, and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive [to Allah]
hindi: और (मुसीबत के वक्त) सब्र और नमाज़ का सहारा पकड़ो और अलबत्ता नमाज़ दूभर तो है मगर उन ख़ाक़सारों पर (नहीं) जो बख़ूबी जानते हैं
hinglish: And seek help through patience and prayer, and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive [to Allah]

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ رَٰجِعُونَ
english: Who are certain that they will meet their Lord and that they will return to Him.
hindi: कि वह अपने परवरदिगार की बारगाह में हाज़िर होंगे और ज़रूर उसकी तरफ लौट जाएँगे
hinglish: Who are certain that they will meet their Lord and that they will return to Him.

arabic: يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتِىَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَأَنِّى فَضَّلْتُكُمْ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
english: O Children of Israel, remember My favor that I have bestowed upon you and that I preferred you over the worlds.
hindi: ऐ बनी इसराइल मेरी उन नेअमतों को याद करो जो मैंने पहले तुम्हें दी और ये (भी तो सोचो) कि हमने तुमको सारे जहान के लोगों से बढ़ा दिया
hinglish: O Children of Israel, remember My favor that I have bestowed upon you and that I preferred you over the worlds.

arabic: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ يَوْمًا لَّا تَجْزِى نَفْسٌ عَن نَّفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهَا شَفَـٰعَةٌ وَلَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنْهَا عَدْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
english: And fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul at all, nor will intercession be accepted from it, nor will compensation be taken from it, nor will they be aided.
hindi: और उस दिन से डरो (जिस दिन) कोई शख्स किसी की तरफ से न फिदिया हो सकेगा और न उसकी तरफ से कोई सिफारिश मानी जाएगी और न उसका कोई मुआवज़ा लिया जाएगा और न वह मदद पहुँचाए जाएँगे
hinglish: And fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul at all, nor will intercession be accepted from it, nor will compensation be taken from it, nor will they be aided.

arabic: وَإِذْ نَجَّيْنَـٰكُم مِّنْ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ يُذَبِّحُونَ أَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَآءَكُمْ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكُم بَلَآءٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌ
english: And [recall] when We saved your forefathers from the people of Pharaoh, who afflicted you with the worst torment, slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.
hindi: और (उस वक्त क़ो याद करो) जब हमने तुम्हें (तुम्हारे बुर्ज़गो को) फिरऔन (के पन्जे) से छुड़ाया जो तुम्हें बड़े-बड़े दुख दे के सताते थे तुम्हारे लड़कों पर छुरी फेरते थे और तुम्हारी औरतों को (अपनी ख़िदमत के लिए) ज़िन्दा रहने देते थे और उसमें तुम्हारे परवरदिगार की तरफ से (तुम्हारे सब्र की) सख्त आज़माइश थी
hinglish: And [recall] when We saved your forefathers from the people of Pharaoh, who afflicted you with the worst torment, slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.

arabic: وَإِذْ فَرَقْنَا بِكُمُ ٱلْبَحْرَ فَأَنجَيْنَـٰكُمْ وَأَغْرَقْنَآ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَأَنتُمْ تَنظُرُونَ
english: And [recall] when We parted the sea for you and saved you and drowned the people of Pharaoh while you were looking on.
hindi: और (वह वक्त भी याद करो) जब हमने तुम्हारे लिए दरिया को टुकड़े-टुकड़े किया फिर हमने तुमको छुटकारा दिया
hinglish: And [recall] when We parted the sea for you and saved you and drowned the people of Pharaoh while you were looking on.

arabic: وَإِذْ وَٰعَدْنَا مُوسَىٰٓ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً ثُمَّ ٱتَّخَذْتُمُ ٱلْعِجْلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ وَأَنتُمْ ظَـٰلِمُونَ
english: And [recall] when We made an appointment with Moses for forty nights. Then you took [for worship] the calf after him, while you were wrongdoers.
hindi: और फिरऔन के आदमियों को तुम्हारे देखते-देखते डुबो दिया और (वह वक्त भी याद करो) जब हमने मूसा से चालीस रातों का वायदा किया था और तुम लोगों ने उनके जाने के बाद एक बछड़े को (परसतिश के लिए खुदा) बना लिया
hinglish: And [recall] when We made an appointment with Moses for forty nights. Then you took [for worship] the calf after him, while you were wrongdoers.

arabic: ثُمَّ عَفَوْنَا عَنكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
english: Then We forgave you after that so perhaps you would be grateful.
hindi: हालाँकि तुम अपने ऊपर ज़ुल्म जोत रहे थे फिर हमने उसके बाद भी दरगुज़र की ताकि तुम शुक्र करो
hinglish: Then We forgave you after that so perhaps you would be grateful.

arabic: وَإِذْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْفُرْقَانَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
english: And [recall] when We gave Moses the Scripture and criterion that perhaps you would be guided.
hindi: और (वह वक्त भी याद करो) जब मूसा को (तौरेत) अता की और हक़ और बातिल को जुदा करनेवाला क़ानून (इनायत किया) ताके तुम हिदायत पाओ
hinglish: And [recall] when We gave Moses the Scripture and criterion that perhaps you would be guided.

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنَّكُمْ ظَلَمْتُمْ أَنفُسَكُم بِٱتِّخَاذِكُمُ ٱلْعِجْلَ فَتُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ بَارِئِكُمْ فَٱقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ عِندَ بَارِئِكُمْ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
english: And [recall] when Moses said to his people, "O my people, indeed you have wronged yourselves by your taking of the calf [for worship]. So repent to your Creator and kill yourselves. That is best for [all of] you in the sight of your Creator." Then He accepted your repentance; indeed, He is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.
hindi: और (वह वक्त भी याद करो) जब मूसा ने अपनी क़ौम से कहा कि ऐ मेरी क़ौम तुमने बछड़े को (ख़ुदा) बना के अपने ऊपर बड़ा सख्त जुल्म किया तो अब (इसके सिवा कोई चारा नहीं कि) तुम अपने ख़ालिक की बारगाह में तौबा करो और वह ये है कि अपने को क़त्ल कर डालो तुम्हारे परवरदिगार के नज़दीक तुम्हारे हक़ में यही बेहतर है, फिर जब तुमने ऐसा किया तो खुदा ने तुम्हारी तौबा क़ुबूल कर ली बेशक वह बड़ा मेहरबान माफ़ करने वाला है
hinglish: And [recall] when Moses said to his people, "O my people, indeed you have wronged yourselves by your taking of the calf [for worship]. So repent to your Creator and kill yourselves. That is best for [all of] you in the sight of your Creator." Then He accepted your repentance; indeed, He is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

arabic: وَإِذْ قُلْتُمْ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ نَرَى ٱللَّهَ جَهْرَةً فَأَخَذَتْكُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَأَنتُمْ تَنظُرُونَ
english: And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we will never believe you until we see Allah outright"; so the thunderbolt took you while you were looking on.
hindi: और (वह वक्त भी याद करो) जब तुमने मूसा से कहा था कि ऐ मूसा हम तुम पर उस वक्त तक ईमान न लाएँगे जब तक हम खुदा को ज़ाहिर बज़ाहिर न देख ले उस पर तुम्हें बिजली ने ले डाला, और तुम तकते ही रह गए
hinglish: And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we will never believe you until we see Allah outright"; so the thunderbolt took you while you were looking on.

arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَـٰكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَوْتِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
english: Then We revived you after your death that perhaps you would be grateful.
hindi: फिर तुम्हें तुम्हारे मरने के बाद हमने जिला उठाया ताकि तुम शुक्र करो
hinglish: Then We revived you after your death that perhaps you would be grateful.

arabic: وَظَلَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْغَمَامَ وَأَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلْوَىٰ ۖ كُلُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَـٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنَـٰكُمْ ۖ وَمَا ظَلَمُونَا وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
english: And We shaded you with clouds and sent down to you manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not - but they were [only] wronging themselves.
hindi: और हमने तुम पर अब्र का साया किया और तुम पर मन व सलवा उतारा और (ये भी तो कह दिया था कि) जो सुथरी व नफीस रोज़िया तुम्हें दी हैं उन्हें शौक़ से खाओ, और उन लोगों ने हमारा तो कुछ बिगड़ा नहीं मगर अपनी जानों पर सितम ढाते रहे
hinglish: And We shaded you with clouds and sent down to you manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not - but they were [only] wronging themselves.

arabic: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا ٱدْخُلُوا۟ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةَ فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمْ رَغَدًا وَٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْبَابَ سُجَّدًا وَقُولُوا۟ حِطَّةٌ نَّغْفِرْ لَكُمْ خَطَـٰيَـٰكُمْ ۚ وَسَنَزِيدُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
english: And [recall] when We said, "Enter this city and eat from it wherever you will in [ease and] abundance, and enter the gate bowing humbly and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens.' We will [then] forgive your sins for you, and We will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]."
hindi: और (वह वक्त भी याद करो) जब हमने तुमसे कहा कि इस गाँव (अरीहा) में जाओ और इसमें जहाँ चाहो फराग़त से खाओ (पियो) और दरवाज़े पर सजदा करते हुए और ज़बान से हित्ता बख्शिश कहते हुए आओ तो हम तुम्हारी ख़ता ये बख्श देगे और हम नेकी करने वालों की नेकी (सवाब) बढ़ा देगें
hinglish: And [recall] when We said, "Enter this city and eat from it wherever you will in [ease and] abundance, and enter the gate bowing humbly and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens.' We will [then] forgive your sins for you, and We will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]."

arabic: فَبَدَّلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ قَوْلًا غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى قِيلَ لَهُمْ فَأَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ رِجْزًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
english: But those who wronged changed [those words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them, so We sent down upon those who wronged a punishment from the sky because they were defiantly disobeying.
hindi: तो जो बात उनसे कही गई थी उसे शरीरों ने बदलकर दूसरी बात कहनी शुरू कर दी तब हमने उन लोगों पर जिन्होंने शरारत की थी उनकी बदकारी की वजह से आसमानी बला नाज़िल की
hinglish: But those who wronged changed [those words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them, so We sent down upon those who wronged a punishment from the sky because they were defiantly disobeying.

arabic: وَإِذِ ٱسْتَسْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦ فَقُلْنَا ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْحَجَرَ ۖ فَٱنفَجَرَتْ مِنْهُ ٱثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ عَيْنًا ۖ قَدْ عَلِمَ كُلُّ أُنَاسٍ مَّشْرَبَهُمْ ۖ كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
english: And [recall] when Moses prayed for water for his people, so We said, "Strike with your staff the stone." And there gushed forth from it twelve springs, and every people knew its watering place. "Eat and drink from the provision of Allah, and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."
hindi: और (वह वक्त भी याद करो) जब मूसा ने अपनी क़ौम के लिए पानी माँगा तो हमने कहा (ऐ मूसा) अपनी लाठी पत्थर पर मारो (लाठी मारते ही) उसमें से बारह चश्में फूट निकले और सब लोगों ने अपना-अपना घाट बखूबी जान लिया और हमने आम इजाज़त दे दी कि खुदा की दी हुईरोज़ी से खाओ पियो और मुल्क में फसाद न करते फिरो
hinglish: And [recall] when Moses prayed for water for his people, so We said, "Strike with your staff the stone." And there gushed forth from it twelve springs, and every people knew its watering place. "Eat and drink from the provision of Allah, and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."

arabic: وَإِذْ قُلْتُمْ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ لَن نَّصْبِرَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامٍ وَٰحِدٍ فَٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُخْرِجْ لَنَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنۢ بَقْلِهَا وَقِثَّآئِهَا وَفُومِهَا وَعَدَسِهَا وَبَصَلِهَا ۖ قَالَ أَتَسْتَبْدِلُونَ ٱلَّذِى هُوَ أَدْنَىٰ بِٱلَّذِى هُوَ خَيْرٌ ۚ ٱهْبِطُوا۟ مِصْرًا فَإِنَّ لَكُم مَّا سَأَلْتُمْ ۗ وَضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلذِّلَّةُ وَٱلْمَسْكَنَةُ وَبَآءُو بِغَضَبٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ ۗ ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوا۟ وَّكَانُوا۟ يَعْتَدُونَ
english: And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we can never endure one [kind of] food. So call upon your Lord to bring forth for us from the earth its green herbs and its cucumbers and its garlic and its lentils and its onions." [Moses] said, "Would you exchange what is better for what is less? Go into [any] settlement and indeed, you will have what you have asked." And they were covered with humiliation and poverty and returned with anger from Allah [upon them]. That was because they [repeatedly] disbelieved in the signs of Allah and killed the prophets without right. That was because they disobeyed and were [habitually] transgressing.
hindi: (और वह वक्त भी याद करो) जब तुमने मूसा से कहा कि ऐ मूसा हमसे एक ही खाने पर न रहा जाएगा तो आप हमारे लिए अपने परवरदिगार से दुआ कीजिए कि जो चीज़े ज़मीन से उगती है जैसे साग पात तरकारी और ककड़ी और गेहूँ या (लहसुन) और मसूर और प्याज़ (मन व सलवा) की जगह पैदा करें (मूसा ने) कहा क्या तुम ऐसी चीज़ को जो हर तरह से बेहतर है अदना चीज़ से बदलन चाहते हो तो किसी शहर में उतर पड़ो फिर तुम्हारे लिए जो तुमने माँगा है सब मौजूद है और उन पर रूसवाई और मोहताजी की मार पड़ी और उन लोगों ने क़हरे खुदा की तरफ पलटा खाया, ये सब इस सबब से हुआ कि वह लोग खुदा की निशानियों से इन्कार करते थे और पैग़म्बरों को नाहक शहीद करते थे, और इस वजह से (भी) कि वह नाफ़रमानी और सरकशी किया करते थे
hinglish: And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we can never endure one [kind of] food. So call upon your Lord to bring forth for us from the earth its green herbs and its cucumbers and its garlic and its lentils and its onions." [Moses] said, "Would you exchange what is better for what is less? Go into [any] settlement and indeed, you will have what you have asked." And they were covered with humiliation and poverty and returned with anger from Allah [upon them]. That was because they [repeatedly] disbelieved in the signs of Allah and killed the prophets without right. That was because they disobeyed and were [habitually] transgressing.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلنَّصَـٰرَىٰ وَٱلصَّـٰبِـِٔينَ مَنْ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَلَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
english: Indeed, those who believed and those who were Jews or Christians or Sabeans [before Prophet Muhammad] - those [among them] who believed in Allah and the Last Day and did righteousness - will have their reward with their Lord, and no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve.
hindi: बेशक मुसलमानों और यहूदियों और नसरानियों और ला मज़हबों में से जो कोई खुदा और रोज़े आख़िरत पर ईमान लाए और अच्छे-अच्छे काम करता रहे तो उन्हीं के लिए उनका अज्र व सवाब उनके खुदा के पास है और न (क़यामत में) उन पर किसी का ख़ौफ होगा न वह रंजीदा दिल होंगे
hinglish: Indeed, those who believed and those who were Jews or Christians or Sabeans [before Prophet Muhammad] - those [among them] who believed in Allah and the Last Day and did righteousness - will have their reward with their Lord, and no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve.

arabic: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَـٰقَكُمْ وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَكُمُ ٱلطُّورَ خُذُوا۟ مَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكُم بِقُوَّةٍ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ مَا فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
english: And [recall] when We took your covenant, [O Children of Israel, to abide by the Torah] and We raised over you the mount, [saying], "Take what We have given you with determination and remember what is in it that perhaps you may become righteous."
hindi: और (वह वक्त याद करो) जब हमने (तामीले तौरेत) का तुमसे एक़रार कर लिया और हमने तुम्हारे सर पर तूर से (पहाड़ को) लाकर लटकाया और कह दिया कि तौरेत जो हमने तुमको दी है उसको मज़बूत पकड़े रहो और जो कुछ उसमें है उसको याद रखो
hinglish: And [recall] when We took your covenant, [O Children of Israel, to abide by the Torah] and We raised over you the mount, [saying], "Take what We have given you with determination and remember what is in it that perhaps you may become righteous."

arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّيْتُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ فَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ لَكُنتُم مِّنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
english: Then you turned away after that. And if not for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy, you would have been among the losers.
hindi: ताकि तुम परहेज़गार बनो फिर उसके बाद तुम (अपने एहदो पैमान से) फिर गए पस अगर तुम पर खुदा का फज़ल और उसकी मेहरबानी न होती तो तुमने सख्त घाटा उठाया होता
hinglish: Then you turned away after that. And if not for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy, you would have been among the losers.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
english: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised."
hindi: और अपनी क़ौम से उन लोगों की हालत तो तुम बखूबी जानते हो जो शम्बे (सनीचर) के दिन अपनी हद से गुज़र गए (कि बावजूद मुमानिअत शिकार खेलने निकले) तो हमने उन से कहा कि तुम राइन्दे गए बन्दर बन जाओ (और वह बन्दर हो गए)
hinglish: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised."

arabic: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا نَكَـٰلًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا وَمَا خَلْفَهَا وَمَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
english: And We made it a deterrent punishment for those who were present and those who succeeded [them] and a lesson for those who fear Allah.
hindi: पस हमने इस वाक़ये से उन लोगों के वास्ते जिन के सामने हुआ था और जो उसके बाद आनेवाले थे अज़ाब क़रार दिया, और परहेज़गारों के लिए नसीहत
hinglish: And We made it a deterrent punishment for those who were present and those who succeeded [them] and a lesson for those who fear Allah.

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَن تَذْبَحُوا۟ بَقَرَةً ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَتَّخِذُنَا هُزُوًا ۖ قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِٱللَّهِ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِينَ
english: And [recall] when Moses said to his people, "Indeed, Allah commands you to slaughter a cow." They said, "Do you take us in ridicule?" He said, "I seek refuge in Allah from being among the ignorant."
hindi: और (वह वक्त याद करो) जब मूसा ने अपनी क़ौम से कहा कि खुदा तुम लोगों को ताकीदी हुक्म करता है कि तुम एक गाय ज़िबाह करो वह लोग कहने लगे क्या तुम हमसे दिल्लगी करते हो मूसा ने कहा मैं खुदा से पनाह माँगता हूँ कि मैं जाहिल बनूँ
hinglish: And [recall] when Moses said to his people, "Indeed, Allah commands you to slaughter a cow." They said, "Do you take us in ridicule?" He said, "I seek refuge in Allah from being among the ignorant."

arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِىَ ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ لَّا فَارِضٌ وَلَا بِكْرٌ عَوَانٌۢ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ فَٱفْعَلُوا۟ مَا تُؤْمَرُونَ
english: They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is." [Moses] said, "[Allah] says, 'It is a cow which is neither old nor virgin, but median between that,' so do what you are commanded."
hindi: (तब वह लोग कहने लगे कि (अच्छा) तुम अपने खुदा से दुआ करो कि हमें बता दे कि वह गाय कैसी हो मूसा ने कहा बेशक खुदा ने फरमाता है कि वह गाय न तो बहुत बूढ़ी हो और न बछिया बल्कि उनमें से औसत दरजे की हो, ग़रज़ जो तुमको हुक्म दिया गया उसको बजा लाओ
hinglish: They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is." [Moses] said, "[Allah] says, 'It is a cow which is neither old nor virgin, but median between that,' so do what you are commanded."

arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا لَوْنُهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ صَفْرَآءُ فَاقِعٌ لَّوْنُهَا تَسُرُّ ٱلنَّـٰظِرِينَ
english: They said, "Call upon your Lord to show us what is her color." He said, "He says, 'It is a yellow cow, bright in color - pleasing to the observers.' "
hindi: वह कहने लगे (वाह) तुम अपने खुदा से दुआ करो कि हमें ये बता दे कि उसका रंग आख़िर क्या हो मूसा ने कहा बेशक खुदा फरमाता है कि वह गाय खूब गहरे ज़र्द रंग की हो देखने वाले उसे देखकर खुश हो जाए
hinglish: They said, "Call upon your Lord to show us what is her color." He said, "He says, 'It is a yellow cow, bright in color - pleasing to the observers.' "

arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِىَ إِنَّ ٱلْبَقَرَ تَشَـٰبَهَ عَلَيْنَا وَإِنَّآ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَمُهْتَدُونَ
english: They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is. Indeed, [all] cows look alike to us. And indeed we, if Allah wills, will be guided."
hindi: तब कहने लगे कि तुम अपने खुदा से दुआ करो कि हमें ज़रा ये तो बता दे कि वह (गाय) और कैसी हो (वह) गाय तो और गायों में मिल जुल गई और खुदा ने चाहा तो हम ज़रूर (उसका) पता लगा लेगे
hinglish: They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is. Indeed, [all] cows look alike to us. And indeed we, if Allah wills, will be guided."

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ لَّا ذَلُولٌ تُثِيرُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَا تَسْقِى ٱلْحَرْثَ مُسَلَّمَةٌ لَّا شِيَةَ فِيهَا ۚ قَالُوا۟ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ جِئْتَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ فَذَبَحُوهَا وَمَا كَادُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
english: He said, "He says, 'It is a cow neither trained to plow the earth nor to irrigate the field, one free from fault with no spot upon her.' " They said, "Now you have come with the truth." So they slaughtered her, but they could hardly do it.
hindi: मूसा ने कहा खुदा ज़रूर फरमाता है कि वह गाय न तो इतनी सधाई हो कि ज़मीन जोते न खेती सीचें भली चंगी एक रंग की कि उसमें कोई धब्बा तक न हो, वह बोले अब (जा के) ठीक-ठीक बयान किया, ग़रज़ उन लोगों ने वह गाय हलाल की हालाँकि उनसे उम्मीद न थी वह कि वह ऐसा करेंगे
hinglish: He said, "He says, 'It is a cow neither trained to plow the earth nor to irrigate the field, one free from fault with no spot upon her.' " They said, "Now you have come with the truth." So they slaughtered her, but they could hardly do it.

arabic: وَإِذْ قَتَلْتُمْ نَفْسًا فَٱدَّٰرَْٰٔتُمْ فِيهَا ۖ وَٱللَّهُ مُخْرِجٌ مَّا كُنتُمْ تَكْتُمُونَ
english: And [recall] when you slew a man and disputed over it, but Allah was to bring out that which you were concealing.
hindi: और जब एक शख्स को मार डाला और तुममें उसकी बाबत फूट पड़ गई एक दूसरे को क़ातिल बताने लगा जो तुम छिपाते थे
hinglish: And [recall] when you slew a man and disputed over it, but Allah was to bring out that which you were concealing.

arabic: فَقُلْنَا ٱضْرِبُوهُ بِبَعْضِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُحْىِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
english: So, We said, "Strike the slain man with part of it." Thus does Allah bring the dead to life, and He shows you His signs that you might reason.
hindi: खुदा को उसका ज़ाहिर करना मंजूर था पस हमने कहा कि उस गाय को कोई टुकड़ा लेकर इस (की लाश) पर मारो यूँ खुदा मुर्दे को ज़िन्दा करता है और तुम को अपनी कुदरत की निशानियाँ दिखा देता है
hinglish: So, We said, "Strike the slain man with part of it." Thus does Allah bring the dead to life, and He shows you His signs that you might reason.

arabic: ثُمَّ قَسَتْ قُلُوبُكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَهِىَ كَٱلْحِجَارَةِ أَوْ أَشَدُّ قَسْوَةً ۚ وَإِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْحِجَارَةِ لَمَا يَتَفَجَّرُ مِنْهُ ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ وَإِنَّ مِنْهَا لَمَا يَشَّقَّقُ فَيَخْرُجُ مِنْهُ ٱلْمَآءُ ۚ وَإِنَّ مِنْهَا لَمَا يَهْبِطُ مِنْ خَشْيَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَـٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
english: Then your hearts became hardened after that, being like stones or even harder. For indeed, there are stones from which rivers burst forth, and there are some of them that split open and water comes out, and there are some of them that fall down for fear of Allah. And Allah is not unaware of what you do.
hindi: ताकि तुम समझो फिर उसके बाद तुम्हारे दिल सख्त हो गये पस वह मिसल पत्थर के (सख्त) थे या उससे भी ज्यादा करख्त क्योंकि पत्थरों में बाज़ तो ऐसे होते हैं कि उनसे नहरें जारी हो जाती हैं और बाज़ ऐसे होते हैं कि उनमें दरार पड़ जाती है और उनमें से पानी निकल पड़ता है और बाज़ पत्थर तो ऐसे होते हैं कि खुदा के ख़ौफ से गिर पड़ते हैं और जो कुछ तुम कर रहे हो उससे खुदा ग़ाफिल नहीं है
hinglish: Then your hearts became hardened after that, being like stones or even harder. For indeed, there are stones from which rivers burst forth, and there are some of them that split open and water comes out, and there are some of them that fall down for fear of Allah. And Allah is not unaware of what you do.

arabic: أَفَتَطْمَعُونَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ لَكُمْ وَقَدْ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ كَلَـٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُحَرِّفُونَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا عَقَلُوهُ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
english: Do you covet [the hope, O believers], that they would believe for you while a party of them used to hear the words of Allah and then distort the Torah after they had understood it while they were knowing?
hindi: (मुसलमानों) क्या तुम ये लालच रखते हो कि वह तुम्हारा (सा) ईमान लाएँगें हालाँकि उनमें का एक गिरोह (साबिक़ में) ऐसा था कि खुदा का कलाम सुनाता था और अच्छी तरह समझने के बाद उलट फेर कर देता था हालाँकि वह खूब जानते थे और जब उन लोगों से मुलाक़ात करते हैं
hinglish: Do you covet [the hope, O believers], that they would believe for you while a party of them used to hear the words of Allah and then distort the Torah after they had understood it while they were knowing?

arabic: وَإِذَا لَقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ قَالُوٓا۟ أَتُحَدِّثُونَهُم بِمَا فَتَحَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ لِيُحَآجُّوكُم بِهِۦ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
english: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We have believed"; but when they are alone with one another, they say, "Do you talk to them about what Allah has revealed to you so they can argue with you about it before your Lord?" Then will you not reason?
hindi: जो ईमान लाए तो कह देते हैं कि हम तो ईमान ला चुके और जब उनसे बाज़-बाज़ के साथ तख़िलया करते हैं तो कहते हैं कि जो कुछ खुदा ने तुम पर (तौरेत) में ज़ाहिर कर दिया है क्या तुम (मुसलमानों को) बता दोगे ताकि उसके सबब से कल तुम्हारे खुदा के पास तुम पर हुज्जत लाएँ क्या तुम इतना भी नहीं समझते
hinglish: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We have believed"; but when they are alone with one another, they say, "Do you talk to them about what Allah has revealed to you so they can argue with you about it before your Lord?" Then will you not reason?

arabic: أَوَلَا يَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
english: But do they not know that Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare?
hindi: लेकिन क्या वह लोग (इतना भी) नहीं जानते कि वह लोग जो कुछ छिपाते हैं या ज़ाहिर करते हैं खुदा सब कुछ जानता है
hinglish: But do they not know that Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare?

arabic: وَمِنْهُمْ أُمِّيُّونَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّآ أَمَانِىَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ
english: And among them are unlettered ones who do not know the Scripture except in wishful thinking, but they are only assuming.
hindi: और कुछ उनमें से ऐसे अनपढ़ हैं कि वह किताबे खुदा को अपने मतलब की बातों के सिवा कुछ नहीं समझते और वह फक़त ख्याली बातें किया करते हैं,
hinglish: And among them are unlettered ones who do not know the Scripture except in wishful thinking, but they are only assuming.

arabic: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يَكْتُبُونَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ ثُمَّ يَقُولُونَ هَـٰذَا مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ لِيَشْتَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا ۖ فَوَيْلٌ لَّهُم مِّمَّا كَتَبَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَوَيْلٌ لَّهُم مِّمَّا يَكْسِبُونَ
english: So woe to those who write the "scripture" with their own hands, then say, "This is from Allah," in order to exchange it for a small price. Woe to them for what their hands have written and woe to them for what they earn.
hindi: पस वाए हो उन लोगों पर जो अपने हाथ से किताब लिखते हैं फिर (लोगों से कहते फिरते) हैं कि ये खुदा के यहाँ से (आई) है ताकि उसके ज़रिये से थोड़ी सी क़ीमत (दुनयावी फ़ायदा) हासिल करें पस अफसोस है उन पर कि उनके हाथों ने लिखा और फिर अफसोस है उनपर कि वह ऐसी कमाई करते हैं
hinglish: So woe to those who write the "scripture" with their own hands, then say, "This is from Allah," in order to exchange it for a small price. Woe to them for what their hands have written and woe to them for what they earn.

arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَن تَمَسَّنَا ٱلنَّارُ إِلَّآ أَيَّامًا مَّعْدُودَةً ۚ قُلْ أَتَّخَذْتُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَهْدًا فَلَن يُخْلِفَ ٱللَّهُ عَهْدَهُۥٓ ۖ أَمْ تَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
english: And they say, "Never will the Fire touch us, except for a few days." Say, "Have you taken a covenant with Allah? For Allah will never break His covenant. Or do you say about Allah that which you do not know?"
hindi: और कहते हैं कि गिनती के चन्द दिनों के सिवा हमें आग छुएगी भी तो नहीं (ऐ रसूल) इन लोगों से कहो कि क्या तुमने खुदा से कोई इक़रार ले लिया है कि फिर वह किसी तरह अपने इक़रार के ख़िलाफ़ हरगिज़ न करेगा या बे समझे बूझे खुदा पर बोहताव जोड़ते हो
hinglish: And they say, "Never will the Fire touch us, except for a few days." Say, "Have you taken a covenant with Allah? For Allah will never break His covenant. Or do you say about Allah that which you do not know?"

arabic: بَلَىٰ مَن كَسَبَ سَيِّئَةً وَأَحَـٰطَتْ بِهِۦ خَطِيٓـَٔتُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
english: Yes, whoever earns evil and his sin has encompassed him - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.
hindi: हाँ (सच तो यह है) कि जिसने बुराई हासिल की और उसके गुनाहों ने चारों तरफ से उसे घेर लिया है वही लोग तो दोज़ख़ी हैं और वही (तो) उसमें हमेशा रहेंगे
hinglish: Yes, whoever earns evil and his sin has encompassed him - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
english: But they who believe and do righteous deeds - those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally.
hindi: और जो लोग ईमानदार हैं और उन्होंने अच्छे काम किए हैं वही लोग जन्नती हैं कि हमेशा जन्नत में रहेंगे
hinglish: But they who believe and do righteous deeds - those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally.

arabic: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَـٰقَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ لَا تَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا وَذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَـٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَـٰكِينِ وَقُولُوا۟ لِلنَّاسِ حُسْنًا وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّنكُمْ وَأَنتُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
english: And [recall] when We took the covenant from the Children of Israel, [enjoining upon them], "Do not worship except Allah; and to parents do good and to relatives, orphans, and the needy. And speak to people good [words] and establish prayer and give zakah." Then you turned away, except a few of you, and you were refusing.
hindi: और (वह वक्त याद करो) जब हमने बनी ईसराइल से (जो तुम्हारे बुर्जुग़ थे) अहद व पैमान लिया था कि खुदा के सिवा किसी की इबादत न करना और माँ बाप और क़राबतदारों और यतीमों और मोहताजों के साथ अच्छे सुलूक करना और लोगों के साथ अच्छी तरह (नरमी) से बातें करना और बराबर नमाज़ पढ़ना और ज़कात देना फिर तुममें से थोड़े आदिमियों के सिवा (सब के सब) फिर गए और तुम लोग हो ही इक़रार से मुँह फेरने वाले
hinglish: And [recall] when We took the covenant from the Children of Israel, [enjoining upon them], "Do not worship except Allah; and to parents do good and to relatives, orphans, and the needy. And speak to people good [words] and establish prayer and give zakah." Then you turned away, except a few of you, and you were refusing.

arabic: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَـٰقَكُمْ لَا تَسْفِكُونَ دِمَآءَكُمْ وَلَا تُخْرِجُونَ أَنفُسَكُم مِّن دِيَـٰرِكُمْ ثُمَّ أَقْرَرْتُمْ وَأَنتُمْ تَشْهَدُونَ
english: And [recall] when We took your covenant, [saying], "Do not shed each other's blood or evict one another from your homes." Then you acknowledged [this] while you were witnessing.
hindi: और (वह वक्त याद करो) जब हमने तुम (तुम्हारे बुर्ज़ुगों) से अहद लिया था कि आपस में खूरेज़ियाँ न करना और न अपने लोगों को शहर बदर करना तो तुम (तुम्हारे बुर्जुग़ों) ने इक़रार किया था और तुम भी उसकी गवाही देते हो
hinglish: And [recall] when We took your covenant, [saying], "Do not shed each other's blood or evict one another from your homes." Then you acknowledged [this] while you were witnessing.

arabic: ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ تَقْتُلُونَ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَتُخْرِجُونَ فَرِيقًا مِّنكُم مِّن دِيَـٰرِهِمْ تَظَـٰهَرُونَ عَلَيْهِم بِٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ وَإِن يَأْتُوكُمْ أُسَـٰرَىٰ تُفَـٰدُوهُمْ وَهُوَ مُحَرَّمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ إِخْرَاجُهُمْ ۚ أَفَتُؤْمِنُونَ بِبَعْضِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَتَكْفُرُونَ بِبَعْضٍ ۚ فَمَا جَزَآءُ مَن يَفْعَلُ ذَٰلِكَ مِنكُمْ إِلَّا خِزْىٌ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ يُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَشَدِّ ٱلْعَذَابِ ۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَـٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
english: Then, you are those [same ones who are] killing one another and evicting a party of your people from their homes, cooperating against them in sin and aggression. And if they come to you as captives, you ransom them, although their eviction was forbidden to you. So do you believe in part of the Scripture and disbelieve in part? Then what is the recompense for those who do that among you except disgrace in worldly life; and on the Day of Resurrection they will be sent back to the severest of punishment. And Allah is not unaware of what you do.
hindi: (कि हाँ ऐसा हुआ था) फिर वही लोग तो तुम हो कि आपस में एक दूसरे को क़त्ल करते हो और अपनों से एक जत्थे के नाहक़ और ज़बरदस्ती हिमायती बनकर दूसरे को शहर बदर करते हो (और लुत्फ़ तो ये है कि) अगर वही लोग क़ैदी बनकर तम्हारे पास (मदद माँगने) आए तो उनको तावान देकर छुड़ा लेते हो हालाँकि उनका निकालना ही तुम पर हराम किया गया था तो फिर क्या तुम (किताबे खुदा की) बाज़ बातों पर ईमान रखते हो और बाज़ से इन्कार करते हो पस तुम में से जो लोग ऐसा करें उनकी सज़ा इसके सिवा और कुछ नहीं कि ज़िन्दगी भर की रूसवाई हो और (आख़िरकार) क़यामत के दिन सख्त अज़ाब की तरफ लौटा दिये जाए और जो कुछ तुम लोग करते हो खुदा उससे ग़ाफ़िल नहीं है
hinglish: Then, you are those [same ones who are] killing one another and evicting a party of your people from their homes, cooperating against them in sin and aggression. And if they come to you as captives, you ransom them, although their eviction was forbidden to you. So do you believe in part of the Scripture and disbelieve in part? Then what is the recompense for those who do that among you except disgrace in worldly life; and on the Day of Resurrection they will be sent back to the severest of punishment. And Allah is not unaware of what you do.

arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۖ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
english: Those are the ones who have bought the life of this world [in exchange] for the Hereafter, so the punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be aided.
hindi: यही वह लोग हैं जिन्होंने आख़ेरत के बदले दुनिया की ज़िन्दगी ख़रीद पस न उनके अज़ाब ही में तख्फ़ीफ़ (कमी) की जाएगी और न वह लोग किसी तरह की मदद दिए जाएँगे
hinglish: Those are the ones who have bought the life of this world [in exchange] for the Hereafter, so the punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be aided.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَقَفَّيْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ بِٱلرُّسُلِ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَا عِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ ٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَأَيَّدْنَـٰهُ بِرُوحِ ٱلْقُدُسِ ۗ أَفَكُلَّمَا جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولٌۢ بِمَا لَا تَهْوَىٰٓ أَنفُسُكُمُ ٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ فَفَرِيقًا كَذَّبْتُمْ وَفَرِيقًا تَقْتُلُونَ
english: And We did certainly give Moses the Torah and followed up after him with messengers. And We gave Jesus, the son of Mary, clear proofs and supported him with the Pure Spirit. But is it [not] that every time a messenger came to you, [O Children of Israel], with what your souls did not desire, you were arrogant? And a party [of messengers] you denied and another party you killed.
hindi: और ये हक़ीक़ी बात है कि हमने मूसा को किताब (तौरेत) दी और उनके बाद बहुत से पैग़म्बरों को उनके क़दम ब क़दम ले चलें और मरियम के बेटे ईसा को (भी बहुत से) वाजेए व रौशन मौजिजे दिए और पाक रूह जिबरील के ज़रिये से उनकी मदद की क्या तुम उस क़दर बददिमाग़ हो गए हो कि जब कोई पैग़म्बर तुम्हारे पास तुम्हारी ख्वाहिशे नफ़सानी के ख़िलाफ कोई हुक्म लेकर आया तो तुम अकड़ बैठे फिर तुमने बाज़ पैग़म्बरों को तो झुठलाया और बाज़ को जान से मार डाला
hinglish: And We did certainly give Moses the Torah and followed up after him with messengers. And We gave Jesus, the son of Mary, clear proofs and supported him with the Pure Spirit. But is it [not] that every time a messenger came to you, [O Children of Israel], with what your souls did not desire, you were arrogant? And a party [of messengers] you denied and another party you killed.

arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ قُلُوبُنَا غُلْفٌۢ ۚ بَل لَّعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِكُفْرِهِمْ فَقَلِيلًا مَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
english: And they said, "Our hearts are wrapped." But, [in fact], Allah has cursed them for their disbelief, so little is it that they believe.
hindi: और कहने लगे कि हमारे दिलों पर ग़िलाफ चढ़ा हुआ है (ऐसा नहीं) बल्कि उनके कुफ्र की वजह से खुदा ने उनपर लानत की है पस कम ही लोग ईमान लाते हैं
hinglish: And they said, "Our hearts are wrapped." But, [in fact], Allah has cursed them for their disbelief, so little is it that they believe.

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ كِتَـٰبٌ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ وَكَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ يَسْتَفْتِحُونَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم مَّا عَرَفُوا۟ كَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ فَلَعْنَةُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
english: And when there came to them a Book from Allah confirming that which was with them - although before they used to pray for victory against those who disbelieved - but [then] when there came to them that which they recognized, they disbelieved in it; so the curse of Allah will be upon the disbelievers.
hindi: और जब उनके पास खुदा की तरफ़ से किताब (कुरान आई और वह उस किताब तौरेत) की जो उन के पास तसदीक़ भी करती है। और उससे पहले (इसकी उम्मीद पर) काफ़िरों पर फतेहयाब होने की दुआएँ माँगते थे पस जब उनके पास वह चीज़ जिसे पहचानते थे आ गई तो लगे इन्कार करने पस काफ़िरों पर खुदा की लानत है
hinglish: And when there came to them a Book from Allah confirming that which was with them - although before they used to pray for victory against those who disbelieved - but [then] when there came to them that which they recognized, they disbelieved in it; so the curse of Allah will be upon the disbelievers.

arabic: بِئْسَمَا ٱشْتَرَوْا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَنفُسَهُمْ أَن يَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بَغْيًا أَن يُنَزِّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ ۖ فَبَآءُو بِغَضَبٍ عَلَىٰ غَضَبٍ ۚ وَلِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
english: How wretched is that for which they sold themselves - that they would disbelieve in what Allah has revealed through [their] outrage that Allah would send down His favor upon whom He wills from among His servants. So they returned having [earned] wrath upon wrath. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment.
hindi: क्या ही बुरा है वह काम जिसके मुक़ाबले में (इतनी बात पर) वह लोग अपनी जानें बेच बैठे हैं कि खुदा अपने बन्दों से जिस पर चाहे अपनी इनायत से किताब नाज़िल किया करे इस रश्क से जो कुछ खुदा ने नाज़िल किया है सबका इन्कार कर बैठे पस उन पर ग़ज़ब पर ग़ज़ब टूट पड़ा और काफ़िरों के लिए (बड़ी) रूसवाई का अज़ाब है
hinglish: How wretched is that for which they sold themselves - that they would disbelieve in what Allah has revealed through [their] outrage that Allah would send down His favor upon whom He wills from among His servants. So they returned having [earned] wrath upon wrath. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment.

arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ قَالُوا۟ نُؤْمِنُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا وَيَكْفُرُونَ بِمَا وَرَآءَهُۥ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ ۗ قُلْ فَلِمَ تَقْتُلُونَ أَنۢبِيَآءَ ٱللَّهِ مِن قَبْلُ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
english: And when it is said to them, "Believe in what Allah has revealed," they say, "We believe [only] in what was revealed to us." And they disbelieve in what came after it, while it is the truth confirming that which is with them. Say, "Then why did you kill the prophets of Allah before, if you are [indeed] believers?"
hindi: और जब उनसे कहा गया कि (जो क़ुरान) खुदा ने नाज़िल किया है उस पर ईमान लाओ तो कहने लगे कि हम तो उसी किताब (तौरेत) पर ईमान लाए हैं जो हम पर नाज़िल की गई थी और उस किताब (कुरान) को जो उसके बाद आई है नहीं मानते हैं हालाँकि वह (क़ुरान) हक़ है और उस किताब (तौरेत) की जो उनके पास है तसदीक़ भी करती है मगर उस किताब कुरान का जो उसके बाद आई है इन्कार करते हैं (ऐ रसूल) उनसे ये तो पूछो कि तुम (तुम्हारे बुर्जुग़) अगर ईमानदार थे तो फिर क्यों खुदा के पैग़म्बरों का साबिक़ क़त्ल करते थे
hinglish: And when it is said to them, "Believe in what Allah has revealed," they say, "We believe [only] in what was revealed to us." And they disbelieve in what came after it, while it is the truth confirming that which is with them. Say, "Then why did you kill the prophets of Allah before, if you are [indeed] believers?"

arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ ٱتَّخَذْتُمُ ٱلْعِجْلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ وَأَنتُمْ ظَـٰلِمُونَ
english: And Moses had certainly brought you clear proofs. Then you took the calf [in worship] after that, while you were wrongdoers.
hindi: और तुम्हारे पास मूसा तो वाज़ेए व रौशन मौजिज़े लेकर आ ही चुके थे फिर भी तुमने उनके बाद बछड़े को खुदा बना ही लिया और उससे तुम अपने ही ऊपर ज़ुल्म करने वाले थे
hinglish: And Moses had certainly brought you clear proofs. Then you took the calf [in worship] after that, while you were wrongdoers.

arabic: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَـٰقَكُمْ وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَكُمُ ٱلطُّورَ خُذُوا۟ مَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكُم بِقُوَّةٍ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ ۖ قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَعَصَيْنَا وَأُشْرِبُوا۟ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلْعِجْلَ بِكُفْرِهِمْ ۚ قُلْ بِئْسَمَا يَأْمُرُكُم بِهِۦٓ إِيمَـٰنُكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
english: And [recall] when We took your covenant and raised over you the mount, [saying], "Take what We have given you with determination and listen." They said [instead], "We hear and disobey." And their hearts absorbed [the worship of] the calf because of their disbelief. Say, "How wretched is that which your faith enjoins upon you, if you should be believers."
hindi: और (वह वक्त याद करो) जब हमने तुमसे अहद लिया और (क़ोहे) तूर को (तुम्हारी उदूले हुक्मी से) तुम्हारे सर पर लटकाया और (हमने कहा कि ये किताब तौरेत) जो हमने दी है मज़बूती से लिए रहो और (जो कुछ उसमें है) सुनो तो कहने लगे सुना तो (सही लेकिन) हम इसको मानते नहीं और उनकी बेईमानी की वजह से (गोया) बछड़े की उलफ़त घोल के उनके दिलों में पिला दी गई (ऐ रसूल) उन लोगों से कह दो कि अगर तुम ईमानदार थे तो तुमको तुम्हारा ईमान क्या ही बुरा हुक्म करता था
hinglish: And [recall] when We took your covenant and raised over you the mount, [saying], "Take what We have given you with determination and listen." They said [instead], "We hear and disobey." And their hearts absorbed [the worship of] the calf because of their disbelief. Say, "How wretched is that which your faith enjoins upon you, if you should be believers."

arabic: قُلْ إِن كَانَتْ لَكُمُ ٱلدَّارُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَالِصَةً مِّن دُونِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُا۟ ٱلْمَوْتَ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
english: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the home of the Hereafter with Allah is for you alone and not the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful.
hindi: (ऐ रसूल) इन लोगों से कह दो कि अगर खुदा के नज़दीक आख़ेरत का घर (बेहिश्त) ख़ास तुम्हारे वास्ते है और लोगों के वासते नहीं है पस अगर तुम सच्चे हो तो मौत की आरजू क़रो
hinglish: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the home of the Hereafter with Allah is for you alone and not the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful.

arabic: وَلَن يَتَمَنَّوْهُ أَبَدًۢا بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
english: But they will never wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allah is Knowing of the wrongdoers.
hindi: (ताकि जल्दी बेहिश्त में जाओ) लेकिन वह उन आमाले बद की वजह से जिनको उनके हाथों ने पहले से आगे भेजा है हरगिज़ मौत की आरज़ू न करेंगे और खुदा ज़ालिमों से खूब वाक़िफ है
hinglish: But they will never wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allah is Knowing of the wrongdoers.

arabic: وَلَتَجِدَنَّهُمْ أَحْرَصَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ حَيَوٰةٍ وَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ ۚ يَوَدُّ أَحَدُهُمْ لَوْ يُعَمَّرُ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ وَمَا هُوَ بِمُزَحْزِحِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ أَن يُعَمَّرَ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ
english: And you will surely find them the most greedy of people for life - [even] more than those who associate others with Allah. One of them wishes that he could be granted life a thousand years, but it would not remove him in the least from the [coming] punishment that he should be granted life. And Allah is Seeing of what they do.
hindi: और (ऐ रसूल) तुम उन ही को ज़िन्दगी का सबसे ज्यादा हरीस पाओगे और मुशरिक़ों में से हर एक शख्स चाहता है कि काश उसको हज़ार बरस की उम्र दी जाती हालाँकि अगर इतनी तूलानी उम्र भी दी जाए तो वह ख़ुदा के अज़ाब से छुटकारा देने वाली नहीं, और जो कुछ वह लोग करते हैं खुदा उसे देख रहा है
hinglish: And you will surely find them the most greedy of people for life - [even] more than those who associate others with Allah. One of them wishes that he could be granted life a thousand years, but it would not remove him in the least from the [coming] punishment that he should be granted life. And Allah is Seeing of what they do.

arabic: قُلْ مَن كَانَ عَدُوًّا لِّجِبْرِيلَ فَإِنَّهُۥ نَزَّلَهُۥ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَهُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
english: Say, "Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel - it is [none but] he who has brought the Qur'an down upon your heart, [O Muhammad], by permission of Allah, confirming that which was before it and as guidance and good tidings for the believers."
hindi: (ऐ रसूल उन लोगों से) कह दो कि जो जिबरील का दुशमन है (उसका खुदा दुशमन है) क्योंकि उस फ़रिश्ते ने खुदा के हुक्म से (इस कुरान को) तुम्हारे दिल पर डाला है और वह उन किताबों की भी तसदीक करता है जो (पहले नाज़िल हो चुकी हैं और सब) उसके सामने मौजूद हैं और ईमानदारों के वास्ते खुशख़बरी है
hinglish: Say, "Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel - it is [none but] he who has brought the Qur'an down upon your heart, [O Muhammad], by permission of Allah, confirming that which was before it and as guidance and good tidings for the believers."

arabic: مَن كَانَ عَدُوًّا لِّلَّهِ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَجِبْرِيلَ وَمِيكَىٰلَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَدُوٌّ لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
english: Whoever is an enemy to Allah and His angels and His messengers and Gabriel and Michael - then indeed, Allah is an enemy to the disbelievers.
hindi: जो शख्स ख़ुदा और उसके फरिश्तों और उसके रसूलों और (ख़ासकर) जिबराईल व मीकाइल का दुशमन हो तो बेशक खुदा भी (ऐसे) काफ़िरों का दुश्मन है
hinglish: Whoever is an enemy to Allah and His angels and His messengers and Gabriel and Michael - then indeed, Allah is an enemy to the disbelievers.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍ ۖ وَمَا يَكْفُرُ بِهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
english: And We have certainly revealed to you verses [which are] clear proofs, and no one would deny them except the defiantly disobedient.
hindi: और (ऐ रसूल) हमने तुम पर ऐसी निशानियाँ नाज़िल की हैं जो वाजेए और रौशन हैं और ऐसे नाफरमानों के सिवा उनका कोई इन्कार नहीं कर सकता
hinglish: And We have certainly revealed to you verses [which are] clear proofs, and no one would deny them except the defiantly disobedient.

arabic: أَوَكُلَّمَا عَـٰهَدُوا۟ عَهْدًا نَّبَذَهُۥ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
english: Is it not [true] that every time they took a covenant a party of them threw it away? But, [in fact], most of them do not believe.
hindi: और उनकी ये हालत है कि जब कभी कोई अहद किया तो उनमें से एक फरीक़ ने तोड़ डाला बल्कि उनमें से अक्सर तो ईमान ही नहीं रखते
hinglish: Is it not [true] that every time they took a covenant a party of them threw it away? But, [in fact], most of them do not believe.

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ نَبَذَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ كِتَـٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِهِمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
english: And when a messenger from Allah came to them confirming that which was with them, a party of those who had been given the Scripture threw the Scripture of Allah behind their backs as if they did not know [what it contained].
hindi: और जब उनके पास खुदा की तरफ से रसूल (मोहम्मद) आया और उस किताब (तौरेत) की जो उनके पास है तसदीक़ भी करता है तो उन अहले किताब के एक गिरोह ने किताबे खुदा को अपने पसे पुश्त फेंक दिया गोया वह लोग कुछ जानते ही नहीं और उस मंत्र के पीछे पड़ गए
hinglish: And when a messenger from Allah came to them confirming that which was with them, a party of those who had been given the Scripture threw the Scripture of Allah behind their backs as if they did not know [what it contained].

arabic: وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَا تَتْلُوا۟ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلْكِ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۖ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيْمَـٰنُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُعَلِّمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَى ٱلْمَلَكَيْنِ بِبَابِلَ هَـٰرُوتَ وَمَـٰرُوتَ ۚ وَمَا يُعَلِّمَانِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَآ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَا تَكْفُرْ ۖ فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مِنْهُمَا مَا يُفَرِّقُونَ بِهِۦ بَيْنَ ٱلْمَرْءِ وَزَوْجِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا هُم بِضَآرِّينَ بِهِۦ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمْ ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمُوا۟ لَمَنِ ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مَا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مِنْ خَلَـٰقٍ ۚ وَلَبِئْسَ مَا شَرَوْا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَنفُسَهُمْ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
english: And they followed [instead] what the devils had recited during the reign of Solomon. It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic and that which was revealed to the two angels at Babylon, Harut and Marut. But the two angels do not teach anyone unless they say, "We are a trial, so do not disbelieve [by practicing magic]." And [yet] they learn from them that by which they cause separation between a man and his wife. But they do not harm anyone through it except by permission of Allah.
