hindi: (वह वक्त याद करो) जब ख़ुदा फरमाएगा कि ये मरियम के बेटे ईसा हमने जो एहसानात तुम पर और तुम्हारी माँ पर किये उन्हे याद करो जब हमने रूहुलक़ुदूस (जिबरील) से तुम्हारी ताईद की कि तुम झूले में (पड़े पड़े) और अधेड़ होकर (शक़ सा बातें) करने लगे और जब हमने तुम्हें लिखना और अक़ल व दानाई की बातें और (तौरेत व इन्जील (ये सब चीजे) सिखायी और जब तुम मेरे हुक्म से मिट्टी से चिड़िया की मूरत बनाते फिर उस पर कुछ दम कर देते तो वह मेरे हुक्म से (सचमुच) चिड़िया बन जाती थी और मेरे हुक्म से मादरज़ाद (पैदायशी) अंधे और कोढ़ी को अच्छा कर देते थे और जब तुम मेरे हुक्म से मुर्दों को ज़िन्दा (करके क़ब्रों से) निकाल खड़ा करते थे और जिस वक्त तुम बनी इसराईल के पास मौजिज़े लेकर आए और उस वक्त मैने उनको तुम (पर दस्त दराज़ी करने) से रोका तो उनमें से बाज़ कुफ्फ़ार कहने लगे ये तो बस खुला हुआ जादू है
hinglish: [The Day] when Allah will say, "O Jesus, Son of Mary, remember My favor upon you and upon your mother when I supported you with the Pure Spirit and you spoke to the people in the cradle and in maturity; and [remember] when I taught you writing and wisdom and the Torah and the Gospel; and when you designed from clay [what was] like the form of a bird with My permission, then you breathed into it, and it became a bird with My permission; and you healed the blind and the leper with My permission; and when you brought forth the dead with My permission; and when I restrained the Children of Israel from [killing] you when you came to them with clear proofs and those who disbelieved among them said, "This is not but obvious magic."

arabic: وَإِذْ أَوْحَيْتُ إِلَى ٱلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ أَنْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِى وَبِرَسُولِى قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَٱشْهَدْ بِأَنَّنَا مُسْلِمُونَ
english: And [remember] when I inspired to the disciples, "Believe in Me and in My messenger Jesus." They said, "We have believed, so bear witness that indeed we are Muslims [in submission to Allah]."
hindi: और जब मैने हवारियों से इलहाम किया कि मुझ पर और मेरे रसूल पर ईमान लाओ तो अर्ज़ करने लगे हम ईमान लाए और तू गवाह रहना कि हम तेरे फरमाबरदार बन्दे हैं
hinglish: And [remember] when I inspired to the disciples, "Believe in Me and in My messenger Jesus." They said, "We have believed, so bear witness that indeed we are Muslims [in submission to Allah]."

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ يَـٰعِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ هَلْ يَسْتَطِيعُ رَبُّكَ أَن يُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ۖ قَالَ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
english: [And remember] when the disciples said, "O Jesus, Son of Mary, can your Lord send down to us a table [spread with food] from the heaven? [Jesus] said," Fear Allah, if you should be believers."
hindi: (वह वक्त याद करो) जब हवारियों ने ईसा से अर्ज़ की कि ऐ मरियम के बेटे ईसा क्या आप का ख़ुदा उस पर क़ादिर है कि हम पर आसमान से (नेअमत की) एक ख्वान नाज़िल फरमाए ईसा ने कहा अगर तुम सच्चे ईमानदार हो तो ख़ुदा से डरो (ऐसी फरमाइश जिसमें इम्तेहान मालूम हो न करो)
hinglish: [And remember] when the disciples said, "O Jesus, Son of Mary, can your Lord send down to us a table [spread with food] from the heaven? [Jesus] said," Fear Allah, if you should be believers."

arabic: قَالُوا۟ نُرِيدُ أَن نَّأْكُلَ مِنْهَا وَتَطْمَئِنَّ قُلُوبُنَا وَنَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ صَدَقْتَنَا وَنَكُونَ عَلَيْهَا مِنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
english: They said, "We wish to eat from it and let our hearts be reassured and know that you have been truthful to us and be among its witnesses."
hindi: वह अर्ज़ करने लगे हम तो फक़त ये चाहते है कि इसमें से (बरतकन) कुछ खाएँ और हमारे दिल को (आपकी रिसालत का पूरा पूरा) इत्मेनान हो जाए और यक़ीन कर लें कि आपने हमसे (जो कुछ कहा था) सच फरमाया था और हम लोग इस पर गवाह रहें
hinglish: They said, "We wish to eat from it and let our hearts be reassured and know that you have been truthful to us and be among its witnesses."

arabic: قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ٱللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَآ أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَءَاخِرِنَا وَءَايَةً مِّنكَ ۖ وَٱرْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
english: Said Jesus, the son of Mary, "O Allah, our Lord, send down to us a table [spread with food] from the heaven to be for us a festival for the first of us and the last of us and a sign from You. And provide for us, and You are the best of providers."
hindi: (तब) मरियम के बेटे ईसा ने (बारगाहे ख़ुदा में) अर्ज़ की ख़ुदा वन्दा ऐ हमारे पालने वाले हम पर आसमान से एक ख्वान (नेअमत) नाज़िल फरमा कि वह दिन हम लोगों के लिए हमारे अगलों के लिए और हमारे पिछलों के लिए ईद का करार पाए (और हमारे हक़ में) तेरी तरफ से एक बड़ी निशानी हो और तू हमें रोज़ी दे और तू सब रोज़ी देने वालो से बेहतर है
hinglish: Said Jesus, the son of Mary, "O Allah, our Lord, send down to us a table [spread with food] from the heaven to be for us a festival for the first of us and the last of us and a sign from You. And provide for us, and You are the best of providers."

arabic: قَالَ ٱللَّهُ إِنِّى مُنَزِّلُهَا عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَمَن يَكْفُرْ بَعْدُ مِنكُمْ فَإِنِّىٓ أُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابًا لَّآ أُعَذِّبُهُۥٓ أَحَدًا مِّنَ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
english: Allah said, "Indeed, I will sent it down to you, but whoever disbelieves afterwards from among you - then indeed will I punish him with a punishment by which I have not punished anyone among the worlds."
hindi: खुदा ने फरमाया मै ख्वान तो तुम पर ज़रुर नाज़िल करुगाँ (मगर याद रहे कि) फिर तुममें से जो भी शख़्श उसके बाद काफ़िर हुआ तो मै उसको यक़ीन ऐसे सख्त अज़ाब की सज़ा दूँगा कि सारी ख़ुदायी में किसी एक पर भी वैसा (सख्त) अज़ाब न करुगाँ
hinglish: Allah said, "Indeed, I will sent it down to you, but whoever disbelieves afterwards from among you - then indeed will I punish him with a punishment by which I have not punished anyone among the worlds."

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَـٰعِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ ءَأَنتَ قُلْتَ لِلنَّاسِ ٱتَّخِذُونِى وَأُمِّىَ إِلَـٰهَيْنِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ مَا يَكُونُ لِىٓ أَنْ أَقُولَ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِحَقٍّ ۚ إِن كُنتُ قُلْتُهُۥ فَقَدْ عَلِمْتَهُۥ ۚ تَعْلَمُ مَا فِى نَفْسِى وَلَآ أَعْلَمُ مَا فِى نَفْسِكَ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ عَلَّـٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ
english: And [beware the Day] when Allah will say, "O Jesus, Son of Mary, did you say to the people, 'Take me and my mother as deities besides Allah?'" He will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for me to say that to which I have no right. If I had said it, You would have known it. You know what is within myself, and I do not know what is within Yourself. Indeed, it is You who is Knower of the unseen.
hindi: और (वह वक्त भी याद करो) जब क़यामत में ईसा से ख़ुदा फरमाएग कि (क्यों) ऐ मरियम के बेटे ईसा क्या तुमने लोगों से ये कह दिया था कि ख़ुदा को छोड़कर मुझ को और मेरी माँ को ख़ुदा बना लो ईसा अर्ज़ करेगें सुबहान अल्लाह मेरी तो ये मजाल न थी कि मै ऐसी बात मुँह से निकालूं जिसका मुझे कोई हक़ न हो (अच्छा) अगर मैने कहा होगा तो तुझको ज़रुर मालूम ही होगा क्योंकि तू मेरे दिल की (सब बात) जानता है हाँ अलबत्ता मै तेरे जी की बात नहीं जानता (क्योंकि) इसमें तो शक़ ही नहीं कि तू ही ग़ैब की बातें ख़ूब जानता है
hinglish: And [beware the Day] when Allah will say, "O Jesus, Son of Mary, did you say to the people, 'Take me and my mother as deities besides Allah?'" He will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for me to say that to which I have no right. If I had said it, You would have known it. You know what is within myself, and I do not know what is within Yourself. Indeed, it is You who is Knower of the unseen.

arabic: مَا قُلْتُ لَهُمْ إِلَّا مَآ أَمَرْتَنِى بِهِۦٓ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبَّكُمْ ۚ وَكُنتُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيدًا مَّا دُمْتُ فِيهِمْ ۖ فَلَمَّا تَوَفَّيْتَنِى كُنتَ أَنتَ ٱلرَّقِيبَ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَأَنتَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
english: I said not to them except what You commanded me - to worship Allah, my Lord and your Lord. And I was a witness over them as long as I was among them; but when You took me up, You were the Observer over them, and You are, over all things, Witness.
hindi: तूने मुझे जो कुछ हुक्म दिया उसके सिवा तो मैने उनसे कुछ भी नहीं कहा यही कि ख़ुदा ही की इबादत करो जो मेरा और तुम्हारा सबका पालने वाला है और जब तक मैं उनमें रहा उन की देखभाल करता रहा फिर जब तूने मुझे (दुनिया से) उठा लिया तो तू ही उनका निगेहबान था और तू तो ख़ुद हर चीज़ का गवाह (मौजूद) है
hinglish: I said not to them except what You commanded me - to worship Allah, my Lord and your Lord. And I was a witness over them as long as I was among them; but when You took me up, You were the Observer over them, and You are, over all things, Witness.

arabic: إِن تُعَذِّبْهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ عِبَادُكَ ۖ وَإِن تَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ فَإِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
english: If You should punish them - indeed they are Your servants; but if You forgive them - indeed it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
hindi: तू अगर उन पर अज़ाब करेगा तो (तू मालिक है) ये तेरे बन्दे हैं और अगर उन्हें बख्श देगा तो (कोई तेरा हाथ नहीं पकड़ सकता क्योंकि) बेशक तू ज़बरदस्त हिकमत वाला है
hinglish: If You should punish them - indeed they are Your servants; but if You forgive them - indeed it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic: قَالَ ٱللَّهُ هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ يَنفَعُ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ صِدْقُهُمْ ۚ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۚ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
english: Allah will say, "This is the Day when the truthful will benefit from their truthfulness." For them are gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them, and they with Him. That is the great attainment.
hindi: ख़ुदा फरमाएगा कि ये वह दिन है कि सच्चे बन्दों को उनकी सच्चाई (आज) काम आएगी उनके लिए (हरे भरे बेहिश्त के) वह बाग़ात है जिनके (दरख्तो के) नीचे नहरे जारी हैं (और) वह उसमें अबादुल आबाद तक रहेंगे ख़ुदा उनसे राज़ी और वह ख़ुदा से खुश यही बहुत बड़ी कामयाबी है
hinglish: Allah will say, "This is the Day when the truthful will benefit from their truthfulness." For them are gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them, and they with Him. That is the great attainment.

arabic: لِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا فِيهِنَّ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌۢ
english: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is within them. And He is over all things competent.
hindi: सारे आसमान व ज़मीन और जो कुछ उनमें है सब ख़ुदा ही की सल्तनत है और वह हर चीज़ पर क़ादिर (व तवाना) है
hinglish: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is within them. And He is over all things competent.

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَجَعَلَ ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ وَٱلنُّورَ ۖ ثُمَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ يَعْدِلُونَ
english: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, who created the heavens and the earth and made the darkness and the light. Then those who disbelieve equate [others] with their Lord.
hindi: सब तारीफ ख़ुदा ही को (सज़ावार) है जिसने बहुतेरे आसमान और ज़मीन को पैदा किया और उसमें मुख्तलिफ क़िस्मों की तारीकी रोशनी बनाई फिर (बावजूद उसके) कुफ्फार (औरों को) अपने परवरदिगार के बराबर करते हैं
hinglish: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, who created the heavens and the earth and made the darkness and the light. Then those who disbelieve equate [others] with their Lord.

arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن طِينٍ ثُمَّ قَضَىٰٓ أَجَلًا ۖ وَأَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى عِندَهُۥ ۖ ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ تَمْتَرُونَ
english: It is He who created you from clay and then decreed a term and a specified time [known] to Him; then [still] you are in dispute.
hindi: वह तो वही ख़ुदा है जिसने तुमको मिट्टी से पैदा किया फिर (फिर तुम्हारे मरने का) एक वक्त मुक़र्रर कर दिया और (अगरचे तुमको मालूम नहीं मगर) उसके नज़दीक (क़यामत) का वक्त मुक़र्रर है
hinglish: It is He who created you from clay and then decreed a term and a specified time [known] to Him; then [still] you are in dispute.

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱللَّهُ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يَعْلَمُ سِرَّكُمْ وَجَهْرَكُمْ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْسِبُونَ
english: And He is Allah, [the only deity] in the heavens and the earth. He knows your secret and what you make public, and He knows that which you earn.
hindi: फिर (यही) तुम शक़ करते हो और वही तो आसमानों में (भी) और ज़मीन में (भी) ख़ुदा है वही तुम्हारे ज़ाहिर व बातिन से (भी) ख़बरदार है और वही जो कुछ भी तुम करते हो जानता है
hinglish: And He is Allah, [the only deity] in the heavens and the earth. He knows your secret and what you make public, and He knows that which you earn.

arabic: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ مِّنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
english: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they turn away therefrom.
hindi: और उन (लोगों का) अजब हाल है कि उनके पास ख़ुदा की आयत में से जब कोई आयत आती तो बस ये लोग ज़रुर उससे मुंह फेर लेते थे
hinglish: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they turn away therefrom.

arabic: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَـٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
english: For they had denied the truth when it came to them, but there is going to reach them the news of what they used to ridicule.
hindi: चुनान्चे जब उनके पास (क़ुरान बरहक़) आया तो उसको भी झुठलाया तो ये लोग जिसके साथ मसख़रापन कर रहे है उनकी हक़ीक़त उन्हें अनक़रीब ही मालूम हो जाएगी
hinglish: For they had denied the truth when it came to them, but there is going to reach them the news of what they used to ridicule.

arabic: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ مَّكَّنَّـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَا لَمْ نُمَكِّن لَّكُمْ وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْهِم مِّدْرَارًا وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرَ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهِمْ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَأَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
english: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them which We had established upon the earth as We have not established you? And We sent [rain from] the sky upon them in showers and made rivers flow beneath them; then We destroyed them for their sins and brought forth after them a generation of others.
hindi: क्या उन्हें सूझता नहीं कि हमने उनसे पहले कितने गिरोह (के गिरोह) हलाक कर डाले जिनको हमने रुए ज़मीन मे वह (कूवत) क़ुदरत अता की थी जो अभी तक तुमको नहीं दी और हमने आसमान तो उन पर मूसलाधार पानी बरसता छोड़ दिया था और उनके (मकानात के) नीचे बहती हुई नहरें बना दी थी (मगर) फिर भी उनके गुनाहों की वजह से उनको मार डाला और उनके बाद एक दूसरे गिरोह को पैदा कर दिया
hinglish: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them which We had established upon the earth as We have not established you? And We sent [rain from] the sky upon them in showers and made rivers flow beneath them; then We destroyed them for their sins and brought forth after them a generation of others.

arabic: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ كِتَـٰبًا فِى قِرْطَاسٍ فَلَمَسُوهُ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ لَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
english: And even if We had sent down to you, [O Muhammad], a written scripture on a page and they touched it with their hands, the disbelievers would say, "This is not but obvious magic."
hindi: और (ऐ रसूल) अगर हम कागज़ पर (लिखी लिखाई) किताब (भी) तुम पर नाज़िल करते और ये लोग उसे अपने हाथों से छू भी लेते फिर भी कुफ्फार (न मानते और) कहते कि ये तो बस खुला हुआ जादू है
hinglish: And even if We had sent down to you, [O Muhammad], a written scripture on a page and they touched it with their hands, the disbelievers would say, "This is not but obvious magic."

arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ ۖ وَلَوْ أَنزَلْنَا مَلَكًا لَّقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ ثُمَّ لَا يُنظَرُونَ
english: And they say, "Why was there not sent down to him an angel?" But if We had sent down an angel, the matter would have been decided; then they would not be reprieved.
hindi: और (ये भी) कहते कि उस (नबी) पर कोई फरिश्ता क्यों नहीं नाज़िल किया गया (जो साथ साथ रहता) हालॉकि अगर हम फरिश्ता भेज देते तो (उनका) काम ही तमाम हो जाता (और) फिर उन्हें मोहलत भी न दी जाती
hinglish: And they say, "Why was there not sent down to him an angel?" But if We had sent down an angel, the matter would have been decided; then they would not be reprieved.

arabic: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَلَكًا لَّجَعَلْنَـٰهُ رَجُلًا وَلَلَبَسْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّا يَلْبِسُونَ
english: And if We had made him an angel, We would have made him [appear as] a man, and We would have covered them with that in which they cover themselves.
hindi: और अगर हम फरिश्ते को नबी बनाते तो (आख़िर) उसको भी मर्द सूरत बनाते और जो शुबहे ये लोग कर रहे हैं वही शुबहे (गोया) हम ख़ुद उन पर (उस वक्त भी) उठा देते
hinglish: And if We had made him an angel, We would have made him [appear as] a man, and We would have covered them with that in which they cover themselves.

arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
english: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by that which they used to ridicule.
hindi: (ऐ रसूल तुम दिल तंग न हो) तुम से पहले (भी) पैग़म्बरों के साथ मसख़रापन किया गया है पस जो लोग मसख़रापन करते थे उनको उस अज़ाब ने जिसके ये लोग हॅसी उड़ाते थे घेर लिया
hinglish: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by that which they used to ridicule.

arabic: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ ٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
english: Say, "Travel through the land; then observe how was the end of the deniers."
hindi: (ऐ रसूल उनसे) कहो कि ज़रुर रुए ज़मीन पर चल फिर कर देखो तो कि (अम्बिया के) झुठलाने वालो का क्या (बुरा) अन्जाम हुआ
hinglish: Say, "Travel through the land; then observe how was the end of the deniers."

arabic: قُل لِّمَن مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ قُل لِّلَّهِ ۚ كَتَبَ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةَ ۚ لَيَجْمَعَنَّكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
english: Say, "To whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth?" Say, "To Allah." He has decreed upon Himself mercy. He will surely assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt. Those who will lose themselves [that Day] do not believe.
hindi: (ऐ रसूल उनसे) पूछो तो कि (भला) जो कुछ आसमान और ज़मीन में है किसका है (वह जवाब देगें) तुम ख़ुद कह दो कि ख़ास ख़ुदा का है उसने अपनी ज़ात पर मेहरबानी लाज़िम कर ली है वह तुम सब के सब को क़यामत के दिन जिसके आने मे कुछ शक़ नहीं ज़रुर जमा करेगा (मगर) जिन लोगों ने अपना आप नुक़सान किया वह तो (क़यामत पर) ईमान न लाएंगें
hinglish: Say, "To whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth?" Say, "To Allah." He has decreed upon Himself mercy. He will surely assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt. Those who will lose themselves [that Day] do not believe.

arabic: وَلَهُۥ مَا سَكَنَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
english: And to Him belongs that which reposes by night and by day, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
hindi: हालॉकि (ये नहीं समझते कि) जो कुछ रात को और दिन को (रुए ज़मीन पर) रहता (सहता) है (सब) ख़ास उसी का है और वही (सब की) सुनता (और सब कुछ) जानता है
hinglish: And to Him belongs that which reposes by night and by day, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

arabic: قُلْ أَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ أَتَّخِذُ وَلِيًّا فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ يُطْعِمُ وَلَا يُطْعَمُ ۗ قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ ۖ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
english: Say, "Is it other than Allah I should take as a protector, Creator of the heavens and the earth, while it is He who feeds and is not fed?" Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to be the first [among you] who submit [to Allah] and [was commanded], 'Do not ever be of the polytheists.' "
hindi: ऐ रसूल) तुम कह दो कि क्या ख़ुदा को जो सारे आसमान व ज़मीन का पैदा करने वाला है छोड़ कर दूसरे को (अपना) सरपरस्त बनाओ और वही (सब को) रोज़ी देता है और उसको कोई रोज़ी नहीं देता (ऐ रसूल) तुम कह दो कि मुझे हुक्म दिया गया है कि सब से पहले इस्लाम लाने वाला मैं हूँ और (ये भी कि ख़बरदार) मुशरेकीन से न होना
hinglish: Say, "Is it other than Allah I should take as a protector, Creator of the heavens and the earth, while it is He who feeds and is not fed?" Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to be the first [among you] who submit [to Allah] and [was commanded], 'Do not ever be of the polytheists.' "

arabic: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
english: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."
hindi: (ऐ रसूल) तुम कहो कि अगर मैं नाफरमानी करुँ तो बेशक एक बड़े (सख्त) दिल के अज़ाब से डरता हूँ
hinglish: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."

arabic: مَّن يُصْرَفْ عَنْهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمَهُۥ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
english: He from whom it is averted that Day - [Allah] has granted him mercy. And that is the clear attainment.
hindi: उस दिन जिस (के सर) से अज़ाब टल गया तो (समझो कि) ख़ुदा ने उस पर (बड़ा) रहम किया और यही तो सरीही कामयाबी है
hinglish: He from whom it is averted that Day - [Allah] has granted him mercy. And that is the clear attainment.

arabic: وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
english: And if Allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him. And if He touches you with good - then He is over all things competent.
hindi: और अगर ख़ुदा तुम को किसी क़िस्म की तकलीफ पहुचाए तो उसके सिवा कोई उसका दफा करने वाला नहीं है और अगर तुम्हें कुछ फायदा) पहुंचाए तो भी (कोई रोक नहीं सकता क्योंकि) वह हर चीज़ पर क़ादिर है
hinglish: And if Allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him. And if He touches you with good - then He is over all things competent.

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
english: And He is the subjugator over His servants. And He is the Wise, the Acquainted [with all].
hindi: वही अपने तमाम बन्दों पर ग़ालिब है और वह वाक़िफकार हकीम है
hinglish: And He is the subjugator over His servants. And He is the Wise, the Acquainted [with all].

arabic: قُلْ أَىُّ شَىْءٍ أَكْبَرُ شَهَـٰدَةً ۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ۖ شَهِيدٌۢ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۚ وَأُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لِأُنذِرَكُم بِهِۦ وَمَنۢ بَلَغَ ۚ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَشْهَدُونَ أَنَّ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً أُخْرَىٰ ۚ قُل لَّآ أَشْهَدُ ۚ قُلْ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ وَإِنَّنِى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
english: Say, "What thing is greatest in testimony?" Say, "Allah is witness between me and you. And this Qur'an was revealed to me that I may warn you thereby and whomever it reaches. Do you [truly] testify that with Allah there are other deities?" Say, "I will not testify [with you]." Say, "Indeed, He is but one God, and indeed, I am free of what you associate [with Him]."
hindi: (ऐ रसूल) तुम पूछो कि गवाही में सबसे बढ़के कौन चीज़ है तुम खुद ही कह दो कि मेरे और तुम्हारे दरमियान ख़ुदा गवाह है और मेरे पास ये क़ुरान वही के तौर पर इसलिए नाज़िल किया गया ताकि मैं तुम्हें और जिसे (उसकी) ख़बर पहुँचे उसके ज़रिए से डराओ क्या तुम यक़ीनन यह गवाही दे सकते हो कि अल्लाह के साथ और दूसरे माबूद भी हैं (ऐ रसूल) तुम कह दो कि मै तो उसकी गवाही नहीं देता (तुम दिया करो) तुम (उन लोगों से) कहो कि वह तो बस एक ही ख़ुदा है और जिन चीज़ों को तुम (ख़ुदा का) शरीक बनाते हो
hinglish: Say, "What thing is greatest in testimony?" Say, "Allah is witness between me and you. And this Qur'an was revealed to me that I may warn you thereby and whomever it reaches. Do you [truly] testify that with Allah there are other deities?" Say, "I will not testify [with you]." Say, "Indeed, He is but one God, and indeed, I am free of what you associate [with Him]."

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ يَعْرِفُونَهُۥ كَمَا يَعْرِفُونَ أَبْنَآءَهُمُ ۘ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
english: Those to whom We have given the Scripture recognize it as they recognize their [own] sons. Those who will lose themselves [in the Hereafter] do not believe.
hindi: मै तो उनसे बेज़र हूँ जिन लोगों को हमने किताब अता फरमाई है (यहूद व नसारा) वह तो जिस तरह अपने बाल बच्चों को पहचानते है उसी तरह उस नबी (मोहम्मद) को भी पहचानते हैं (मगर) जिन लोगों ने अपना आप नुक़सान किया वह तो (किसी तरह) ईमान न लाएंगें
hinglish: Those to whom We have given the Scripture recognize it as they recognize their [own] sons. Those who will lose themselves [in the Hereafter] do not believe.

arabic: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
english: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah a lie or denies His verses? Indeed, the wrongdoers will not succeed.
hindi: और जो शख़्श ख़ुदा पर झूठ बोहतान बॉधे या उसकी आयतों को झुठलाए उससे बढ़के ज़ालिम कौन होगा और ज़ालिमों को हरगिज़ नजात न होगी
hinglish: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah a lie or denies His verses? Indeed, the wrongdoers will not succeed.

arabic: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوٓا۟ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآؤُكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ
english: And [mention, O Muhammad], the Day We will gather them all together; then We will say to those who associated others with Allah, "Where are your 'partners' that you used to claim [with Him]?"
hindi: और (उस दिन को याद करो) जिस दिन हम उन सबको जमा करेंगे फिर जिन लोगों ने शिर्क किया उनसे पूछेगें कि जिनको तुम (ख़ुदा का) शरीक ख्याल करते थे कहाँ हैं
hinglish: And [mention, O Muhammad], the Day We will gather them all together; then We will say to those who associated others with Allah, "Where are your 'partners' that you used to claim [with Him]?"

arabic: ثُمَّ لَمْ تَكُن فِتْنَتُهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ وَٱللَّهِ رَبِّنَا مَا كُنَّا مُشْرِكِينَ
english: Then there will be no [excuse upon] examination except they will say, "By Allah, our Lord, we were not those who associated."
hindi: फिर उनकी कोई शरारत (बाक़ी) न रहेगी बल्कि वह तो ये कहेगें क़सम है उस ख़ुदा की जो हमारा पालने वाला है हम किसी को उसका शरीक नहीं बनाते थे
hinglish: Then there will be no [excuse upon] examination except they will say, "By Allah, our Lord, we were not those who associated."

arabic: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۚ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
english: See how they will lie about themselves. And lost from them will be what they used to invent.
hindi: (ऐ रसूल भला) देखो तो ये लोग अपने ही ऊपर आप किस तरह झूठ बोलने लगे और ये लोग (दुनिया में) जो कुछ इफ़तेरा परदाज़ी (झूठी बातें) करते थे
hinglish: See how they will lie about themselves. And lost from them will be what they used to invent.

arabic: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا ۚ وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كُلَّ ءَايَةٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوكَ يُجَـٰدِلُونَكَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
english: And among them are those who listen to you, but We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if they should see every sign, they will not believe in it. Even when they come to you arguing with you, those who disbelieve say, "This is not but legends of the former peoples."
hindi: वह सब ग़ायब हो गयी और बाज़ उनमें के ऐसे भी हैं जो तुम्हारी (बातों की) तरफ कान लगाए रहते हैं और (उनकी हठ धर्मी इस हद को पहुँची है कि गोया हमने ख़ुद उनके दिलों पर परदे डाल दिए हैं और उनके कानों में बहरापन पैदा कर दिया है कि उसे समझ न सकें और अगर वह सारी (ख़ुदाई के) मौजिज़े भी देखे लें तब भी ईमान न लाएंगें यहाँ तक (हठ धर्मी पहुची) कि जब तुम्हारे पास तुम से उलझे हुए आ निकलते हैं तो कुफ्फ़ार (क़ुरान लेकर) कहा बैठे है (कि भला इसमें रखा ही क्या है) ये तो अगलों की कहानियों के सिवा कुछ भी नहीं
hinglish: And among them are those who listen to you, but We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if they should see every sign, they will not believe in it. Even when they come to you arguing with you, those who disbelieve say, "This is not but legends of the former peoples."

arabic: وَهُمْ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنْهُ وَيَنْـَٔوْنَ عَنْهُ ۖ وَإِن يُهْلِكُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
english: And they prevent [others] from him and are [themselves] remote from him. And they do not destroy except themselves, but they perceive [it] not.
hindi: और ये लोग (दूसरों को भी) उस के (सुनने से) से रोकते हैं और ख़ुद तो अलग थलग रहते ही हैं और (इन बातों से) बस आप ही अपने को हलाक करते हैं और (अफसोस) समझते नहीं
hinglish: And they prevent [others] from him and are [themselves] remote from him. And they do not destroy except themselves, but they perceive [it] not.

arabic: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ وُقِفُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰلَيْتَنَا نُرَدُّ وَلَا نُكَذِّبَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّنَا وَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
english: If you could but see when they are made to stand before the Fire and will say, "Oh, would that we could be returned [to life on earth] and not deny the signs of our Lord and be among the believers."
hindi: (ऐ रसूल) अगर तुम उन लोगों को उस वक्त देखते (तो ताज्जुब करते) जब जहन्नुम (के किनारे) पर लाकर खड़े किए जाओगे तो (उसे देखकर) कहेगें ऐ काश हम (दुनिया में) फिर (दुबारा) लौटा भी दिए जाते और अपने परवरदिगार की आयतों को न झुठलाते और हम मोमिनीन से होते (मगर उनकी आरज़ू पूरी न होगी)
hinglish: If you could but see when they are made to stand before the Fire and will say, "Oh, would that we could be returned [to life on earth] and not deny the signs of our Lord and be among the believers."

arabic: بَلْ بَدَا لَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُخْفُونَ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَوْ رُدُّوا۟ لَعَادُوا۟ لِمَا نُهُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
english: But what they concealed before has [now] appeared to them. And even if they were returned, they would return to that which they were forbidden; and indeed, they are liars.
hindi: बल्कि जो (बेईमानी) पहले से छिपाते थे आज (उसकी हक़ीक़त) उन पर खुल गयी और (हम जानते हैं कि) अगर ये लोग (दुनिया में) लौटा भी दिए जाएं तो भी जिस चीज़ की मनाही की गयी है उसे करें और ज़रुर करें और इसमें शक़ नहीं कि ये लोग ज़रुर झूठे हैं
hinglish: But what they concealed before has [now] appeared to them. And even if they were returned, they would return to that which they were forbidden; and indeed, they are liars.

arabic: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
english: And they say, "There is none but our worldly life, and we will not be resurrected."
hindi: और कुफ्फार ये भी तो कहते हैं कि हमारी इस दुनिया ज़िन्दगी के सिवा कुछ भी नहीं और (क़यामत वग़ैरह सब ढकोसला है) हम (मरने के बाद) भी उठाए ही न जायेंगे
hinglish: And they say, "There is none but our worldly life, and we will not be resurrected."

arabic: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ وُقِفُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ هَـٰذَا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَا ۚ قَالَ فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
english: If you could but see when they will be made to stand before their Lord. He will say, "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will [then] say, "So taste the punishment because you used to disbelieve."
hindi: और (ऐ रसूल) अगर तुम उनको उस वक्त देखते (तो ताज्जुब करते) जब वे लोग ख़ुदा के सामने खड़े किए जाएंगें और ख़ुदा उनसे पूछेगा कि क्या ये (क़यामत का दिन) अब भी सही नहीं है वह (जवाब में) कहेगें कि (दुनिया में) इससे इन्कार करते थे
hinglish: If you could but see when they will be made to stand before their Lord. He will say, "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will [then] say, "So taste the punishment because you used to disbelieve."

arabic: قَدْ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً قَالُوا۟ يَـٰحَسْرَتَنَا عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطْنَا فِيهَا وَهُمْ يَحْمِلُونَ أَوْزَارَهُمْ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِمْ ۚ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ
english: Those will have lost who deny the meeting with Allah, until when the Hour [of resurrection] comes upon them unexpectedly, they will say, "Oh, [how great is] our regret over what we neglected concerning it," while they bear their burdens on their backs. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear.
hindi: उसकी सज़ा में अज़ाब (के मजे) चखो बेशक जिन लोगों ने क़यामत के दिन ख़ुदा की हुज़ूरी को झुठलाया वह बड़े घाटे में हैं यहाँ तक कि जब उनके सर पर क़यामत नागहा (एक दम आ) पहँचेगी तो कहने लगेगें ऐ है अफसोस हम ने तो इसमें बड़ी कोताही की (ये कहते जाएगे) और अपने गुनाहों का पुश्तारा अपनी अपनी पीठ पर लादते जाएंगे देखो तो (ये) क्या बुरा बोझ है जिसको ये लादे (लादे फिर रहे) हैं
hinglish: Those will have lost who deny the meeting with Allah, until when the Hour [of resurrection] comes upon them unexpectedly, they will say, "Oh, [how great is] our regret over what we neglected concerning it," while they bear their burdens on their backs. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear.

arabic: وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ ۖ وَلَلدَّارُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
english: And the worldly life is not but amusement and diversion; but the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allah, so will you not reason?
hindi: और (ये) दुनियावी ज़िन्दगी तो खेल तमाशे के सिवा कुछ भी नहीं और ये तो ज़ाहिर है कि आख़िरत का घर (बेहिश्त) परहेज़गारो के लिए उसके बदर वहॉ (कई गुना) बेहतर है तो क्या तुम (इतना भी) नहीं समझते
hinglish: And the worldly life is not but amusement and diversion; but the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allah, so will you not reason?

arabic: قَدْ نَعْلَمُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيَحْزُنُكَ ٱلَّذِى يَقُولُونَ ۖ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَا يُكَذِّبُونَكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ
english: We know that you, [O Muhammad], are saddened by what they say. And indeed, they do not call you untruthful, but it is the verses of Allah that the wrongdoers reject.
hindi: हम खूब जानते हैं कि उन लोगों की बकबक तुम को सदमा पहुँचाती है तो (तुम को समझना चाहिए कि) ये लोग तुम को नहीं झुठलाते बल्कि (ये) ज़ालिम (हक़ीक़तन) ख़ुदा की आयतों से इन्कार करते हैं
hinglish: We know that you, [O Muhammad], are saddened by what they say. And indeed, they do not call you untruthful, but it is the verses of Allah that the wrongdoers reject.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَصَبَرُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا كُذِّبُوا۟ وَأُوذُوا۟ حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰهُمْ نَصْرُنَا ۚ وَلَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكَ مِن نَّبَإِى۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
english: And certainly were messengers denied before you, but they were patient over [the effects of] denial, and they were harmed until Our victory came to them. And none can alter the words of Allah. And there has certainly come to you some information about the [previous] messengers.
hindi: और (कुछ तुम ही पर नहीं) तुमसे पहले भी बहुतेरे रसूल झुठलाए जा चुके हैं तो उन्होनें अपने झुठलाए जाने और अज़ीयत (व तकलीफ) पर सब्र किया यहाँ तक कि हमारी मदद उनके पास आयी और (क्यों न आती) ख़ुदा की बातों का कोई बदलने वाला नहीं है और पैग़म्बर के हालात तो तुम्हारे पास पहुँच ही चुके हैं
hinglish: And certainly were messengers denied before you, but they were patient over [the effects of] denial, and they were harmed until Our victory came to them. And none can alter the words of Allah. And there has certainly come to you some information about the [previous] messengers.

arabic: وَإِن كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكَ إِعْرَاضُهُمْ فَإِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتَ أَن تَبْتَغِىَ نَفَقًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَوْ سُلَّمًا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَأْتِيَهُم بِـَٔايَةٍ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَمَعَهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ ۚ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِينَ
english: And if their evasion is difficult for you, then if you are able to seek a tunnel into the earth or a stairway into the sky to bring them a sign, [then do so]. But if Allah had willed, He would have united them upon guidance. So never be of the ignorant.
hindi: अगरचे उन लोगों की रदगिरदानी (मुँह फेरना) तुम पर शाक़ ज़रुर है (लेकिन) अगर तुम्हारा बस चले तो ज़मीन के अन्दर कोई सुरगं ढँढ निकालो या आसमान में सीढ़ी लगाओ और उन्हें कोई मौजिज़ा ला दिखाओ (तो ये भी कर देखो) अगर ख़ुदा चाहता तो उन सब को राहे रास्त पर इकट्ठा कर देता (मगर वह तो इम्तिहान करता है) बस (देखो) तुम हरगिज़ ज़ालिमों में (शामिल) न होना
hinglish: And if their evasion is difficult for you, then if you are able to seek a tunnel into the earth or a stairway into the sky to bring them a sign, [then do so]. But if Allah had willed, He would have united them upon guidance. So never be of the ignorant.

arabic: إِنَّمَا يَسْتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْمَعُونَ ۘ وَٱلْمَوْتَىٰ يَبْعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ
english: Only those who hear will respond. But the dead - Allah will resurrect them; then to Him they will be returned.
hindi: (तुम्हारा कहना तो) सिर्फ वही लोग मानते हैं जो (दिल से) सुनते हैं और मुर्दो को तो ख़ुदा क़यामत ही में उठाएगा फिर उसी की तरफ लौटाए जाएंगें
hinglish: Only those who hear will respond. But the dead - Allah will resurrect them; then to Him they will be returned.

arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۚ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُنَزِّلَ ءَايَةً وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
english: And they say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "Indeed, Allah is Able to send down a sign, but most of them do not know."
hindi: और कुफ्फ़ार कहते हैं कि (आख़िर) उस नबी पर उसके परवरदिगार की तरफ से कोई मौजिज़ा क्यों नहीं नाज़िल होता तो तुम (उनसे) कह दो कि ख़ुदा मौजिज़े के नाज़िल करने पर ज़रुर क़ादिर है मगर उनमें के अक्सर लोग (ख़ुदा की मसलहतों को) नहीं जानते
hinglish: And they say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "Indeed, Allah is Able to send down a sign, but most of them do not know."

arabic: وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا طَـٰٓئِرٍ يَطِيرُ بِجَنَاحَيْهِ إِلَّآ أُمَمٌ أَمْثَالُكُم ۚ مَّا فَرَّطْنَا فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِن شَىْءٍ ۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يُحْشَرُونَ
english: And there is no creature on [or within] the earth or bird that flies with its wings except [that they are] communities like you. We have not neglected in the Register a thing. Then unto their Lord they will be gathered.
hindi: ज़मीन में जो चलने फिरने वाला (हैवान) या अपने दोनों परों से उड़ने वाला परिन्दा है उनकी भी तुम्हारी तरह जमाअतें हैं और सब के सब लौह महफूज़ में मौजूद (हैं) हमने किताब (क़ुरान) में कोई बात नहीं छोड़ी है फिर सब के सब (चरिन्द हों या परिन्द) अपने परवरदिगार के हुज़ूर में लाए जायेंगे।
hinglish: And there is no creature on [or within] the earth or bird that flies with its wings except [that they are] communities like you. We have not neglected in the Register a thing. Then unto their Lord they will be gathered.

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا صُمٌّ وَبُكْمٌ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ ۗ مَن يَشَإِ ٱللَّهُ يُضْلِلْهُ وَمَن يَشَأْ يَجْعَلْهُ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
english: But those who deny Our verses are deaf and dumb within darknesses. Whomever Allah wills - He leaves astray; and whomever He wills - He puts him on a straight path.
hindi: और जिन लोगों ने हमारी आयतों को झुठला दिया गोया वह (कुफ्र के घटाटोप) ऍधेरों में गूंगें बहरे (पड़े हैं) ख़ुदा जिसे चाहे उसे गुमराही में छोड़ दे और जिसे चाहे उसे सीधे ढर्रे पर लगा दे
hinglish: But those who deny Our verses are deaf and dumb within darknesses. Whomever Allah wills - He leaves astray; and whomever He wills - He puts him on a straight path.

arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتَكُمْ إِنْ أَتَىٰكُمْ عَذَابُ ٱللَّهِ أَوْ أَتَتْكُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَدْعُونَ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
english: Say, "Have you considered: if there came to you the punishment of Allah or there came to you the Hour - is it other than Allah you would invoke, if you should be truthful?"
hindi: (ऐ रसूल उनसे) पूछो तो कि क्या तुम यह समझते हो कि अगर तुम्हारे सामने ख़ुदा का अज़ाब आ जाए या तुम्हारे सामने क़यामत ही आ खड़ी मौजूद हो तो तुम अगर (अपने दावे में) सच्चे हो तो (बताओ कि मदद के वास्ते) क्या ख़ुदा को छोड़कर दूसरे को पुकारोगे
hinglish: Say, "Have you considered: if there came to you the punishment of Allah or there came to you the Hour - is it other than Allah you would invoke, if you should be truthful?"

arabic: بَلْ إِيَّاهُ تَدْعُونَ فَيَكْشِفُ مَا تَدْعُونَ إِلَيْهِ إِن شَآءَ وَتَنسَوْنَ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ
english: No, it is Him [alone] you would invoke, and He would remove that for which you invoked Him if He willed, and you would forget what you associate [with Him].
hindi: (दूसरों को तो क्या) बल्कि उसी को पुकारोगे फिर अगर वह चाहेगा तो जिस के वास्ते तुमने उसको पुकारा है उसे दफा कर देगा और (उस वक्त) तुम दूसरे माबूदों को जिन्हे तुम (ख़ुदा का) शरीक समझते थे भूल जाओगे
hinglish: No, it is Him [alone] you would invoke, and He would remove that for which you invoked Him if He willed, and you would forget what you associate [with Him].

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَمٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْبَأْسَآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
english: And We have already sent [messengers] to nations before you, [O Muhammad]; then We seized them with poverty and hardship that perhaps they might humble themselves [to Us].
hindi: और (ऐ रसूल) जो उम्मतें तुमसे पहले गुज़र चुकी हैं हम उनके पास भी बहुतेरे रसूल भेज चुके हैं फिर (जब नाफ़रमानी की) तो हमने उनको सख्ती
hinglish: And We have already sent [messengers] to nations before you, [O Muhammad]; then We seized them with poverty and hardship that perhaps they might humble themselves [to Us].

arabic: فَلَوْلَآ إِذْ جَآءَهُم بَأْسُنَا تَضَرَّعُوا۟ وَلَـٰكِن قَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
english: Then why, when Our punishment came to them, did they not humble themselves? But their hearts became hardened, and Satan made attractive to them that which they were doing.
hindi: और तकलीफ़ में गिरफ्तार किया ताकि वह लोग (हमारी बारगाह में) गिड़गिड़ाए तो जब उन (के सर) पर हमारा अज़ाब आ खड़ा हुआ तो वह लोग क्यों नहीं गिड़गिड़ाए (कि हम अज़ाब दफा कर देते) मगर उनके दिल तो सख्त हो गए थे ओर उनकी कारस्तानियों को शैतान ने आरास्ता कर दिखाया था (फिर क्योंकर गिड़गिड़ाते)
hinglish: Then why, when Our punishment came to them, did they not humble themselves? But their hearts became hardened, and Satan made attractive to them that which they were doing.

arabic: فَلَمَّا نَسُوا۟ مَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ أَبْوَٰبَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَرِحُوا۟ بِمَآ أُوتُوٓا۟ أَخَذْنَـٰهُم بَغْتَةً فَإِذَا هُم مُّبْلِسُونَ
english: So when they forgot that by which they had been reminded, We opened to them the doors of every [good] thing until, when they rejoiced in that which they were given, We seized them suddenly, and they were [then] in despair.
hindi: फिर जिसकी उन्हें नसीहत की गयी थी जब उसको भूल गए तो हमने उन पर (ढील देने के लिए) हर तरह की (दुनियावी) नेअमतों के दरवाज़े खोल दिए यहाँ तक कि जो नेअमतें उनको दी गयी थी जब उनको पाकर ख़ुश हुए तो हमने उन्हें नागाहाँ (एक दम) ले डाला तो उस वक्त वह नाउम्मीद होकर रह गए
hinglish: So when they forgot that by which they had been reminded, We opened to them the doors of every [good] thing until, when they rejoiced in that which they were given, We seized them suddenly, and they were [then] in despair.

arabic: فَقُطِعَ دَابِرُ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ۚ وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
english: So the people that committed wrong were eliminated. And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
hindi: फिर ज़ालिम लोगों की जड़ काट दी गयी और सारे जहाँन के मालिक ख़ुदा का शुक्र है
hinglish: So the people that committed wrong were eliminated. And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ سَمْعَكُمْ وَأَبْصَـٰرَكُمْ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِكُم مَّنْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُم بِهِ ۗ ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ ثُمَّ هُمْ يَصْدِفُونَ
english: Say, "Have you considered: if Allah should take away your hearing and your sight and set a seal upon your hearts, which deity other than Allah could bring them [back] to you?" Look how we diversify the verses; then they [still] turn away.
hindi: (कि क़िस्सा पाक हुआ) (ऐ रसूल) उनसे पूछो तो कि क्या तुम ये समझते हो कि अगर ख़ुदा तुम्हारे कान और तुम्हारी ऑंखे लें ले और तुम्हारे दिलों पर मोहर कर दे तो ख़ुदा के सिवा और कौन मौजूद है जो (फिर) तुम्हें ये नेअमतें (वापस) दे (ऐ रसूल) देखो तो हम किस किस तरह अपनी दलीले बयान करते हैं इस पर भी वह लोग मुँह मोडे ज़ाते हैं
hinglish: Say, "Have you considered: if Allah should take away your hearing and your sight and set a seal upon your hearts, which deity other than Allah could bring them [back] to you?" Look how we diversify the verses; then they [still] turn away.

arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتَكُمْ إِنْ أَتَىٰكُمْ عَذَابُ ٱللَّهِ بَغْتَةً أَوْ جَهْرَةً هَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
english: Say, "Have you considered: if the punishment of Allah should come to you unexpectedly or manifestly, will any be destroyed but the wrongdoing people?"
hindi: (ऐ रसूल) उनसे पूछो कि क्या तुम ये समझते हो कि अगर तुम्हारे सर पर ख़ुदा का अज़ाब बेख़बरी में या जानकारी में आ जाए तो क्या गुनाहगारों के सिवा और लोग भी हलाक़ किए जाएंगें (हरगिज़ नहीं)
hinglish: Say, "Have you considered: if the punishment of Allah should come to you unexpectedly or manifestly, will any be destroyed but the wrongdoing people?"

arabic: وَمَا نُرْسِلُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ ۖ فَمَنْ ءَامَنَ وَأَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
english: And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. So whoever believes and reforms - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
hindi: और हम तो रसूलों को सिर्फ इस ग़रज़ से भेजते हैं कि (नेको को जन्नत की) खुशख़बरी दें और (बदो को अज़ाब जहन्नुम से) डराएं फिर जिसने ईमान कुबूल किया और अच्छे अच्छे काम किए तो ऐसे लोगों पर (क़यामत में) न कोई ख़ौफ होगा और न वह ग़मग़ीन होगें
hinglish: And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. So whoever believes and reforms - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
english: But those who deny Our verses - the punishment will touch them for their defiant disobedience.
hindi: और जिन लोगों ने हमारी आयतों को झुठलाया तो चूंकि बदकारी करते थे (हमारा) अज़ाब उनको पलट जाएगा
hinglish: But those who deny Our verses - the punishment will touch them for their defiant disobedience.

arabic: قُل لَّآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِندِى خَزَآئِنُ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَعْلَمُ ٱلْغَيْبَ وَلَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ إِنِّى مَلَكٌ ۖ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ ۚ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ ۚ أَفَلَا تَتَفَكَّرُونَ
english: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not tell you that I have the depositories [containing the provision] of Allah or that I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel. I only follow what is revealed to me." Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Then will you not give thought?"
hindi: (ऐ रसूल) उनसे कह दो कि मै तो ये नहीं कहता कि मेरे पास ख़ुदा के ख़ज़ाने हैं (कि ईमान लाने पर दे दूंगा) और न मै गैब के (कुल हालात) जानता हूँ और न मै तुमसे ये कहता हूँ कि मै फरिश्ता हूँ मै तो बस जो (ख़ुदा की तरफ से) मेरे पास वही की जाती है उसी का पाबन्द हूँ (उनसे पूछो तो) कि अन्धा और ऑंख वाला बराबर हो सकता है तो क्या तुम (इतना भी) नहीं सोचते
hinglish: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not tell you that I have the depositories [containing the provision] of Allah or that I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel. I only follow what is revealed to me." Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Then will you not give thought?"

arabic: وَأَنذِرْ بِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَن يُحْشَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ ۙ لَيْسَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ وَلِىٌّ وَلَا شَفِيعٌ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
english: And warn by the Qur'an those who fear that they will be gathered before their Lord - for them besides Him will be no protector and no intercessor - that they might become righteous.
hindi: और इस क़ुरान के ज़रिए से तुम उन लोगों को डराओ जो इस बात का ख़ौफ रखते हैं कि वह (मरने के बाद) अपने ख़ुदा के सामने जमा किये जायेंगे (और यह समझते है कि) उनका ख़ुदा के सिवा न कोई सरपरस्त हे और न कोई सिफारिश करने वाला ताकि ये लोग परहेज़गार बन जाएं
hinglish: And warn by the Qur'an those who fear that they will be gathered before their Lord - for them besides Him will be no protector and no intercessor - that they might become righteous.

arabic: وَلَا تَطْرُدِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَدَوٰةِ وَٱلْعَشِىِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُۥ ۖ مَا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ وَمَا مِنْ حِسَابِكَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَتَطْرُدَهُمْ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
english: And do not send away those who call upon their Lord morning and afternoon, seeking His countenance. Not upon you is anything of their account and not upon them is anything of your account. So were you to send them away, you would [then] be of the wrongdoers.
hindi: और (ऐ रसूल) जो लोग सुबह व शाम अपने परवरदिगार से उसकी ख़ुशनूदी की तमन्ना में दुऑए मॉगा करते हैं- उनको अपने पास से न धुत्कारो-न उनके (हिसाब किताब की) जवाब देही कुछ उनके ज़िम्मे है ताकि तुम उन्हें (इस ख्याल से) धुत्कार बताओ तो तुम ज़ालिम (के शुमार) में हो जाओगे
hinglish: And do not send away those who call upon their Lord morning and afternoon, seeking His countenance. Not upon you is anything of their account and not upon them is anything of your account. So were you to send them away, you would [then] be of the wrongdoers.

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍ لِّيَقُولُوٓا۟ أَهَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنۢ بَيْنِنَآ ۗ أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
english: And thus We have tried some of them through others that the disbelievers might say, "Is it these whom Allah has favored among us?" Is not Allah most knowing of those who are grateful?
hindi: और इसी तरह हमने बाज़ आदमियों को बाज़ से आज़माया ताकि वह लोग कहें कि हाएं क्या ये लोग हममें से हैं जिन पर ख़ुदा ने अपना फ़जल व करम किया है (यह तो समझते की) क्या ख़ुदा शुक्र गुज़ारों को भी नही जानता
hinglish: And thus We have tried some of them through others that the disbelievers might say, "Is it these whom Allah has favored among us?" Is not Allah most knowing of those who are grateful?

arabic: وَإِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَقُلْ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةَ ۖ أَنَّهُۥ مَنْ عَمِلَ مِنكُمْ سُوٓءًۢا بِجَهَـٰلَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَنَّهُۥ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
english: And when those come to you who believe in Our verses, say, "Peace be upon you. Your Lord has decreed upon Himself mercy: that any of you who does wrong out of ignorance and then repents after that and corrects himself - indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful."
hindi: और जो लोग हमारी आयतों पर ईमान लाए हैं तुम्हारे पास ऑंए तो तुम सलामुन अलैकुम (तुम पर ख़ुदा की सलामती हो) कहो तुम्हारे परवरदिगार ने अपने ऊपर रहमत लाज़िम कर ली है बेशक तुम में से जो शख़्श नादानी से कोई गुनाह कर बैठे उसके बाद फिर तौबा करे और अपनी हालत की (असलाह करे ख़ुदा उसका गुनाह बख्श देगा क्योंकि) वह यक़ीनी बड़ा बख्शने वाला मेहरबान है
hinglish: And when those come to you who believe in Our verses, say, "Peace be upon you. Your Lord has decreed upon Himself mercy: that any of you who does wrong out of ignorance and then repents after that and corrects himself - indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful."

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ وَلِتَسْتَبِينَ سَبِيلُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
english: And thus do We detail the verses, and [thus] the way of the criminals will become evident.
hindi: और हम (अपनी) आयतों को यूं तफ़सील से बयान करते हैं ताकि गुनाहगारों की राह (सब पर) खुल जाए और वह इस पर न चले
hinglish: And thus do We detail the verses, and [thus] the way of the criminals will become evident.

arabic: قُلْ إِنِّى نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قُل لَّآ أَتَّبِعُ أَهْوَآءَكُمْ ۙ قَدْ ضَلَلْتُ إِذًا وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
english: Say, "Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you invoke besides Allah." Say, "I will not follow your desires, for I would then have gone astray, and I would not be of the [rightly] guided."
hindi: (ऐ रसूल) तुम कह दो कि मुझसे उसकी मनाही की गई है कि मैं ख़ुदा को छोड़कर उन माबूदों की इबादत करुं जिन को तुम पूजा करते हो (ये भी) कह दो कि मै तो तुम्हारी (नाफसानी) ख्वाहिश पर चलने का नहीं (वरना) फिर तो मै गुमराह हो जाऊॅगा और हिदायत याफता लोगों में न रहूँगा
hinglish: Say, "Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you invoke besides Allah." Say, "I will not follow your desires, for I would then have gone astray, and I would not be of the [rightly] guided."

arabic: قُلْ إِنِّى عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّى وَكَذَّبْتُم بِهِۦ ۚ مَا عِندِى مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ ۖ يَقُصُّ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْفَـٰصِلِينَ
english: Say, "Indeed, I am on clear evidence from my Lord, and you have denied it. I do not have that for which you are impatient. The decision is only for Allah. He relates the truth, and He is the best of deciders."
hindi: तुम कह दो कि मै तो अपने परवरदिगार की तरफ से एक रौशन दलील पर हूं और तुमने उसे झुठला दिया (तो) तुम जिस की जल्दी करते हो (अज़ाब) वह कुछ मेरे पास (एख्तियार में) तो है नहीं हुकूमत तो बस ज़रुर ख़ुदा ही के लिए है वह तो (हक़) बयान करता है और वह तमाम फैसला करने वालों से बेहतर है
hinglish: Say, "Indeed, I am on clear evidence from my Lord, and you have denied it. I do not have that for which you are impatient. The decision is only for Allah. He relates the truth, and He is the best of deciders."

arabic: قُل لَّوْ أَنَّ عِندِى مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِۦ لَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
english: Say, "If I had that for which you are impatient, the matter would have been decided between me and you, but Allah is most knowing of the wrongdoers."
hindi: (उन लोगों से) कह दो कि जिस (अज़ाब) की तुम जल्दी करते हो अगर वह मेरे पास (एख्तियार में) होता तो मेरे और तुम्हारे दरमियान का फैसला कब का चुक गया होता और ख़ुदा तो ज़ालिमों से खूब वाक़िफ है
hinglish: Say, "If I had that for which you are impatient, the matter would have been decided between me and you, but Allah is most knowing of the wrongdoers."

arabic: وَعِندَهُۥ مَفَاتِحُ ٱلْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْلَمُهَآ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ ۚ وَمَا تَسْقُطُ مِن وَرَقَةٍ إِلَّا يَعْلَمُهَا وَلَا حَبَّةٍ فِى ظُلُمَـٰتِ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا رَطْبٍ وَلَا يَابِسٍ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ
english: And with Him are the keys of the unseen; none knows them except Him. And He knows what is on the land and in the sea. Not a leaf falls but that He knows it. And no grain is there within the darknesses of the earth and no moist or dry [thing] but that it is [written] in a clear record.
hindi: और उसके पास ग़ैब की कुन्जियॉ हैं जिनको उसके सिवा कोई नही जानता और जो कुछ ख़ुशकी और तरी में है उसको (भी) वही जानता है और कोई पत्ता भी नहीं खटकता मगर वह उसे ज़रुर जानता है और ज़मीन की तारिक़ियों में कोई दाना और न कोई ख़ुश्क चीज़ है मगर वह नूरानी किताब (लौहे महफूज़) में मौजूद है
hinglish: And with Him are the keys of the unseen; none knows them except Him. And He knows what is on the land and in the sea. Not a leaf falls but that He knows it. And no grain is there within the darknesses of the earth and no moist or dry [thing] but that it is [written] in a clear record.

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا جَرَحْتُم بِٱلنَّهَارِ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُكُمْ فِيهِ لِيُقْضَىٰٓ أَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
english: And it is He who takes your souls by night and knows what you have committed by day. Then He revives you therein that a specified term may be fulfilled. Then to Him will be your return; then He will inform you about what you used to do.
hindi: वह वही (ख़ुदा) है जो तुम्हें रात को (नींद में एक तरह पर दुनिया से) उठा लेता हे और जो कुछ तूने दिन को किया है जानता है फिर तुम्हें दिन को उठा कर खड़ा करता है ताकि (ज़िन्दगी की) (वह) मियाद जो (उसके इल्म में) मुअय्युन है पूरी की जाए फिर (तो आख़िर) तुम सबको उसी की तरफ लौटना है फिर जो कुछ तुम (दुनिया में भला बुरा) करते हो तुम्हें बता देगा
hinglish: And it is He who takes your souls by night and knows what you have committed by day. Then He revives you therein that a specified term may be fulfilled. Then to Him will be your return; then He will inform you about what you used to do.

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِۦ ۖ وَيُرْسِلُ عَلَيْكُمْ حَفَظَةً حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ تَوَفَّتْهُ رُسُلُنَا وَهُمْ لَا يُفَرِّطُونَ
english: And He is the subjugator over His servants, and He sends over you guardian-angels until, when death comes to one of you, Our messengers take him, and they do not fail [in their duties].
hindi: वह अपने बन्दों पर ग़ालिब है वह तुम लोगों पर निगेहबान (फ़रिश्ततें तैनात करके) भेजता है-यहाँ तक कि जब तुम में से किसी की मौत आए तो हमारे भेजे हुये फ़रिश्ते उसको (दुनिया से) उठा लेते हैं और वह (हमारे तामीले हुक्म में ज़रा भी) कोताही नहीं करते
hinglish: And He is the subjugator over His servants, and He sends over you guardian-angels until, when death comes to one of you, Our messengers take him, and they do not fail [in their duties].

arabic: ثُمَّ رُدُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَوْلَىٰهُمُ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ أَلَا لَهُ ٱلْحُكْمُ وَهُوَ أَسْرَعُ ٱلْحَـٰسِبِينَ
english: Then they His servants are returned to Allah, their true Lord. Unquestionably, His is the judgement, and He is the swiftest of accountants.
hindi: फिर ये लोग अपने सच्चे मालिक ख़ुदा के पास वापस बुलाए गए-आगाह रहो कि हुक़ूमत ख़ास उसी के लिए है और वह सबसे ज्यादा हिसाब लेने वाला है
hinglish: Then they His servants are returned to Allah, their true Lord. Unquestionably, His is the judgement, and He is the swiftest of accountants.

arabic: قُلْ مَن يُنَجِّيكُم مِّن ظُلُمَـٰتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ تَدْعُونَهُۥ تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفْيَةً لَّئِنْ أَنجَىٰنَا مِنْ هَـٰذِهِۦ لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
english: Say, "Who rescues you from the darknesses of the land and sea [when] you call upon Him imploring [aloud] and privately, 'If He should save us from this [crisis], we will surely be among the thankful.' "
hindi: (ऐ रसूल) उनसे पूछो कि तुम ख़ुश्की और तरी के (घटाटोप) ऍधेरों से कौन छुटकारा देता है जिससे तुम गिड़ गिड़ाकर और (चुपके) दुआएं मॉगते हो कि अगर वह हमें (अब की दफ़ा) उस (बला) से छुटकारा दे तो हम ज़रुर उसके शुक्र गुज़ार (बन्दे होकर) रहेगें
hinglish: Say, "Who rescues you from the darknesses of the land and sea [when] you call upon Him imploring [aloud] and privately, 'If He should save us from this [crisis], we will surely be among the thankful.' "

arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُنَجِّيكُم مِّنْهَا وَمِن كُلِّ كَرْبٍ ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ
english: Say, "It is Allah who saves you from it and from every distress; then you [still] associate others with Him."
hindi: तुम कहो उन (मुसीबतों) से और हर बला में ख़ुदा तुम्हें नजात देता है (मगर अफसोस) उस पर भी तुम शिर्क करते ही जाते हो
hinglish: Say, "It is Allah who saves you from it and from every distress; then you [still] associate others with Him."

arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلْقَادِرُ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَبْعَثَ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابًا مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ أَوْ مِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِكُمْ أَوْ يَلْبِسَكُمْ شِيَعًا وَيُذِيقَ بَعْضَكُم بَأْسَ بَعْضٍ ۗ ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَفْقَهُونَ
english: Say, "He is the [one] Able to send upon you affliction from above you or from beneath your feet or to confuse you [so you become] sects and make you taste the violence of one another." Look how We diversify the signs that they might understand.
hindi: (ऐ रसूल) तुम कह दो कि वही उस पर अच्छी तरह क़ाबू रखता है कि अगर (चाहे तो) तुम पर अज़ाब तुम्हारे (सर के) ऊपर से नाज़िल करे या तुम्हारे पॉव के नीचे से (उठाकर खड़ा कर दे) या एक गिरोह को दूसरे से भिड़ा दे और तुम में से कुछ लोगों को बाज़ आदमियों की लड़ाई का मज़ा चखा दे ज़रा ग़ौर तो करो हम किस किस तरह अपनी आयतों को उलट पुलट के बयान करते हैं ताकि लोग समझे
hinglish: Say, "He is the [one] Able to send upon you affliction from above you or from beneath your feet or to confuse you [so you become] sects and make you taste the violence of one another." Look how We diversify the signs that they might understand.

arabic: وَكَذَّبَ بِهِۦ قَوْمُكَ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ ۚ قُل لَّسْتُ عَلَيْكُم بِوَكِيلٍ
english: But your people have denied it while it is the truth. Say, "I am not over you a manager."
hindi: और उसी (क़ुरान) को तुम्हारी क़ौम ने झुठला दिया हालॉकि वह बरहक़ है (ऐ रसूल) तुम उनसे कहो कि मैं तुम पर कुछ निगेहबान तो हूं नहीं हर ख़बर (के पूरा होने) का एक ख़ास वक्त मुक़र्रर है और अनक़रीब (जल्दी) ही तुम जान लोगे
hinglish: But your people have denied it while it is the truth. Say, "I am not over you a manager."

arabic: لِّكُلِّ نَبَإٍ مُّسْتَقَرٌّ ۚ وَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
english: For every happening is a finality; and you are going to know.
hindi: और जब तुम उन लोगों को देखो जो हमारी आयतों में बेहूदा बहस कर रहे हैं तो उन (के पास) से टल जाओ यहाँ तक कि वह लोग उसके सिवा किसी और बात में बहस करने लगें और अगर (हमारा ये हुक्म) तुम्हें शैतान भुला दे तो याद आने के बाद ज़ालिम लोगों के साथ हरगिज़ न बैठना
hinglish: For every happening is a finality; and you are going to know.

arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخُوضُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يَخُوضُوا۟ فِى حَدِيثٍ غَيْرِهِۦ ۚ وَإِمَّا يُنسِيَنَّكَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ فَلَا تَقْعُدْ بَعْدَ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
english: And when you see those who engage in [offensive] discourse concerning Our verses, then turn away from them until they enter into another conversation. And if Satan should cause you to forget, then do not remain after the reminder with the wrongdoing people.
hindi: और ऐसे लोगों (के हिसाब किताब) का जवाब देही कुछ परहेज़गारो पर तो है नहीं मगर (सिर्फ नसीहतन) याद दिलाना (चाहिए) ताकि ये लोग भी परहेज़गार बनें
hinglish: And when you see those who engage in [offensive] discourse concerning Our verses, then turn away from them until they enter into another conversation. And if Satan should cause you to forget, then do not remain after the reminder with the wrongdoing people.

arabic: وَمَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ وَلَـٰكِن ذِكْرَىٰ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
english: And those who fear Allah are not held accountable for the disbelievers at all, but [only for] a reminder - that perhaps they will fear Him.
hindi: और जिन लोगों ने अपने दीन को खेल और तमाशा बना रखा है और दुनिया की ज़िन्दगी ने उन को धोके में डाल रखा है ऐसे लोगों को छोड़ो और क़ुरान के ज़रिए से उनको नसीहत करते रहो (ऐसा न हो कि कोई) शख़्श अपने करतूत की बदौलत मुब्तिलाए बला हो जाए (क्योंकि उस वक्त) तो ख़ुदा के सिवा उसका न कोई सरपरस्त होगा न सिफारिशी और अगर वह अपने गुनाह के ऐवज़ सारे (जहाँन का) बदला भी दे तो भी उनमें से एक न लिया जाएगा जो लोग अपनी करनी की बदौलत मुब्तिलाए बला हुए है उनको पीने के लिए खौलता हुआ गर्म पानी (मिलेगा) और (उन पर) दर्दनाक अज़ाब होगा क्योंकर वह कुफ़्र किया करते थे
hinglish: And those who fear Allah are not held accountable for the disbelievers at all, but [only for] a reminder - that perhaps they will fear Him.

arabic: وَذَرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ لَعِبًا وَلَهْوًا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَذَكِّرْ بِهِۦٓ أَن تُبْسَلَ نَفْسٌۢ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِىٌّ وَلَا شَفِيعٌ وَإِن تَعْدِلْ كُلَّ عَدْلٍ لَّا يُؤْخَذْ مِنْهَآ ۗ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُبْسِلُوا۟ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ ۖ لَهُمْ شَرَابٌ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ وَعَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ
english: And leave those who take their religion as amusement and diversion and whom the worldly life has deluded. But remind with the Qur'an, lest a soul be given up to destruction for what it earned; it will have other than Allah no protector and no intercessor. And if it should offer every compensation, it would not be taken from it. Those are the ones who are given to destruction for what they have earned. For them will be a drink of scalding water and a painful punishment because they used to disbelieve.
hindi: (ऐ रसूल) उनसे पूछो तो कि क्या हम लोग ख़ुदा को छोड़कर उन (माबूदों) से मुनाज़ात (दुआ) करे जो न तो हमें नफ़ा पहुंचा सकते हैं न हमारा कुछ बिगाड़ ही सकते हैं- और जब ख़ुदा हमारी हिदायत कर चुका) उसके बाद उल्टे पावँ कुफ्र की तरफ उस शख़्श की तरह फिर जाएं जिसे शैतानों ने जंगल में भटका दिया हो और वह हैरान (परेशान) हो (कि कहा जाए क्या करें) और उसके कुछ रफीक़ हो कि उसे राहे रास्त (सीधे रास्ते) की तरफ पुकारते रह जाएं कि (उधर) हमारे पास आओ और वह एक न सुने (ऐ रसूल) तुम कह दो कि हिदायत तो बस ख़ुदा की हिदायत है और हमें तो हुक्म ही दिया गया है कि हम सारे जहॉन के परवरदिगार ख़ुदा के फरमाबरदार हैं
hinglish: And leave those who take their religion as amusement and diversion and whom the worldly life has deluded. But remind with the Qur'an, lest a soul be given up to destruction for what it earned; it will have other than Allah no protector and no intercessor. And if it should offer every compensation, it would not be taken from it. Those are the ones who are given to destruction for what they have earned. For them will be a drink of scalding water and a painful punishment because they used to disbelieve.

arabic: قُلْ أَنَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُنَا وَلَا يَضُرُّنَا وَنُرَدُّ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَابِنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ كَٱلَّذِى ٱسْتَهْوَتْهُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ حَيْرَانَ لَهُۥٓ أَصْحَـٰبٌ يَدْعُونَهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱلْهُدَى ٱئْتِنَا ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ هُوَ ٱلْهُدَىٰ ۖ وَأُمِرْنَا لِنُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
english: Say, "Shall we invoke instead of Allah that which neither benefits us nor harms us and be turned back on our heels after Allah has guided us? [We would then be] like one whom the devils enticed [to wander] upon the earth confused, [while] he has companions inviting him to guidance, [calling], 'Come to us.' " Say, "Indeed, the guidance of Allah is the [only] guidance; and we have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds.
hindi: और ये (भी हुक्म हुआ है) कि पाबन्दी से नमाज़ पढ़ा करो और उसी से डरते रहो और वही तो वह (ख़ुदा) है जिसके हुज़ूर में तुम सब के सब हाज़िर किए जाओगे
hinglish: Say, "Shall we invoke instead of Allah that which neither benefits us nor harms us and be turned back on our heels after Allah has guided us? [We would then be] like one whom the devils enticed [to wander] upon the earth confused, [while] he has companions inviting him to guidance, [calling], 'Come to us.' " Say, "Indeed, the guidance of Allah is the [only] guidance; and we have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds.

arabic: وَأَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
english: And to establish prayer and fear Him." And it is He to whom you will be gathered.
hindi: वह तो वह (ख़ुदा है) जिसने ठीक ठीक बहुतेरे आसमान व ज़मीन पैदा किए और जिस दिन (किसी चीज़ को) कहता है कि हो जा तो (फौरन) हो जाती है
hinglish: And to establish prayer and fear Him." And it is He to whom you will be gathered.

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ كُن فَيَكُونُ ۚ قَوْلُهُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۚ وَلَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
english: And it is He who created the heavens and earth in truth. And the day He says, "Be," and it is, His word is the truth. And His is the dominion [on] the Day the Horn is blown. [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed; and He is the Wise, the Acquainted.
hindi: उसका क़ौल सच्चा है और जिस दिन सूर फूंका जाएगा (उस दिन) ख़ास उसी की बादशाहत होगी (वही) ग़ायब हाज़िर (सब) का जानने वाला है और वही दाना वाक़िफकार है
hinglish: And it is He who created the heavens and earth in truth. And the day He says, "Be," and it is, His word is the truth. And His is the dominion [on] the Day the Horn is blown. [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed; and He is the Wise, the Acquainted.

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ ءَازَرَ أَتَتَّخِذُ أَصْنَامًا ءَالِهَةً ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكَ وَقَوْمَكَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
english: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father Azar, "Do you take idols as deities? Indeed, I see you and your people to be in manifest error."
hindi: (ऐ रसूल) उस वक्त क़ा याद करो) जब इबराहीम ने अपने (मुंह बोले) बाप आज़र से कहा क्या तुम बुतों को ख़ुदा मानते हो-मै तो तुमको और तुम्हारी क़ौम को खुली गुमराही में देखता हूँ
hinglish: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father Azar, "Do you take idols as deities? Indeed, I see you and your people to be in manifest error."

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُرِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِيَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُوقِنِينَ
english: And thus did We show Abraham the realm of the heavens and the earth that he would be among the certain [in faith]
hindi: और (जिस तरह हमने इबराहीम को दिखाया था कि बुत क़ाबिले परसतिश (पूजने के क़ाबिल) नहीं) उसी तरह हम इबराहीम को सारे आसमान और ज़मीन की सल्तनत का (इन्तज़ाम) दिखाते रहे ताकि वह (हमारी वहदानियत का) यक़ीन करने वालों से हो जाएं
hinglish: And thus did We show Abraham the realm of the heavens and the earth that he would be among the certain [in faith]

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلَّيْلُ رَءَا كَوْكَبًا ۖ قَالَ هَـٰذَا رَبِّى ۖ فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَ قَالَ لَآ أُحِبُّ ٱلْـَٔافِلِينَ
english: So when the night covered him [with darkness], he saw a star. He said, "This is my lord." But when it set, he said, "I like not those that disappear."
hindi: तो जब उन पर रात की तारीक़ी (अंधेरा) छा गयी तो एक सितारे को देखा तो दफअतन बोल उठे (हाए क्या) यही मेरा ख़ुदा है फिर जब वह डूब गया तो कहने लगे ग़ुरुब (डूब) हो जाने वाली चीज़ को तो मै (ख़ुदा बनाना) पसन्द नहीं करता
hinglish: So when the night covered him [with darkness], he saw a star. He said, "This is my lord." But when it set, he said, "I like not those that disappear."

arabic: فَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلْقَمَرَ بَازِغًا قَالَ هَـٰذَا رَبِّى ۖ فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَ قَالَ لَئِن لَّمْ يَهْدِنِى رَبِّى لَأَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
english: And when he saw the moon rising, he said, "This is my lord." But when it set, he said, "Unless my Lord guides me, I will surely be among the people gone astray."
hindi: फिर जब चाँद को जगमगाता हुआ देखा तो बोल उठे (क्या) यही मेरा ख़ुदा है फिर जब वह भी ग़ुरुब हो गया तो कहने लगे कि अगर (कहीं) मेरा (असली) परवरदिगार मेरी हिदायत न करता तो मैं ज़रुर गुमराह लोगों में हो जाता
hinglish: And when he saw the moon rising, he said, "This is my lord." But when it set, he said, "Unless my Lord guides me, I will surely be among the people gone astray."

arabic: فَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلشَّمْسَ بَازِغَةً قَالَ هَـٰذَا رَبِّى هَـٰذَآ أَكْبَرُ ۖ فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَتْ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
english: And when he saw the sun rising, he said, "This is my lord; this is greater." But when it set, he said, "O my people, indeed I am free from what you associate with Allah.
hindi: फिर जब आफताब को दमकता हुआ देखा तो कहने लगे (क्या) यही मेरा ख़ुदा है ये तो सबसे बड़ा (भी) है फिर जब ये भी ग़ुरुब हो गया तो कहने लगे ऐ मेरी क़ौम जिन जिन चीज़ों को तुम लोग (ख़ुदा का) शरीक बनाते हो उनसे मैं बेज़ार हूँ
hinglish: And when he saw the sun rising, he said, "This is my lord; this is greater." But when it set, he said, "O my people, indeed I am free from what you associate with Allah.

arabic: إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
english: Indeed, I have turned my face toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allah."
hindi: (ये हरगिज़ नहीं हो सकते) मैने तो बातिल से कतराकर उसकी तरफ से मुँह कर लिया है जिसने बहुतेरे आसमान और ज़मीन पैदा किए और मैं मुशरेकीन से नहीं हूँ
hinglish: Indeed, I have turned my face toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allah."

arabic: وَحَآجَّهُۥ قَوْمُهُۥ ۚ قَالَ أَتُحَـٰٓجُّوٓنِّى فِى ٱللَّهِ وَقَدْ هَدَىٰنِ ۚ وَلَآ أَخَافُ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ رَبِّى شَيْـًٔا ۗ وَسِعَ رَبِّى كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًا ۗ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
english: And his people argued with him. He said, "Do you argue with me concerning Allah while He has guided me? And I fear not what you associate with Him [and will not be harmed] unless my Lord should will something. My Lord encompasses all things in knowledge; then will you not remember?
hindi: और उनकी क़ौम के लोग उनसे हुज्जत करने लगे तो इबराहीम ने कहा था क्या तुम मुझसे ख़ुदा के बारे में हुज्जत करते हो हालॉकि वह यक़ीनी मेरी हिदायत कर चुका और तुम मे जिन बुतों को उसका शरीक मानते हो मै उनसे डरता (वरता) नहीं (वह मेरा कुछ नहीं कर सकते) मगर हॉ मेरा ख़ुदा खुद (करना) चाहे तो अलबत्ता कर सकता है मेरा परवरदिगार तो बाएतबार इल्म के सब पर हावी है तो क्या उस पर भी तुम नसीहत नहीं मानते
hinglish: And his people argued with him. He said, "Do you argue with me concerning Allah while He has guided me? And I fear not what you associate with Him [and will not be harmed] unless my Lord should will something. My Lord encompasses all things in knowledge; then will you not remember?

arabic: وَكَيْفَ أَخَافُ مَآ أَشْرَكْتُمْ وَلَا تَخَافُونَ أَنَّكُمْ أَشْرَكْتُم بِٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ عَلَيْكُمْ سُلْطَـٰنًا ۚ فَأَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ أَحَقُّ بِٱلْأَمْنِ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
english: And how should I fear what you associate while you do not fear that you have associated with Allah that for which He has not sent down to you any authority? So which of the two parties has more right to security, if you should know?
hindi: और जिन्हें तुम ख़ुदा का शरीक बताते हो मै उन से क्यों डरुँ जब तुम इस बात से नहीं डरते कि तुमने ख़ुदा का शरीक ऐसी चीज़ों को बनाया है जिनकी ख़ुदा ने कोई सनद तुम पर नहीं नाज़िल की फिर अगर तुम जानते हो तो (भला बताओ तो सही कि) हम दोनों फरीक़ (गिरोह) में अमन क़ायम रखने का ज्यादा हक़दार कौन है
hinglish: And how should I fear what you associate while you do not fear that you have associated with Allah that for which He has not sent down to you any authority? So which of the two parties has more right to security, if you should know?

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَلْبِسُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنَهُم بِظُلْمٍ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلْأَمْنُ وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
english: They who believe and do not mix their belief with injustice - those will have security, and they are [rightly] guided.
hindi: जिन लोगों ने ईमान क़ुबूल किया और अपने ईमान को ज़ुल्म (शिर्क) से आलूदा नहीं किया उन्हीं लोगों के लिए अमन (व इतमिनान) है और यही लोग हिदायत याफ़ता हैं
hinglish: They who believe and do not mix their belief with injustice - those will have security, and they are [rightly] guided.

arabic: وَتِلْكَ حُجَّتُنَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ ۚ نَرْفَعُ دَرَجَـٰتٍ مَّن نَّشَآءُ ۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
english: And that was Our [conclusive] argument which We gave Abraham against his people. We raise by degrees whom We will. Indeed, your Lord is Wise and Knowing.
hindi: और ये हमारी (समझाई बुझाई) दलीलें हैं जो हमने इबराहीम को अपनी क़ौम पर (ग़ालिब आने के लिए) अता की थी हम जिसके मरतबे चाहते हैं बुलन्द करते हैं बेशक तुम्हारा परवरदिगार हिक़मत वाला बाख़बर है
hinglish: And that was Our [conclusive] argument which We gave Abraham against his people. We raise by degrees whom We will. Indeed, your Lord is Wise and Knowing.

arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۚ كُلًّا هَدَيْنَا ۚ وَنُوحًا هَدَيْنَا مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِۦ دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَأَيُّوبَ وَيُوسُفَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
english: And We gave to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - all [of them] We guided. And Noah, We guided before; and among his descendants, David and Solomon and Job and Joseph and Moses and Aaron. Thus do We reward the doers of good.
hindi: और हमने इबराहीम को इसहाक़ वा याक़ूब (सा बेटा पोता) अता किया हमने सबकी हिदायत की और उनसे पहले नूह को (भी) हम ही ने हिदायत की और उन्हीं (इबराहीम) को औलाद से दाऊद व सुलेमान व अय्यूब व यूसुफ व मूसा व हारुन (सब की हमने हिदायत की) और नेकों कारों को हम ऐसा ही इल्म अता फरमाते हैं
hinglish: And We gave to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - all [of them] We guided. And Noah, We guided before; and among his descendants, David and Solomon and Job and Joseph and Moses and Aaron. Thus do We reward the doers of good.

arabic: وَزَكَرِيَّا وَيَحْيَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَإِلْيَاسَ ۖ كُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
english: And Zechariah and John and Jesus and Elias - and all were of the righteous.
hindi: और ज़करिया व यहया व ईसा व इलियास (सब की हिदायत की (और ये) सब (ख़ुदा के) नेक बन्दों से हैं
hinglish: And Zechariah and John and Jesus and Elias - and all were of the righteous.

arabic: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَيُونُسَ وَلُوطًا ۚ وَكُلًّا فَضَّلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
english: And Ishmael and Elisha and Jonah and Lot - and all [of them] We preferred over the worlds.
hindi: और इसमाइल व इलियास व युनूस व लूत (की भी हिदायत की) और सब को सारे जहाँन पर फज़ीलत अता की
hinglish: And Ishmael and Elisha and Jonah and Lot - and all [of them] We preferred over the worlds.

arabic: وَمِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِهِمْ وَإِخْوَٰنِهِمْ ۖ وَٱجْتَبَيْنَـٰهُمْ وَهَدَيْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
english: And [some] among their fathers and their descendants and their brothers - and We chose them and We guided them to a straight path.
hindi: और (सिर्फ उन्हीं को नहीं बल्कि) उनके बाप दादाओं और उनकी औलाद और उनके भाई बन्दों में से (बहुतेरों को) और उनके मुन्तख़िब किया और उन्हें सीधी राह की हिदायत की
hinglish: And [some] among their fathers and their descendants and their brothers - and We chose them and We guided them to a straight path.

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ ۚ وَلَوْ أَشْرَكُوا۟ لَحَبِطَ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
english: That is the guidance of Allah by which He guides whomever He wills of His servants. But if they had associated others with Allah, then worthless for them would be whatever they were doing.
hindi: (देखो) ये ख़ुदा की हिदायत है अपने बन्दों से जिसको चाहे उसीकी वजह से राह पर लाए और अगर उन लोगों ने शिर्क किया होता तो उनका किया (धरा) सब अकारत हो जाता
hinglish: That is the guidance of Allah by which He guides whomever He wills of His servants. But if they had associated others with Allah, then worthless for them would be whatever they were doing.

arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ ۚ فَإِن يَكْفُرْ بِهَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ فَقَدْ وَكَّلْنَا بِهَا قَوْمًا لَّيْسُوا۟ بِهَا بِكَـٰفِرِينَ
english: Those are the ones to whom We gave the Scripture and authority and prophethood. But if the disbelievers deny it, then We have entrusted it to a people who are not therein disbelievers.
hindi: (पैग़म्बर) वह लोग थे जिनको हमने (आसमानी) किताब और हुकूमत और नुबूवत अता फरमाई पस अगर ये लोग उसे भी न माने तो (कुछ परवाह नहीं) हमने तो उस पर ऐसे लोगों को मुक़र्रर कर दिया हे जो (उनकी तरह) इन्कार करने वाले नहीं
hinglish: Those are the ones to whom We gave the Scripture and authority and prophethood. But if the disbelievers deny it, then We have entrusted it to a people who are not therein disbelievers.

arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَبِهُدَىٰهُمُ ٱقْتَدِهْ ۗ قُل لَّآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا ۖ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
english: Those are the ones whom Allah has guided, so from their guidance take an example. Say, "I ask of you for this message no payment. It is not but a reminder for the worlds."
hindi: (ये अगले पैग़म्बर) वह लोग थे जिनकी ख़ुदा ने हिदायत की पस तुम भी उनकी हिदायत की पैरवी करो (ऐ रसूल उन से) कहो कि मै तुम से इस (रिसालत) की मज़दूरी कुछ नहीं चाहता सारे जहाँन के लिए सिर्फ नसीहत है
hinglish: Those are the ones whom Allah has guided, so from their guidance take an example. Say, "I ask of you for this message no payment. It is not but a reminder for the worlds."

arabic: وَمَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓ إِذْ قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ بَشَرٍ مِّن شَىْءٍ ۗ قُلْ مَنْ أَنزَلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ٱلَّذِى جَآءَ بِهِۦ مُوسَىٰ نُورًا وَهُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ ۖ تَجْعَلُونَهُۥ قَرَاطِيسَ تُبْدُونَهَا وَتُخْفُونَ كَثِيرًا ۖ وَعُلِّمْتُم مَّا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنتُمْ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ ۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ۖ ثُمَّ ذَرْهُمْ فِى خَوْضِهِمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
english: And they did not appraise Allah with true appraisal when they said, "Allah did not reveal to a human being anything." Say, "Who revealed the Scripture that Moses brought as light and guidance to the people? You [Jews] make it into pages, disclosing [some of] it and concealing much. And you were taught that which you knew not - neither you nor your fathers." Say, "Allah [revealed it]." Then leave them in their [empty] discourse, amusing themselves.
