hindi: बेशक हमारे पास बेड़ियाँ (भी) हैं और जलाने वाली आग (भी)
hinglish: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire

arabic: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
english: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
hindi: और गले में फँसने वाला खाना (भी) और दुख देने वाला अज़ाब (भी)
hinglish: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -

arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
english: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
hindi: जिस दिन ज़मीन और पहाड़ लरज़ने लगेंगे और पहाड़ रेत के टीले से भुर भुरे हो जाएँगे
hinglish: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
english: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
hindi: (ऐ मक्का वालों) हमने तुम्हारे पास (उसी तरह) एक रसूल (मोहम्मद) को भेजा जो तुम्हारे मामले में गवाही दे जिस तरह फिरऔन के पास एक रसूल (मूसा) को भेजा था
hinglish: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.

arabic: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
english: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.
hindi: तो फिरऔन ने उस रसूल की नाफ़रमानी की तो हमने भी (उसकी सज़ा में) उसको बहुत सख्त पकड़ा
hinglish: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.

arabic: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
english: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired?
hindi: तो अगर तुम भी न मानोगे तो उस दिन (के अज़ाब) से क्यों कर बचोगे जो बच्चों को बूढ़ा बना देगा
hinglish: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired?

arabic: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
english: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.
hindi: जिस दिन आसमान फट पड़ेगा (ये) उसका वायदा पूरा होकर रहेगा
hinglish: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.

arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
english: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
hindi: बेशक ये नसीहत है तो जो शख़्श चाहे अपने परवरदिगार की राह एख्तेयार करे
hinglish: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.

arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ
english: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
hindi: (ऐ रसूल) तुम्हारा परवरदिगार चाहता है कि तुम और तुम्हारे चन्द साथ के लोग (कभी) दो तिहाई रात के करीब और (कभी) आधी रात और (कभी) तिहाई रात (नमाज़ में) खड़े रहते हो और ख़ुदा ही रात और दिन का अच्छी तरह अन्दाज़ा कर सकता है उसे मालूम है कि तुम लोग उस पर पूरी तरह से हावी नहीं हो सकते तो उसने तुम पर मेहरबानी की तो जितना आसानी से हो सके उतना (नमाज़ में) क़ुरान पढ़ लिया करो और वह जानता है कि अनक़रीब तुममें से बाज़ बीमार हो जाएँगे और बाज़ ख़ुदा के फ़ज़ल की तलाश में रूए ज़मीन पर सफर एख्तेयार करेंगे और कुछ लोग ख़ुदा की राह में जेहाद करेंगे तो जितना तुम आसानी से हो सके पढ़ लिया करो और नमाज़ पाबन्दी से पढ़ो और ज़कात देते रहो और ख़ुदा को कर्ज़े हसना दो और जो नेक अमल अपने वास्ते (ख़ुदा के सामने) पेश करोगे उसको ख़ुदा के हाँ बेहतर और सिले में बुर्ज़ुग तर पाओगे और ख़ुदा से मग़फेरत की दुआ माँगो बेशक ख़ुदा बड़ा बख्शने वाला मेहरबान है
hinglish: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ
english: O you who covers himself [with a garment],
hindi: ऐ (मेरे) कपड़ा ओढ़ने वाले (रसूल) उठो
hinglish: O you who covers himself [with a garment],

arabic: قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ
english: Arise and warn
hindi: और लोगों को (अज़ाब से) डराओ
hinglish: Arise and warn

arabic: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ
english: And your Lord glorify
hindi: और अपने परवरदिगार की बड़ाई करो
hinglish: And your Lord glorify

arabic: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ
english: And your clothing purify
hindi: और अपने कपड़े पाक रखो
hinglish: And your clothing purify

arabic: وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ
english: And uncleanliness avoid
hindi: और गन्दगी से अलग रहो
hinglish: And uncleanliness avoid

arabic: وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ
english: And do not confer favor to acquire more
hindi: और इसी तरह एहसान न करो कि ज्यादा के ख़ास्तगार बनो
hinglish: And do not confer favor to acquire more

arabic: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ
english: But for your Lord be patient.
hindi: और अपने परवरदिगार के लिए सब्र करो
hinglish: But for your Lord be patient.

arabic: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ
english: And when the trumpet is blown,
hindi: फिर जब सूर फूँका जाएगा
hinglish: And when the trumpet is blown,

arabic: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ
english: That Day will be a difficult day
hindi: तो वह दिन काफ़िरों पर सख्त दिन होगा
hinglish: That Day will be a difficult day

arabic: عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ
english: For the disbelievers - not easy.
hindi: आसान नहीं होगा
hinglish: For the disbelievers - not easy.

arabic: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا
english: Leave Me with the one I created alone
hindi: (ऐ रसूल) मुझे और उस शख़्श को छोड़ दो जिसे मैने अकेला पैदा किया
hinglish: Leave Me with the one I created alone

arabic: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا
english: And to whom I granted extensive wealth
hindi: और उसे बहुत सा माल दिया
hinglish: And to whom I granted extensive wealth

arabic: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا
english: And children present [with him]
hindi: और नज़र के सामने रहने वाले बेटे (दिए)
hinglish: And children present [with him]

arabic: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًا
english: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
hindi: और उसे हर तरह के सामान से वुसअत दी
hinglish: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].

arabic: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
english: Then he desires that I should add more.
hindi: फिर उस पर भी वह तमाअ रखता है कि मैं और बढ़ाऊँ
hinglish: Then he desires that I should add more.

arabic: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا عَنِيدًا
english: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
hindi: ये हरगिज़ न होगा ये तो मेरी आयतों का दुश्मन था
hinglish: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.

arabic: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
english: I will cover him with arduous torment.
hindi: तो मैं अनक़रीब उस सख्त अज़ाब में मुब्तिला करूँगा
hinglish: I will cover him with arduous torment.

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
english: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.
hindi: उसने फिक्र की और ये तजवीज़ की
hinglish: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.

arabic: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
english: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
hindi: तो ये (कम्बख्त) मार डाला जाए
hinglish: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

arabic: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
english: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
hindi: उसने क्यों कर तजवीज़ की
hinglish: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

arabic: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
english: Then he considered [again];
hindi: फिर ग़ौर किया
hinglish: Then he considered [again];

arabic: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
english: Then he frowned and scowled;
hindi: फिर त्योरी चढ़ाई और मुँह बना लिया
hinglish: Then he frowned and scowled;

arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
english: Then he turned back and was arrogant
hindi: फिर पीठ फेर कर चला गया और अकड़ बैठा
hinglish: Then he turned back and was arrogant

arabic: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ
english: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].
hindi: फिर कहने लगा ये बस जादू है जो (अगलों से) चला आता है
hinglish: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].

arabic: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ
english: This is not but the word of a human being."
hindi: ये तो बस आदमी का कलाम है
hinglish: This is not but the word of a human being."

arabic: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ
english: I will drive him into Saqar.
hindi: (ख़ुदा का नहीं) मैं उसे अनक़रीब जहन्नुम में झोंक दूँगा
hinglish: I will drive him into Saqar.

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ
english: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
hindi: और तुम क्या जानों कि जहन्नुम क्या है
hinglish: And what can make you know what is Saqar?

arabic: لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ
english: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],
hindi: वह न बाक़ी रखेगी न छोड़ देगी
hinglish: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],

arabic: لَوَّاحَةٌ لِّلْبَشَرِ
english: Blackening the skins.
hindi: और बदन को जला कर सियाह कर देगी
hinglish: Blackening the skins.

arabic: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ
english: Over it are nineteen [angels].
hindi: उस पर उन्नीस (फ़रिश्ते मुअय्यन) हैं
hinglish: Over it are nineteen [angels].

arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
english: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And mention of the Fire is not but a reminder to humanity.
hindi: और हमने जहन्नुम का निगेहबान तो बस फरिश्तों को बनाया है और उनका ये शुमार भी काफिरों की आज़माइश के लिए मुक़र्रर किया ताकि अहले किताब (फौरन) यक़ीन कर लें और मोमिनो का ईमान और ज्यादा हो और अहले किताब और मोमिनीन (किसी तरह) शक़ न करें और जिन लोगों के दिल में (निफ़ाक का) मर्ज़ है (वह) और काफिर लोग कह बैठे कि इस मसल (के बयान करने) से ख़ुदा का क्या मतलब है यूँ ख़ुदा जिसे चाहता है गुमराही में छोड़ देता है और जिसे चाहता है हिदायत करता है और तुम्हारे परवरदिगार के लशकरों को उसके सिवा कोई नहीं जानता और ये तो आदमियों के लिए बस नसीहत है
hinglish: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And mention of the Fire is not but a reminder to humanity.

arabic: كَلَّا وَٱلْقَمَرِ
english: No! By the moon
hindi: सुन रखो (हमें) चाँद की क़सम
hinglish: No! By the moon

arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ
english: And [by] the night when it departs
hindi: और रात की जब जाने लगे
hinglish: And [by] the night when it departs

arabic: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ
english: And [by] the morning when it brightens,
hindi: और सुबह की जब रौशन हो जाए
hinglish: And [by] the morning when it brightens,

arabic: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ
english: Indeed, the Fire is of the greatest [afflictions]
hindi: कि वह (जहन्नुम) भी एक बहुत बड़ी (आफ़त) है
hinglish: Indeed, the Fire is of the greatest [afflictions]

arabic: نَذِيرًا لِّلْبَشَرِ
english: As a warning to humanity -
hindi: (और) लोगों के डराने वाली है
hinglish: As a warning to humanity -

arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
english: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.
hindi: (सबके लिए नहीें बल्कि) तुममें से वह जो शख़्श (नेकी की तरफ़) आगे बढ़ना
hinglish: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.

arabic: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ
english: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained
hindi: और (बुराई से) पीछे हटना चाहे हर शख़्श अपने आमाल के बदले गिर्द है
hinglish: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained

arabic: إِلَّآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ
english: Except the companions of the right,
hindi: मगर दाहिने हाथ (में नामए अमल लेने) वाले
hinglish: Except the companions of the right,

arabic: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
english: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
hindi: (बेहिश्त के) बाग़ों में गुनेहगारों से बाहम पूछ रहे होंगे
hinglish: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other

arabic: عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
english: About the criminals,
hindi: कि आख़िर तुम्हें दोज़ख़ में कौन सी चीज़ (घसीट) लायी
hinglish: About the criminals,

arabic: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ
english: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"
hindi: वह लोग कहेंगे
hinglish: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"

arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
english: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,
hindi: कि हम न तो नमाज़ पढ़ा करते थे
hinglish: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,

arabic: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ
english: Nor did we used to feed the poor.
hindi: और न मोहताजों को खाना खिलाते थे
hinglish: Nor did we used to feed the poor.

arabic: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ
english: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],
hindi: और अहले बातिल के साथ हम भी बड़े काम में घुस पड़ते थे
hinglish: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],

arabic: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
english: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
hindi: और रोज़ जज़ा को झुठलाया करते थे (और यूँ ही रहे)
hinglish: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
english: Until there came to us the certainty."
hindi: यहाँ तक कि हमें मौत आ गयी
hinglish: Until there came to us the certainty."

arabic: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَـٰعَةُ ٱلشَّـٰفِعِينَ
english: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
hindi: तो (उस वक्त) उन्हें सिफ़ारिश करने वालों की सिफ़ारिश कुछ काम न आएगी
hinglish: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.

arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
english: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away
hindi: और उन्हें क्या हो गया है कि नसीहत से मुँह मोड़े हुए हैं
hinglish: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away

arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ
english: As if they were alarmed donkeys
hindi: गोया वह वहशी गधे हैं
hinglish: As if they were alarmed donkeys

arabic: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
english: Fleeing from a lion?
hindi: कि येर से (दुम दबा कर) भागते हैं
hinglish: Fleeing from a lion?

arabic: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً
english: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.
hindi: असल ये है कि उनमें से हर शख़्श इसका मुतमइनी है कि उसे खुली हुई (आसमानी) किताबें अता की जाएँ
hinglish: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.

arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
english: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
hindi: ये तो हरगिज़ न होगा बल्कि ये तो आख़ेरत ही से नहीं डरते
hinglish: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.

arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌ
english: No! Indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder
hindi: हाँ हाँ बेशक ये (क़ुरान सरा सर) नसीहत है
hinglish: No! Indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder

arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
english: Then whoever wills will remember it.
hindi: तो जो चाहे उसे याद रखे
hinglish: Then whoever wills will remember it.

arabic: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
english: And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
hindi: और ख़ुदा की मशीयत के बग़ैर ये लोग याद रखने वाले नहीं वही (बन्दों के) डराने के क़ाबिल और बख्यिश का मालिक है
hinglish: And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
english: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
hindi: मैं रोजे क़यामत की क़सम खाता हूँ
hinglish: I swear by the Day of Resurrection

arabic: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
english: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].
hindi: (और बुराई से) मलामत करने वाले जी की क़सम खाता हूँ (कि तुम सब दोबारा) ज़रूर ज़िन्दा किए जाओगे
hinglish: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].

arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
english: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?
hindi: क्या इन्सान ये ख्याल करता है (कि हम उसकी हड्डियों को बोसीदा होने के बाद) जमा न करेंगे हाँ (ज़रूर करेंगें)
hinglish: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?

arabic: بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
english: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.
hindi: हम इस पर क़ादिर हैं कि हम उसकी पोर पोर दुरूस्त करें
hinglish: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.

arabic: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
english: But man desires to continue in sin.
hindi: मगर इन्सान तो ये जानता है कि अपने आगे भी (हमेशा) बुराई करता जाए
hinglish: But man desires to continue in sin.

arabic: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
english: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
hindi: पूछता है कि क़यामत का दिन कब होगा
hinglish: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"

arabic: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
english: So when vision is dazzled
hindi: तो जब ऑंखे चकाचौन्ध में आ जाएँगी
hinglish: So when vision is dazzled

arabic: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
english: And the moon darkens
hindi: और चाँद गहन में लग जाएगा
hinglish: And the moon darkens

arabic: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
english: And the sun and the moon are joined,
hindi: और सूरज और चाँद इकट्ठा कर दिए जाएँगे
hinglish: And the sun and the moon are joined,

arabic: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
english: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"
hindi: तो इन्सान कहेगा आज कहाँ भाग कर जाऊँ
hinglish: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"

arabic: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
english: No! There is no refuge.
hindi: यक़ीन जानों कहीं पनाह नहीं
hinglish: No! There is no refuge.

arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
english: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.
hindi: उस रोज़ तुम्हारे परवरदिगार ही के पास ठिकाना है
hinglish: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.

arabic: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
english: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.
hindi: उस दिन आदमी को जो कुछ उसके आगे पीछे किया है बता दिया जाएगा
hinglish: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.

arabic: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ
english: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,
hindi: बल्कि इन्सान तो अपने ऊपर आप गवाह है
hinglish: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,

arabic: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
english: Even if he presents his excuses.
hindi: अगरचे वह अपने गुनाहों की उज्र व ज़रूर माज़ेरत पढ़ा करता रहे
hinglish: Even if he presents his excuses.

arabic: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
english: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an.
hindi: (ऐ रसूल) वही के जल्दी याद करने वास्ते अपनी ज़बान को हरकत न दो
hinglish: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an.

arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
english: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.
hindi: उसका जमा कर देना और पढ़वा देना तो यक़ीनी हमारे ज़िम्मे है
hinglish: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.

arabic: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَـٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
english: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.
hindi: तो जब हम उसको (जिबरील की ज़बानी) पढ़ें तो तुम भी (पूरा) सुनने के बाद इसी तरह पढ़ा करो
hinglish: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
english: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].
hindi: फिर उस (के मुश्किलात का समझा देना भी हमारे ज़िम्में है)
hinglish: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].

arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
english: No! But you love the immediate
hindi: मगर (लोगों) हक़ तो ये है कि तुम लोग दुनिया को दोस्त रखते हो
hinglish: No! But you love the immediate

arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
english: And leave the Hereafter.
hindi: और आख़ेरत को छोड़े बैठे हो
hinglish: And leave the Hereafter.

arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ
english: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,
hindi: उस रोज़ बहुत से चेहरे तो तरो ताज़ा बशबाब होंगे
hinglish: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,

arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
english: Looking at their Lord.
hindi: (और) अपने परवरदिगार (की नेअमत) को देख रहे होंगे
hinglish: Looking at their Lord.

arabic: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌ
english: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,
hindi: और बहुतेरे मुँह उस दिन उदास होंगे
hinglish: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,

arabic: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ
english: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.
hindi: समझ रहें हैं कि उन पर मुसीबत पड़ने वाली है कि कमर तोड़ देगी
hinglish: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.

arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
english: No! When the soul has reached the collar bones
hindi: सुन लो जब जान (बदन से खिंच के) हँसली तक आ पहुँचेगी
hinglish: No! When the soul has reached the collar bones

arabic: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍ
english: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"
hindi: और कहा जाएगा कि (इस वक्त) क़ोई झाड़ फूँक करने वाला है
hinglish: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"

arabic: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
english: And the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation
hindi: और मरने वाले ने समझा कि अब (सबसे) जुदाई है
hinglish: And the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation

arabic: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
english: And the leg is wound about the leg,
hindi: और (मौत की तकलीफ़ से) पिन्डली से पिन्डली लिपट जाएगी
hinglish: And the leg is wound about the leg,

arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
english: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.
hindi: उस दिन तुमको अपने परवरदिगार की बारगाह में चलना है
hinglish: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.

arabic: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
english: And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed.
hindi: तो उसने (ग़फलत में) न (कलामे ख़ुदा की) तसदीक़ की न नमाज़ पढ़ी
hinglish: And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed.

arabic: وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
english: But [instead], he denied and turned away.
hindi: मगर झुठलाया और (ईमान से) मुँह फेरा
hinglish: But [instead], he denied and turned away.

arabic: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
english: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].
hindi: अपने घर की तरफ इतराता हुआ चला
hinglish: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].

arabic: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
english: Woe to you, and woe!
hindi: अफसोस है तुझ पर फिर अफसोस है फिर तुफ़ है
hinglish: Woe to you, and woe!

arabic: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
english: Then woe to you, and woe!
hindi: तुझ पर फिर तुफ़ है
hinglish: Then woe to you, and woe!

arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
english: Does man think that he will be left neglected?
hindi: क्या इन्सान ये समझता है कि वह यूँ ही छोड़ दिया जाएगा
hinglish: Does man think that he will be left neglected?

arabic: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
english: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?
hindi: क्या वह (इब्तेदन) मनी का एक क़तरा न था जो रहम में डाली जाती है
hinglish: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?

arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
english: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
hindi: फिर लोथड़ा हुआ फिर ख़ुदा ने उसे बनाया
hinglish: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]

arabic: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
english: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.
hindi: फिर उसे दुरूस्त किया फिर उसकी दो किस्में बनायीं (एक) मर्द और (एक) औरत
hinglish: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.

arabic: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
english: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?
hindi: क्या इस पर क़ादिर नहीं कि (क़यामत में) मुर्दों को ज़िन्दा कर दे
hinglish: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
english: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
hindi: बेशक इन्सान पर एक ऐसा वक्त अा चुका है कि वह कोई चीज़ क़ाबिले ज़िक्र न था
hinglish: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?

arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
english: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
hindi: हमने इन्सान को मख़लूत नुत्फे से पैदा किया कि उसे आज़माये तो हमने उसे सुनता देखता बनाया
hinglish: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.

arabic: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
english: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
hindi: और उसको रास्ता भी दिखा दिया (अब वह) ख्वाह शुक्र गुज़ार हो ख्वाह नाशुक्रा
hinglish: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
english: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
hindi: हमने काफ़िरों के ज़ंजीरे, तौक और दहकती हुई आग तैयार कर रखी है
hinglish: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
english: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur,
hindi: बेशक नेकोकार लोग शराब के वह सागर पियेंगे जिसमें काफूर की आमेज़िश होगी ये एक चश्मा है जिसमें से ख़ुदा के (ख़ास) बन्दे पियेंगे
hinglish: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur,

arabic: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
english: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].
hindi: और जहाँ चाहेंगे बहा ले जाएँगे
hinglish: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].

arabic: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
english: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
hindi: ये वह लोग हैं जो नज़रें पूरी करते हैं और उस दिन से जिनकी सख्ती हर तरह फैली होगी डरते हैं
hinglish: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.

arabic: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
english: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
hindi: और उसकी मोहब्बत में मोहताज और यतीम और असीर को खाना खिलाते हैं
hinglish: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,

arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
english: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
hindi: (और कहते हैं कि) हम तो तुमको बस ख़ालिस ख़ुदा के लिए खिलाते हैं हम न तुम से बदले के ख़ास्तगार हैं और न शुक्र गुज़ारी के
hinglish: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.

arabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
english: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."
hindi: हमको तो अपने परवरदिगार से उस दिन का डर है जिसमें मुँह बन जाएँगे (और) चेहरे पर हवाइयाँ उड़ती होंगी
hinglish: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
english: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
hindi: तो ख़ुदा उन्हें उस दिन की तकलीफ़ से बचा लेगा और उनको ताज़गी और ख़ुशदिली अता फरमाएगा
hinglish: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness

arabic: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
english: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].
hindi: और उनके सब्र के बदले (बेहिश्त के) बाग़ और रेशम (की पोशाक) अता फ़रमाएगा
hinglish: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].

arabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
english: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
hindi: वहाँ वह तख्तों पर तकिए लगाए (बैठे) होंगे न वहाँ (आफताब की) धूप देखेंगे और न शिद्दत की सर्दी
hinglish: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.

arabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
english: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.
hindi: और घने दरख्तों के साए उन पर झुके हुए होंगे और मेवों के गुच्छे उनके बहुत क़रीब हर तरह उनके एख्तेयार में
hinglish: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.

arabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
english: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],
hindi: और उनके सामने चाँदी के साग़र और शीशे के निहायत शफ्फ़ाफ़ गिलास का दौर चल रहा होगा
hinglish: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],

arabic: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
english: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.
hindi: और शीशे भी (काँच के नहीं) चाँदी के जो ठीक अन्दाज़े के मुताबिक बनाए गए हैं
hinglish: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.

arabic: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
english: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
hindi: और वहाँ उन्हें ऐसी शराब पिलाई जाएगी जिसमें जनजबील (के पानी) की आमेज़िश होगी
hinglish: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger

arabic: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
english: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.
hindi: ये बेहश्त में एक चश्मा है जिसका नाम सलसबील है
hinglish: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.

arabic: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
english: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
hindi: और उनके सामने हमेशा एक हालत पर रहने वाले नौजवाल लड़के चक्कर लगाते होंगे कि जब तुम उनको देखो तो समझो कि बिखरे हुए मोती हैं
hinglish: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.

arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
english: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
hindi: और जब तुम वहाँ निगाह उठाओगे तो हर तरह की नेअमत और अज़ीमुश शान सल्तनत देखोगे
hinglish: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.

arabic: عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
english: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
hindi: उनके ऊपर सब्ज़ क्रेब और अतलस की पोशाक होगी और उन्हें चाँदी के कंगन पहनाए जाएँगे और उनका परवरदिगार उन्हें निहायत पाकीज़ा शराब पिलाएगा
hinglish: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.

arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
english: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."
hindi: ये यक़ीनी तुम्हारे लिए होगा और तुम्हारी (कारगुज़ारियों के) सिले में और तुम्हारी कोशिश क़ाबिले शुक्र गुज़ारी है
hinglish: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."

arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
english: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.
hindi: (ऐ रसूल) हमने तुम पर क़ुरान को रफ्ता रफ्ता करके नाज़िल किया
hinglish: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.

arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
english: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
hindi: तो तुम अपने परवरदिगार के हुक्म के इन्तज़ार में सब्र किए रहो और उन लोगों में से गुनाहगार और नाशुक्रे की पैरवी न करना
hinglish: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].

arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
english: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
hindi: सुबह शाम अपने परवरदिगार का नाम लेते रहो
hinglish: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening

arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
english: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.
hindi: और कुछ रात गए उसका सजदा करो और बड़ी रात तक उसकी तस्बीह करते रहो
hinglish: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.

arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
english: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
hindi: ये लोग यक़ीनन दुनिया को पसन्द करते हैं और बड़े भारी दिन को अपने पसे पुश्त छोड़ बैठे हैं
hinglish: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.

arabic: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
english: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
hindi: हमने उनको पैदा किया और उनके आज़ा को मज़बूत बनाया और अगर हम चाहें तो उनके बदले उन्हीं के जैसे लोग ले आएँ
hinglish: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.

arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
english: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
hindi: बेशक ये कुरान सरासर नसीहत है तो जो शख़्श चाहे अपने परवरदिगार की राह ले
hinglish: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.

arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
english: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
hindi: और जब तक ख़ुदा को मंज़ूर न हो तुम लोग कुछ भी चाह नहीं सकते बेशक ख़ुदा बड़ा वाक़िफकार दाना है
hinglish: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.

arabic: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
english: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
hindi: जिसको चाहे अपनी रहमत में दाख़िल कर ले और ज़ालिमों के वास्ते उसने दर्दनाक अज़ाब तैयार कर रखा है
hinglish: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْمُرْسَلَـٰتِ عُرْفًا
english: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
hindi: हवाओं की क़सम जो (पहले) धीमी चलती हैं
hinglish: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts

arabic: فَٱلْعَـٰصِفَـٰتِ عَصْفًا
english: And the winds that blow violently
hindi: फिर ज़ोर पकड़ के ऑंधी हो जाती हैं
hinglish: And the winds that blow violently

arabic: وَٱلنَّـٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًا
english: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]
hindi: और (बादलों को) उभार कर फैला देती हैं
hinglish: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]

arabic: فَٱلْفَـٰرِقَـٰتِ فَرْقًا
english: And those [angels] who bring criterion
hindi: फिर (उनको) फाड़ कर जुदा कर देती हैं
hinglish: And those [angels] who bring criterion

arabic: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
english: And those [angels] who deliver a message
hindi: फिर फरिश्तों की क़सम जो वही लाते हैं
hinglish: And those [angels] who deliver a message

arabic: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
english: As justification or warning,
hindi: ताकि हुज्जत तमाम हो और डरा दिया जाए
hinglish: As justification or warning,

arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
english: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.
hindi: कि जिस बात का तुमसे वायदा किया जाता है वह ज़रूर होकर रहेगा
hinglish: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.

arabic: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
english: So when the stars are obliterated
hindi: फिर जब तारों की चमक जाती रहेगी
hinglish: So when the stars are obliterated

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
english: And when the heaven is opened
hindi: और जब आसमान फट जाएगा
hinglish: And when the heaven is opened

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
english: And when the mountains are blown away
hindi: और जब पहाड़ (रूई की तरह) उड़े उड़े फिरेंगे
hinglish: And when the mountains are blown away

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
english: And when the messengers' time has come...
hindi: और जब पैग़म्बर लोग एक मुअय्यन वक्त पर जमा किए जाएँगे
hinglish: And when the messengers' time has come...

arabic: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
english: For what Day was it postponed?
hindi: (फिर) भला इन (बातों) में किस दिन के लिए ताख़ीर की गयी है
hinglish: For what Day was it postponed?

arabic: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
english: For the Day of Judgement.
hindi: फ़ैसले के दिन के लिए
hinglish: For the Day of Judgement.

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
english: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?
hindi: और तुमको क्या मालूम की फ़ैसले का दिन क्या है
hinglish: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
english: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
hindi: उस दिन झुठलाने वालों की मिट्टी ख़राब है
hinglish: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
english: Did We not destroy the former peoples?
hindi: क्या हमने अगलों को हलाक नहीं किया
hinglish: Did We not destroy the former peoples?

arabic: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
english: Then We will follow them with the later ones.
hindi: फिर उनके पीछे पीछे पिछलों को भी चलता करेंगे
hinglish: Then We will follow them with the later ones.

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
english: Thus do We deal with the criminals.
hindi: हम गुनेहगारों के साथ ऐसा ही किया करते हैं
hinglish: Thus do We deal with the criminals.

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
english: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
hindi: उस दिन झुठलाने वालों की मिट्टी ख़राब है
hinglish: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
english: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?
hindi: क्या हमने तुमको ज़लील पानी (मनी) से पैदा नहीं किया
hinglish: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?

arabic: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
english: And We placed it in a firm lodging
hindi: फिर हमने उसको एक मुअय्यन वक्त तक
hinglish: And We placed it in a firm lodging

arabic: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
english: For a known extent.
hindi: एक महफूज़ मक़ाम (रहम) में रखा
hinglish: For a known extent.

arabic: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَـٰدِرُونَ
english: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
hindi: फिर (उसका) एक अन्दाज़ा मुक़र्रर किया तो हम कैसा अच्छा अन्दाज़ा मुक़र्रर करने वाले हैं
hinglish: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
english: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
hindi: उन दिन झुठलाने वालों की ख़राबी है
hinglish: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا
english: Have We not made the earth a container
hindi: क्या हमने ज़मीन को ज़िन्दों और मुर्दों को समेटने वाली नहीं बनाया
hinglish: Have We not made the earth a container

arabic: أَحْيَآءً وَأَمْوَٰتًا
english: Of the living and the dead?
hindi: और उसमें ऊँचे ऊँचे अटल पहाड़ रख दिए
hinglish: Of the living and the dead?

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَـٰمِخَـٰتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُم مَّآءً فُرَاتًا
english: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.
hindi: और तुम लोगों को मीठा पानी पिलाया
hinglish: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
english: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
hindi: उस दिन झुठलाने वालों की ख़राबी है
hinglish: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
english: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.
hindi: जिस चीज़ को तुम झुठलाया करते थे अब उसकी तरफ़ चलो
hinglish: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.

arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِى ثَلَـٰثِ شُعَبٍ
english: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns
hindi: (धुएँ के) साये की तरफ़ चलो जिसके तीन हिस्से हैं
hinglish: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns

arabic: لَّا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
english: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."
hindi: जिसमें न ठन्डक है और न जहन्नुम की लपक से बचाएगा
hinglish: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."

arabic: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِى بِشَرَرٍ كَٱلْقَصْرِ
english: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,
hindi: उससे इतने बड़े बड़े अंगारे बरसते होंगे जैसे महल
hinglish: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,

arabic: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَـٰلَتٌ صُفْرٌ
english: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.
hindi: गोया ज़र्द रंग के ऊँट हैं
hinglish: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
english: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
hindi: उस दिन झुठलाने वालों की ख़राबी है
hinglish: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
english: This is a Day they will not speak,
hindi: ये वह दिन होगा कि लोग लब तक न हिला सकेंगे
hinglish: This is a Day they will not speak,

arabic: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
english: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.
hindi: और उनको इजाज़त दी जाएगी कि कुछ उज्र माअज़ेरत कर सकें
hinglish: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
english: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
hindi: उस दिन झुठलाने वालों की तबाही है
hinglish: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَـٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
english: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
hindi: यही फैसले का दिन है (जिस में) हमने तुमको और अगलों को इकट्ठा किया है
hinglish: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.

arabic: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
english: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.
hindi: तो अगर तुम्हें कोई दाँव करना हो तो आओ चल चुको
hinglish: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
english: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
hindi: उस दिन झुठलाने वालों की ख़राबी है
hinglish: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ وَعُيُونٍ
english: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
hindi: बेशक परहेज़गार लोग (दरख्तों की) घनी छाँव में होंगे
hinglish: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs

arabic: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
english: And fruits from whatever they desire,
hindi: और चश्मों और आदमियों में जो उन्हें मरग़ूब हो
hinglish: And fruits from whatever they desire,

arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
english: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
hindi: (दुनिया में) जो अमल करते थे उसके बदले में मज़े से खाओ पियो
hinglish: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
english: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
hindi: मुबारक हम नेकोकारों को ऐसा ही बदला दिया करते हैं
hinglish: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
english: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
hindi: उस दिन झुठलाने वालों की ख़राबी है
hinglish: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
english: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.
hindi: (झुठलाने वालों) चन्द दिन चैन से खा पी लो तुम बेशक गुनेहगार हो
hinglish: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
english: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
hindi: उस दिन झुठलाने वालों की मिट्टी ख़राब है
hinglish: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
english: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.
hindi: और जब उनसे कहा जाता है कि रूकूउ करों तो रूकूउ नहीं करते
hinglish: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
english: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
hindi: उस दिन झुठलाने वालों की ख़राबी है
hinglish: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic: فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ
english: Then in what statement after the Qur'an will they believe?
hindi: अब इसके बाद ये किस बात पर ईमान लाएँगे
hinglish: Then in what statement after the Qur'an will they believe?

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
english: About what are they asking one another?
hindi: ये लोग आपस में किस चीज़ का हाल पूछते हैं
hinglish: About what are they asking one another?

arabic: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
english: About the great news -
hindi: एक बड़ी ख़बर का हाल
hinglish: About the great news -

arabic: ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
english: That over which they are in disagreement.
hindi: जिसमें लोग एख्तेलाफ कर रहे हैं
hinglish: That over which they are in disagreement.

arabic: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
english: No! They are going to know.
hindi: देखो उन्हें अनक़रीब ही मालूम हो जाएगा
hinglish: No! They are going to know.

arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
english: Then, no! They are going to know.
hindi: फिर इन्हें अनक़रीब ही ज़रूर मालूम हो जाएगा
hinglish: Then, no! They are going to know.

arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَـٰدًا
english: Have We not made the earth a resting place?
hindi: क्या हमने ज़मीन को बिछौना
hinglish: Have We not made the earth a resting place?

arabic: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًا
english: And the mountains as stakes?
hindi: और पहाड़ों को (ज़मीन) की मेख़े नहीं बनाया
hinglish: And the mountains as stakes?

arabic: وَخَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا
english: And We created you in pairs
hindi: और हमने तुम लोगों को जोड़ा जोड़ा पैदा किया
hinglish: And We created you in pairs

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًا
english: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
hindi: और तुम्हारी नींद को आराम (का बाइस) क़रार दिया
hinglish: And made your sleep [a means for] rest

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا
english: And made the night as clothing
hindi: और रात को परदा बनाया
hinglish: And made the night as clothing

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًا
english: And made the day for livelihood
hindi: और हम ही ने दिन को (कसब) मआश (का वक्त) बनाया
hinglish: And made the day for livelihood

arabic: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًا شِدَادًا
english: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
hindi: और तुम्हारे ऊपर सात मज़बूत (आसमान) बनाए
hinglish: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًا وَهَّاجًا
english: And made [therein] a burning lamp
hindi: और हम ही ने (सूरज) को रौशन चिराग़ बनाया
hinglish: And made [therein] a burning lamp

arabic: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءً ثَجَّاجًا
english: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water
hindi: और हम ही ने बादलों से मूसलाधार पानी बरसाया
hinglish: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water

arabic: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّا وَنَبَاتًا
english: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
hindi: ताकि उसके ज़रिए से दाने और सबज़ी
hinglish: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation

arabic: وَجَنَّـٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا
english: And gardens of entwined growth.
hindi: और घने घने बाग़ पैदा करें
hinglish: And gardens of entwined growth.

arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَـٰتًا
english: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -
hindi: बेशक फैसले का दिन मुक़र्रर है
hinglish: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -

arabic: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا
english: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
hindi: जिस दिन सूर फूँका जाएगा और तुम लोग गिरोह गिरोह हाज़िर होगे
hinglish: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes

arabic: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًا
english: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
hindi: और आसमान खोल दिए जाएँगे
hinglish: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways

arabic: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا
english: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
hindi: तो (उसमें) दरवाज़े हो जाएँगे और पहाड़ (अपनी जगह से) चलाए जाएँगे तो रेत होकर रह जाएँगे
hinglish: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.

arabic: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا
english: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
hindi: बेशक जहन्नुम घात में है
hinglish: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait

arabic: لِّلطَّـٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًا
english: For the transgressors, a place of return,
hindi: सरकशों का (वही) ठिकाना है
hinglish: For the transgressors, a place of return,

arabic: لَّـٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًا
english: In which they will remain for ages [unending].
hindi: उसमें मुद्दतों पड़े झींकते रहेंगें
hinglish: In which they will remain for ages [unending].

arabic: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا
english: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
hindi: न वहाँ ठन्डक का मज़ा चखेंगे और न खौलते हुए पानी
hinglish: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink

arabic: إِلَّا حَمِيمًا وَغَسَّاقًا
english: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -
hindi: और बहती हुई पीप के सिवा कुछ पीने को मिलेगा
hinglish: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -

arabic: جَزَآءً وِفَاقًا
english: An appropriate recompense.
hindi: (ये उनकी कारस्तानियों का) पूरा पूरा बदला है
hinglish: An appropriate recompense.

arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا
english: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
hindi: बेशक ये लोग आख़ेरत के हिसाब की उम्मीद ही न रखते थे
hinglish: Indeed, they were not expecting an account

arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كِذَّابًا
english: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
hindi: और इन लोगो हमारी आयतों को बुरी तरह झुठलाया
hinglish: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.

arabic: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ كِتَـٰبًا
english: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
hindi: और हमने हर चीज़ को लिख कर मनज़बत कर रखा है
hinglish: But all things We have enumerated in writing.

arabic: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
english: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."
hindi: तो अब तुम मज़ा चखो हमतो तुम पर अज़ाब ही बढ़ाते जाएँगे
hinglish: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."

arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
english: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -
hindi: बेशक परहेज़गारों के लिए बड़ी कामयाबी है
hinglish: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -

arabic: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَـٰبًا
english: Gardens and grapevines
hindi: (यानि बेहश्त के) बाग़ और अंगूर
hinglish: Gardens and grapevines

arabic: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا
english: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age
hindi: और वह औरतें जिनकी उठती हुई जवानियाँ
hinglish: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age

arabic: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا
english: And a full cup.
hindi: और बाहम हमजोलियाँ हैं और शराब के लबरेज़ साग़र
hinglish: And a full cup.

arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
english: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
hindi: और शराब के लबरेज़ साग़र वहाँ न बेहूदा बात सुनेंगे और न झूठ
hinglish: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -

arabic: جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًا
english: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,
hindi: (ये) तुम्हारे परवरदिगार की तरफ से काफ़ी इनाम और सिला है
hinglish: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,

arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
english: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.
hindi: जो सारे आसमान और ज़मीन और जो इन दोनों के बीच में है सबका मालिक है बड़ा मेहरबान लोगों को उससे बात का पूरा न होगा
hinglish: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.

arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
english: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
hindi: जिस दिन जिबरील और फरिश्ते (उसके सामने) पर बाँध कर खड़े होंगे (उस दिन) उससे कोई बात न कर सकेगा मगर जिसे ख़ुदा इजाज़त दे और वह ठिकाने की बात कहे
hinglish: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
english: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
hindi: वह दिन बरहक़ है तो जो शख़्श चाहे अपने परवरदिगार की बारगाह में (अपना) ठिकाना बनाए
hinglish: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
english: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
hindi: हमने तुम लोगों को अनक़रीब आने वाले अज़ाब से डरा दिया जिस दिन आदमी अपने हाथों पहले से भेजे हुए (आमाल) को देखेगा और काफ़िर कहेगा काश मैं ख़ाक हो जाता
hinglish: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلنَّـٰزِعَـٰتِ غَرْقًا
english: By those [angels] who extract with violence
hindi: उन (फ़रिश्तों) की क़सम
hinglish: By those [angels] who extract with violence

arabic: وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَـٰتِ نَشْطًا
english: And [by] those who remove with ease
hindi: जो (कुफ्फ़ार की रूह) डूब कर सख्ती से खींच लेते हैं
hinglish: And [by] those who remove with ease

arabic: وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَـٰتِ سَبْحًا
english: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming
hindi: और उनकी क़सम जो (मोमिनीन की जान) आसानी से खोल देते हैं
hinglish: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming

arabic: فَٱلسَّـٰبِقَـٰتِ سَبْقًا
english: And those who race each other in a race
hindi: और उनकी क़सम जो (आसमान ज़मीन के दरमियान) पैरते फिरते हैं
hinglish: And those who race each other in a race

arabic: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًا
english: And those who arrange [each] matter,
hindi: फिर एक के आगे बढ़ते हैं
hinglish: And those who arrange [each] matter,

arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
english: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],
hindi: फिर (दुनिया के) इन्तज़ाम करते हैं (उनकी क़सम) कि क़यामत हो कर रहेगी
hinglish: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],

arabic: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
english: There will follow it the subsequent [one].
hindi: जिस दिन ज़मीन को भूचाल आएगा फिर उसके पीछे और ज़लज़ला आएगा
hinglish: There will follow it the subsequent [one].

arabic: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ
english: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,
hindi: उस दिन दिलों को धड़कन होगी
hinglish: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,

arabic: أَبْصَـٰرُهَا خَـٰشِعَةٌ
english: Their eyes humbled.
hindi: उनकी ऑंखें (निदामत से) झुकी हुई होंगी
hinglish: Their eyes humbled.

arabic: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
english: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?
hindi: कुफ्फ़ार कहते हैं कि क्या हम उलटे पाँव (ज़िन्दगी की तरफ़) फिर लौटेंगे
hinglish: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?

arabic: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا نَّخِرَةً
english: Even if we should be decayed bones?
hindi: क्या जब हम खोखल हड्डियाँ हो जाएँगे
hinglish: Even if we should be decayed bones?

arabic: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ
english: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."
hindi: कहते हैं कि ये लौटना तो बड़ा नुक़सान देह है
hinglish: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."

arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
english: Indeed, it will be but one shout,
hindi: वह (क़यामत) तो (गोया) बस एक सख्त चीख़ होगी
hinglish: Indeed, it will be but one shout,

arabic: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
english: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.
hindi: और लोग शक़ बारगी एक मैदान (हश्र) में मौजूद होंगे
hinglish: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.

arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
english: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -
hindi: (ऐ रसूल) क्या तुम्हारे पास मूसा का किस्सा भी पहुँचा है
hinglish: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -

arabic: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
english: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,
hindi: जब उनको परवरदिगार ने तूवा के मैदान में पुकारा
hinglish: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,

arabic: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
english: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
hindi: कि फिरऔन के पास जाओ वह सरकश हो गया है
hinglish: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

arabic: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
english: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
hindi: (और उससे) कहो कि क्या तेरी ख्वाहिश है कि (कुफ्र से) पाक हो जाए
hinglish: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself

arabic: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
english: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"
hindi: और मैं तुझे तेरे परवरदिगार की राह बता दूँ तो तुझको ख़ौफ (पैदा) हो
hinglish: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"

arabic: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْـَٔايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
english: And he showed him the greatest sign,
hindi: ग़रज़ मूसा ने उसे (असा का बड़ा) मौजिज़ा दिखाया
hinglish: And he showed him the greatest sign,

arabic: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
english: But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed.
hindi: तो उसने झुठला दिया और न माना
hinglish: But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed.

arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
english: Then he turned his back, striving.
hindi: फिर पीठ फेर कर (ख़िलाफ़ की) तदबीर करने लगा
hinglish: Then he turned his back, striving.

arabic: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
english: And he gathered [his people] and called out
hindi: फिर (लोगों को) जमा किया और बुलन्द आवाज़ से चिल्लाया
hinglish: And he gathered [his people] and called out

arabic: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
english: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."
hindi: तो कहने लगा मैं तुम लोगों का सबसे बड़ा परवरदिगार हूँ
hinglish: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."

arabic: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
english: So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].
hindi: तो ख़ुदा ने उसे दुनिया और आख़ेरत (दोनों) के अज़ाब में गिरफ्तार किया
hinglish: So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].

arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
english: Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [Allah].
hindi: बेशक जो शख़्श (ख़ुदा से) डरे उसके लिए इस (किस्से) में इबरत है
hinglish: Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [Allah].

arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
english: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.
hindi: भला तुम्हारा पैदा करना ज्यादा मुश्किल है या आसमान का
hinglish: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.

arabic: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
english: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
hindi: कि उसी ने उसको बनाया उसकी छत को ख़ूब ऊँचा रखा
hinglish: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.

arabic: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
english: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.
hindi: फिर उसे दुरूस्त किया और उसकी रात को तारीक बनाया और (दिन को) उसकी धूप निकाली
hinglish: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.

arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
english: And after that He spread the earth.
hindi: और उसके बाद ज़मीन को फैलाया
hinglish: And after that He spread the earth.

arabic: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
english: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,
hindi: उसी में से उसका पानी और उसका चारा निकाला
hinglish: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,

arabic: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
english: And the mountains He set firmly
hindi: और पहाड़ों को उसमें गाड़ दिया
hinglish: And the mountains He set firmly

arabic: مَتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ
english: As provision for you and your grazing livestock.
hindi: (ये सब सामान) तुम्हारे और तुम्हारे चारपायो के फ़ायदे के लिए है
hinglish: As provision for you and your grazing livestock.

arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
english: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -
hindi: तो जब बड़ी सख्त मुसीबत (क़यामत) आ मौजूद होगी
hinglish: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -

arabic: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
english: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,
hindi: जिस दिन इन्सान अपने कामों को कुछ याद करेगा
hinglish: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,

arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
english: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -
hindi: और जहन्नुम देखने वालों के सामने ज़ाहिर कर दी जाएगी
hinglish: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -

arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
english: So as for he who transgressed
hindi: तो जिसने (दुनिया में) सर उठाया था
hinglish: So as for he who transgressed

arabic: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
english: And preferred the life of the world,
hindi: और दुनियावी ज़िन्दगी को तरजीह दी थी
hinglish: And preferred the life of the world,

arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
english: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.
hindi: उसका ठिकाना तो यक़ीनन दोज़ख़ है
hinglish: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
english: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
hindi: मगर जो शख़्श अपने परवरदिगार के सामने खड़े होने से डरता और जी को नाजायज़ ख्वाहिशों से रोकता रहा
hinglish: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,

arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
english: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.
hindi: तो उसका ठिकाना यक़ीनन बेहश्त है
hinglish: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.

arabic: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
english: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?
hindi: (ऐ रसूल) लोग तुम से क़यामत के बारे में पूछते हैं
hinglish: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?

arabic: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
english: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?
hindi: कि उसका कहीं थल बेड़ा भी है
hinglish: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?

arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
english: To your Lord is its finality.
hindi: तो तुम उसके ज़िक्र से किस फ़िक्र में हो
hinglish: To your Lord is its finality.

arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
english: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
hindi: उस (के इल्म) की इन्तेहा तुम्हारे परवरदिगार ही तक है तो तुम बस जो उससे डरे उसको डराने वाले हो
hinglish: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
english: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
hindi: जिस दिन वह लोग इसको देखेंगे तो (समझेंगे कि दुनिया में) बस एक शाम या सुबह ठहरे थे
hinglish: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
english: The Prophet frowned and turned away
hindi: वह अपनी बात पर चीं ब जबीं हो गया
hinglish: The Prophet frowned and turned away

arabic: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
english: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].
hindi: और मुँह फेर बैठा कि उसके पास नाबीना आ गया
hinglish: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].

arabic: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
english: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified
hindi: और तुमको क्या मालूम यायद वह (तालीम से) पाकीज़गी हासिल करता
hinglish: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified

arabic: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
english: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?
hindi: या वह नसीहत सुनता तो नसीहत उसके काम आती
hinglish: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?

arabic: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
english: As for he who thinks himself without need,
hindi: तो जो कुछ परवाह नहीं करता
hinglish: As for he who thinks himself without need,

arabic: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
english: To him you give attention.
hindi: उसके तो तुम दरपै हो जाते हो हालॉकि अगर वह न सुधरे
hinglish: To him you give attention.

arabic: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
english: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.
hindi: तो तुम ज़िम्मेदार नहीं
hinglish: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
english: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]
hindi: और जो तुम्हारे पास लपकता हुआ आता है
hinglish: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]

arabic: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
english: While he fears [Allah],
hindi: और (ख़ुदा से) डरता है
hinglish: While he fears [Allah],

arabic: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
english: From him you are distracted.
hindi: तो तुम उससे बेरूख़ी करते हो
hinglish: From him you are distracted.

arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
english: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder;
hindi: देखो ये (क़ुरान) तो सरासर नसीहत है
hinglish: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder;

arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
english: So whoever wills may remember it.
hindi: तो जो चाहे इसे याद रखे
hinglish: So whoever wills may remember it.

arabic: فِى صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ
english: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,
hindi: (लौहे महफूज़ के) बहुत मोअज़ज़िज औराक़ में (लिखा हुआ) है
hinglish: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,

arabic: مَّرْفُوعَةٍ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
english: Exalted and purified,
hindi: बुलन्द मरतबा और पाक हैं
hinglish: Exalted and purified,

arabic: بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍ
english: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,
hindi: (ऐसे) लिखने वालों के हाथों में है
hinglish: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,

arabic: كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍ
english: Noble and dutiful.
hindi: जो बुज़ुर्ग नेकोकार हैं
hinglish: Noble and dutiful.

arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ
english: Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he.
hindi: इन्सान हलाक हो जाए वह क्या कैसा नाशुक्रा है
hinglish: Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he.

arabic: مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
english: From what substance did He create him?
hindi: (ख़ुदा ने) उसे किस चीज़ से पैदा किया
hinglish: From what substance did He create him?

arabic: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
english: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;
hindi: नुत्फे से उसे पैदा किया फिर उसका अन्दाज़ा मुक़र्रर किया
hinglish: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;

arabic: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
english: Then He eased the way for him;
hindi: फिर उसका रास्ता आसान कर दिया
hinglish: Then He eased the way for him;

arabic: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ
english: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.
hindi: फिर उसे मौत दी फिर उसे कब्र में दफ़न कराया
hinglish: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.

arabic: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
english: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.
hindi: फिर जब चाहेगा उठा खड़ा करेगा
hinglish: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.

arabic: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
english: No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.
hindi: सच तो यह है कि ख़ुदा ने जो हुक्म उसे दिया उसने उसको पूरा न किया
hinglish: No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.

arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
english: Then let mankind look at his food -
hindi: तो इन्सान को अपने घाटे ही तरफ ग़ौर करना चाहिए
hinglish: Then let mankind look at his food -

arabic: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّا
english: How We poured down water in torrents,
hindi: कि हम ही ने (बादल) से पानी बरसाया
hinglish: How We poured down water in torrents,

arabic: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّا
english: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],
hindi: फिर हम ही ने ज़मीन (दरख्त उगाकर) चीरी फाड़ी
hinglish: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],

arabic: فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّا
english: And caused to grow within it grain
hindi: फिर हमने उसमें अनाज उगाया
hinglish: And caused to grow within it grain

arabic: وَعِنَبًا وَقَضْبًا
english: And grapes and herbage
hindi: और अंगूर और तरकारियाँ
hinglish: And grapes and herbage

arabic: وَزَيْتُونًا وَنَخْلًا
english: And olive and palm trees
hindi: और ज़ैतून और खजूरें
hinglish: And olive and palm trees

arabic: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًا
english: And gardens of dense shrubbery
hindi: और घने घने बाग़ और मेवे
hinglish: And gardens of dense shrubbery

arabic: وَفَـٰكِهَةً وَأَبًّا
english: And fruit and grass -
hindi: और चारा (ये सब कुछ) तुम्हारे और तुम्हारे
hinglish: And fruit and grass -

arabic: مَّتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ
english: [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock.
hindi: चारपायों के फायदे के लिए (बनाया)
hinglish: [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock.

arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
english: But when there comes the Deafening Blast
hindi: तो जब कानों के परदे फाड़ने वाली (क़यामत) आ मौजूद होगी
hinglish: But when there comes the Deafening Blast

arabic: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
english: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
hindi: उस दिन आदमी अपने भाई
hinglish: On the Day a man will flee from his brother

arabic: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
english: And his mother and his father
hindi: और अपनी माँ और अपने बाप
hinglish: And his mother and his father

arabic: وَصَـٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
english: And his wife and his children,
hindi: और अपने लड़के बालों से भागेगा
hinglish: And his wife and his children,

arabic: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ
english: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.
hindi: उस दिन हर शख़्श (अपनी नजात की) ऐसी फ़िक्र में होगा जो उसके (मशग़ूल होने के) लिए काफ़ी हों
hinglish: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.

arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّسْفِرَةٌ
english: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -
hindi: बहुत से चेहरे तो उस दिन चमकते होंगे
hinglish: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -

arabic: ضَاحِكَةٌ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌ
english: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.
hindi: ख़न्दाँ शांदाँ (यही नेको कार हैं)
hinglish: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.

arabic: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌ
english: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.
hindi: और बहुत से चेहरे ऐसे होंगे जिन पर गर्द पड़ी होगी
hinglish: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.

arabic: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
english: Blackness will cover them.
hindi: उस पर सियाही छाई हुई होगी
hinglish: Blackness will cover them.

arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ
english: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.
hindi: यही कुफ्फ़ार बदकार हैं
hinglish: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
english: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
hindi: जिस वक्त आफ़ताब की चादर को लपेट लिया जाएगा
hinglish: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
english: And when the stars fall, dispersing,
hindi: और जिस वक्त तारे गिर पडेग़ें
hinglish: And when the stars fall, dispersing,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
english: And when the mountains are removed
hindi: और जब पहाड़ चलाए जाएंगें
hinglish: And when the mountains are removed

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
english: And when full-term she-camels are neglected
hindi: और जब अनक़रीब जनने वाली ऊंटनियों बेकार कर दी जाएंगी
hinglish: And when full-term she-camels are neglected

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
english: And when the wild beasts are gathered
hindi: और जिस वक्त वहशी जानवर इकट्ठा किये जायेंगे
hinglish: And when the wild beasts are gathered

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
english: And when the seas are filled with flame
hindi: और जिस वक्त दरिया आग हो जायेंगे
hinglish: And when the seas are filled with flame

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
english: And when the souls are paired
hindi: और जिस वक्त रुहें हवियों से मिला दी जाएंगी
hinglish: And when the souls are paired

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ
english: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
hindi: और जिस वक्त ज़िन्दा दर गोर लड़की से पूछा जाएगा
hinglish: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked

arabic: بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍ قُتِلَتْ
english: For what sin she was killed
hindi: कि वह किस गुनाह के बदले मारी गयी
hinglish: For what sin she was killed

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
english: And when the pages are made public
hindi: और जिस वक्त (आमाल के) दफ्तर खोले जाएं
hinglish: And when the pages are made public

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ
english: And when the sky is stripped away
hindi: और जिस वक्त आसमान का छिलका उतारा जाएगा
hinglish: And when the sky is stripped away

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
english: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
hindi: और जब दोज़ख़ (की आग) भड़कायी जाएगी
hinglish: And when Hellfire is set ablaze

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
english: And when Paradise is brought near,
hindi: और जब बेहिश्त क़रीब कर दी जाएगी
hinglish: And when Paradise is brought near,

arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ
english: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].
hindi: तब हर शख़्श मालूम करेगा कि वह क्या (आमाल) लेकर आया
hinglish: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].

arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ
english: So I swear by the retreating stars -
hindi: तो मुझे उन सितारों की क़सम जो चलते चलते पीछे हट जाते
hinglish: So I swear by the retreating stars -

arabic: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ
english: Those that run [their courses] and disappear -
hindi: और ग़ायब होते हैं
hinglish: Those that run [their courses] and disappear -

arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
english: And by the night as it closes in
hindi: और रात की क़सम जब ख़त्म होने को आए
hinglish: And by the night as it closes in

arabic: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
english: And by the dawn when it breathes
hindi: और सुबह की क़सम जब रौशन हो जाए
hinglish: And by the dawn when it breathes

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
english: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger
hindi: कि बेशक यें (क़ुरान) एक मुअज़िज़ फरिश्ता (जिबरील की ज़बान का पैग़ाम है
hinglish: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger

arabic: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
english: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
hindi: जो बड़े क़वी अर्श के मालिक की बारगाह में बुलन्द रुतबा है
hinglish: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],

arabic: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
english: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.
hindi: वहाँ (सब फरिश्तों का) सरदार अमानतदार है
